prs.title: test(managed-agent): gate G3 cleanup and terminal recovery faults
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds three packaged fault arms to the G3 Step 3 recovery gates. The first refuses the original Runtime cleanup release and crashes the Harness again, so the replacement must retry the original cleanup identity and confirm it exactly once. The second commits the terminal event but loses its reply — including every bounded retry — until the Harness crashes, so the replacement must replay the terminal once with no inference or tool call. The third refuses the terminal write over a payable checkpoint, so the replacement must compensate it once without inventing a result. Each arm keeps the original Action, execution, file effect, Runtime binding and terminal count, and the failover job grows from 20 to 23 arms.

The surviving public transcript must also still carry the recovered model answer, so a compensation that only projects a terminal does not pass. The bilingual Step 3 design and the server README are updated, and the lost takeover-load reply remains focused because the packaged arm found a separate recovery gap.

## Why it's needed

The remaining rows of the G3 Step 3 matrix still have no packaged evidence. A regression in cleanup retry, terminal replay or terminal compensation would pass CI today. These three arms close the cleanup and terminal rows; the load-reply arm was written and run, but it exposed a product gap (the redrive's active handoff leaves the original Turn RUNNING), so it is deliberately not part of this change.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

In the `Hosted failover E2E / Java 21` job, confirm the three new arms stay green. The cleanup arm must show one refused release, one successful retry, one settled execution, one file effect, one terminal and the original cleanup confirmation. The terminal reply-loss arm must commit the terminal before the crash, lose every bounded retry of its reply, and show one replay after the replacement with no second model or tool call. The terminal write-failure arm must show one refused terminal write, one compensating write, one terminal and no invented result. All three must leave the recovered model answer visible in the surviving public transcript. Removing the corresponding fault must make the arm fail at its barrier, not pass on a weaker check.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test and CI only. Local evidence at head `0f439320a5` on Linux aarch64 (MySQL 8.4.13, JDK 21.0.9, current CLI bundle and server jar): all three arms exited 0 with `releaseFailures=1 releaseSuccesses=1`, `terminalAccepts=1`, and `terminalRejects=1 terminalAccepts=1` respectively; each had one settled execution, one file effect, one terminal, the recovered answer and the original cleanup confirmation. The transcript check also passed on the base Allow, `after-result`, `decision-reply-lost` and `admission-reply-lost` arms.

In three local mutation runs that disabled each fault and shortened only the barrier budget, every arm failed at the expected barrier (`Runtime cleanup release refused` / `Terminal commit store fault observed`), so the gates are live. The two runner/CI contract suites pass 122 tests; ESLint, Prettier and the workflow-size ratchet are clean.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

macOS ran the build, the runner/CI contract suites and lint/format. Linux aarch64 ran the three packaged arms against real MySQL, Spring, the Runtime Broker and a replacement Harness. Windows is not applicable to the Linux durable-runtime lane.

### Environment (optional)

The packaged arms ran in a Linux container with a runner-private MySQL, the packaged CLI bundle and the server jar; the model was a controlled local OpenAI fixture, not a real provider.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the arms add 30 minutes of step ceilings to the failover job, so the job ceiling moves to 245 minutes. The store and Broker proxies are test-only and do not change production behavior. The terminal reply-loss arm now drops every bounded retry, which makes the fault stronger than a single lost response.
- Not validated / out of scope: the lost takeover-load reply (written and run, but it exposed a separate recovery gap and stays focused), real-provider acceptance, a real mixed-version cluster and a two-control-plane deployment.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; test, CI and documentation only.

Design docs: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/test/14481-g3-residual-faults/docs/design/2026-10-09-hosted-g3-step3-recovery.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/test/14481-g3-residual-faults/docs/design/2026-10-09-hosted-g3-step3-recovery.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Part of #14481. Tracks #12380.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

给 G3 第 3 步恢复门禁新增三条打包故障支路。第一条拒绝原 Runtime 的清理释放，然后再次崩溃 Harness，要求替换方用原 cleanup 身份重试并恰好确认一次。第二条提交终态事件但丢失回复——包括每一次有界重试——直到 Harness 崩溃，要求替换方重放一次终态，且不产生推理或工具调用。第三条在可付 checkpoint 上拒绝终态写入，要求替换方恰好补偿一次，且不发明结果。每条支路都保留原 Action、执行、文件效果、Runtime binding 与终态计数；failover 任务从 20 条臂增加到 23 条。

公开文本还必须保留恢复出的模型答案，因此只投影终态、没有答案的补偿不能通过。同步更新中英双语第 3 步设计与 server README；接管 load 回复丢失仍保持定向覆盖，因为打包支路发现了一个独立的恢复缺口。

## 为什么需要

G3 第 3 步矩阵的剩余行仍没有打包证据。清理重试、终态重放或终态补偿一旦回归，今天的 CI 仍会通过。这三条支路补齐 cleanup 与 terminal 行；load 回复支路已经实现并运行，但它暴露了产品缺口（重发的 active handoff 让原 Turn 停在 RUNNING），因此刻意不放入本变更。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

在 `Hosted failover E2E / Java 21` 任务中确认三条新支路保持绿色。cleanup 支路必须显示一次释放被拒、一次成功重试、一次已结算执行、一次文件效果、一个终态和原 cleanup 确认。终态回复丢失支路必须在崩溃前提交终态、丢失它的每一次有界重试，并在替换后只重放一次终态，且没有第二次模型或工具调用。终态写入失败支路必须显示一次写入被拒、一次补偿写入、一个终态且没有发明结果。三条都必须让恢复出的模型答案保留在公开文本中。移除对应故障必须让支路在屏障处失败，而不是靠更弱的检查通过。

### 证据（修改前后）

N/A —— 仅测试与 CI。head `0f439320a5` 的 Linux aarch64 本地证据（MySQL 8.4.13、JDK 21.0.9、当前 CLI bundle 与 server jar）：三条支路均退出 0，分别为 `releaseFailures=1 releaseSuccesses=1`、`terminalAccepts=1`、`terminalRejects=1 terminalAccepts=1`；每条都只有一次已结算执行、一次文件效果、一个终态、恢复出的答案和原 cleanup 确认。答案检查也在基础 Allow、`after-result`、`decision-reply-lost` 与 `admission-reply-lost` 支路上通过。

三次本地变异分别移除一个故障、只缩短屏障预算：每条支路都在预期屏障处失败（`Runtime cleanup release refused` / `Terminal commit store fault observed`），证明门禁不是空过。两个 runner/CI 契约套件通过 122 条测试；ESLint、Prettier 与 workflow 体积棘轮均干净。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

macOS 运行了构建、runner/CI 契约套件与 lint/format。Linux aarch64 在真实 MySQL、Spring、Runtime Broker 与替换 Harness 上运行了三条打包支路。Windows 不适用于 Linux durable-runtime lane。

### 环境（可选）

打包支路在 Linux 容器中运行，使用 runner 私有 MySQL、打包 CLI bundle 与 server jar；模型是受控的本地 OpenAI fixture，不是真实 provider。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：三条支路给 failover 任务增加 30 分钟 step 上限，任务上限提高到 245 分钟。store 与 Broker 代理仅用于测试，不改变生产行为。终态回复丢失支路现在丢弃每一次有界重试，故障比单次丢包更强。
- 未验证 / 范围外：接管 load 回复丢失（已实现并运行，但暴露独立恢复缺口，保持定向覆盖）、真实 provider 验收、真实混版本集群和双控制面部署。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无；仅测试、CI 与文档。

设计文档：[英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/test/14481-g3-residual-faults/docs/design/2026-10-09-hosted-g3-step3-recovery.md) 与 [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/test/14481-g3-residual-faults/docs/design/2026-10-09-hosted-g3-step3-recovery.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

Part of #14481. Tracks #12380.

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): move no-workspace sessions beside workspaces
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Moves **No-workspace sessions / 无工作区会话** out of Workspaces into its own peer group, after the workspace list and before Archived. Collapsing Workspaces no longer hides the group. Its collapse preference now survives reload independently; active and archived no-workspace groups use separate preferences.

**Naming decision:** after discussion, the requester confirmed that the name remains **No-workspace sessions / 无工作区会话**. “Standalone sessions / 独立会话” is not being adopted. This resolves the naming decision raised in #15309 while preserving the existing English and Chinese labels.

## Why it's needed

Sessions without a registered workspace association were nested under the Workspaces collapse boundary. Users could mistake the disappearing group for missing sessions, even though expanding Workspaces restored it. Independent placement makes the organizational relationship clearer and keeps the group reachable when workspace entries are collapsed.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Connect Web Shell to a daemon supporting no-workspace sessions. With at least one such session, collapse Workspaces (currently labeled Project on main). The no-workspace group and its rows should remain visible after reload.
2. Collapse the no-workspace group, expand Workspaces, and reload. Workspaces should remain expanded and the no-workspace group collapsed. Expand the group and confirm its sessions return.
3. With the group collapsed, search for a session title. The matching row should appear without changing the saved collapse preference. Open it and confirm it uses the standalone session context.
4. Confirm existing creation, rename, export, archive, unarchive, and delete actions retain their behavior. A locked workspace or a daemon without standalone-session support must not expose the group. Archived no-workspace sessions remain under Archived.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Chromium screenshots of the actual Web Shell with Workspaces collapsed and simulated daemon responses:

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![Group hidden](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deggs7/qwen-code/codex/standalone-session-placement/docs/design/images/no-workspace-sessions-before.png) | ![Peer group visible](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deggs7/qwen-code/codex/standalone-session-placement/docs/design/images/no-workspace-sessions-after.png) |

The added browser regression failed on the unchanged implementation because the group became hidden after collapsing Workspaces. The fixed implementation passes visibility, independent reload persistence, search, and exact session-route assertions. Independent browser verification reproduced the baseline with globally installed Qwen 0.25.3 and verified the final locally built CLI serving its bundled Web Shell assets.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Chromium and automated checks |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Node.js 24.14.1, Chromium, and simulated daemon APIs. Full repository build, typecheck, bundle, and lint passed. The two related component files passed 180 tests; the standalone-session browser suite passed all seven cases, and the final stricter exact-URL regression also passed. Formatting and whitespace checks passed. Independent static review found no actionable defects. Full repository preflight/test suites were not run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the no-workspace group changes position and gains independent persisted expansion preferences. It retains the existing header, session rows, search, pagination, and actions.
- Not validated / out of scope: real model-provider traffic, Windows/Linux browsers, and native embedding runtime were not exercised. Existing capability, host ownership, locked-workspace, section-view, and Live restrictions remain in place. #14904 handles Recent, #15311 handles creation refresh, and #14988 handles general terminology separately.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; no backend, SDK, session storage, workspace association, or filesystem permission changes.

Design: [English](https://github.com/deggs7/qwen-code/blob/codex/standalone-session-placement/docs/design/no-workspace-session-placement.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/deggs7/qwen-code/blob/codex/standalone-session-placement/docs/design/no-workspace-session-placement.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Closes #15309.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

将**无工作区会话 / No-workspace sessions**移出工作区，放到工作区列表之后、已归档之前，成为独立的同级分组。折叠工作区不再隐藏该分组。分组自身的折叠偏好独立跨刷新保留，活动与已归档的无工作区分组分别保存偏好。

**命名决定：**经讨论，请求者已确认名称保留为**无工作区会话 / No-workspace sessions**，不采用“独立会话 / Standalone sessions”。这明确了 #15309 提出的命名决定，保留现有中英文名称。

## 修改原因

未关联已注册工作区的会话此前位于工作区折叠边界内部。分组消失可能让用户误以为会话丢失，虽然展开工作区即可恢复。同级放置让组织关系更清晰，也让工作区条目折叠时该分组仍然可访问。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 验证方法

1. 将 Web Shell 连接到支持无工作区会话的 daemon，准备至少一个此类会话并折叠工作区（当前 main 文案为 Project）。无工作区分组及会话行应在刷新后仍然可见。
2. 折叠无工作区分组，展开工作区并刷新。工作区应保持展开，无工作区分组保持折叠。展开分组后应恢复显示其会话。
3. 分组折叠时按会话标题搜索。匹配会话行应显示，且不改变已保存的折叠偏好。打开后确认进入独立会话上下文。
4. 确认现有创建、重命名、导出、归档、取消归档和删除操作行为保持一致。锁定工作区或不支持独立会话的 daemon 不应暴露该分组。已归档的无工作区会话仍位于已归档区域。

### 修改前后证据

上表为工作区折叠时真实 Web Shell 的 Chromium 截图，使用模拟 daemon 响应。左侧为修改前分组隐藏，右侧为修改后同级分组可见。

新增浏览器回归测试在未修改实现上因折叠工作区后分组隐藏而失败。修改后通过可见性、独立刷新持久化、搜索及精确会话路由断言。独立浏览器验证使用全局安装的 Qwen 0.25.3 复现基线，并验证最终本地 CLI 构建提供的 Web Shell 产物。

### 本地测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Chromium 及自动检查 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试 |

### 环境

macOS、Node.js 24.14.1、Chromium 和模拟 daemon API。完整仓库构建、类型检查、打包及 lint 通过。两个相关组件文件共 180 项测试通过；独立会话浏览器套件全部七项通过，最终更严格的精确 URL 回归测试也通过。格式与空白检查通过。独立静态审查未发现可操作缺陷。未运行完整仓库 preflight 或全量测试套件。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：无工作区分组改变位置并新增独立展开偏好持久化，保留现有标题、会话行、搜索、分页及操作。
- 未验证或范围外：未验证真实模型服务流量、Windows/Linux 浏览器和原生嵌入运行环境。保留现有能力、主机归属、锁定工作区、分区视图和 Live 限制。#14904 的最近列表、#15311 的创建刷新和 #14988 的通用术语分别处理。
- 不兼容改动或迁移说明：无；不修改后端、SDK、会话存储、工作区关联或文件系统权限。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/deggs7/qwen-code/blob/codex/standalone-session-placement/docs/design/no-workspace-session-placement.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/deggs7/qwen-code/blob/codex/standalone-session-placement/docs/design/no-workspace-session-placement.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

关闭 #15309。

</details>

prs.title: feat(acp): connect durable team reports and session approvals [13902 B/3]
prs.body:
Stack: **[#15657](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15657) → [#15658](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15658) → [#15659](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15659)**. This is **B**, based on A (`split/13902-agent-identity`, `3294001f39040a668fcbad20045b64e03dc1b6e6`); base branch: `split/13902-agent-identity`. C (`split/13902-teammate-activity`) depends on B. Split from #13902 at source commit `6ed7884c381dfe1c59bd975d6cf61dbb41ef441c`; candidate B: `435e4f949eca7232c2b48d3a259f5083cb788b8a`. Review B against A to isolate the coordination change.

## What this PR does

Connects an ACP-hosted leader to Team reports, roster membership and teammate approvals. Reports and join/exit notices enter the existing peer notification path with canonical teammate identity, survive recording and replay, and receive teammate attribution in the Web Shell. Pending reports participate in work holds, reversible close, queue overflow and shutdown flushing.

Teammate approvals reach the host independently of the leader's permission queue. Session scope, request UUIDs, binding epochs, ownership checks and retirement on manager replacement or teammate exit keep approval lifetime tied to the owning session. B includes producer, persistence, bridge, SDK/UI consumers and their tests. It consumes A's shared identity contract without depending on subagent runtime behavior. Tool activity and inter-agent message display arrive in C.

## Why it's needed

Without a leader sink, ACP-hosted teammate reports remain unread and teammate approval events have no consumer. The leader and its client need a delivery path that carries attribution, preserves undrained reports and exposes teammate approval requests.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. At candidate `435e4f949eca7232c2b48d3a259f5083cb788b8a`, run `npm run build` from the repository root, then run the package-local commands below serially. Each Vitest command runs from the stated package directory.
2. Deliver a teammate report and roster join/exit, then reload the transcript. Confirm canonical attribution, peer semantics and turn-marker correlation. Exercise reversible close, pending-report holds, overflow, repeat flush and shutdown with undrained reports.
3. Leave a teammate approval unanswered while the leader requests its own tool approval. Confirm the leader request remains visible. Exercise host answer/failure, standalone policy, session ownership, manager rebinding, teammate exit and cancellation; evaluate the inherited feedback below separately.

```sh
# cwd: packages/acp-bridge
../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/bridge-workflow-ancestor-trust.test.ts src/bridgeClient.test.ts src/transcript-replay.test.ts
# cwd: packages/cli
../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/acp-integration/acpAgent.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts src/acp-integration/session/team-sink.test.ts
# cwd: packages/core
../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/agents/team/test-utils/coordination-harness.test.ts src/services/api-user-prompt.test.ts
# cwd: packages/sdk-typescript
../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run test/agent-identity.test.ts
# cwd: packages/web-shell
../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run client/adapters/transcriptToMessages.test.ts client/components/messages/SystemMessage.test.tsx
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

On candidate `435e4f949eca7232c2b48d3a259f5083cb788b8a`, `npm run build` exited 0. The focused package-local Vitest runs passed **3058 tests in 11 test files**: ACP bridge 356, CLI 2246, core 130, SDK 13 and Web Shell 313. These counts come from this split candidate, not the original PR.

Runtime, UI E2E and standalone typecheck were not run. Matched before/after protocol, persistence and UI evidence is not available. The build and focused tests do not establish that all verification obligations are complete; this PR remains a draft and the unresolved feedback below remains open.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Build and focused tests; runtime/UI E2E and standalone typecheck not run |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Local isolated worktree; repository-root build followed by serial package-local Vitest runs.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: notification durability and session-scoped approval lifetime cross queue, recording, bridge and shutdown boundaries. Roster transitions are event-based; there is no current-state snapshot for late attach or reconnect.
- Not validated / out of scope: exact-SHA runtime/UI and cross-platform validation are pending. Observational activity belongs to C. The source's unresolved feedback is retained.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: optional identity/attribution fields and session-scoped teammate permission metadata are added; no transcript migration is introduced.

Inherited unresolved feedback is not fixed by splitting:

- [R8-3: blanket XML escaping changes report/notice envelope fidelity across hosts](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372660).
- [R9-2: team teardown can queue a leader wake for each roster exit](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372667).
- [R9-5: the inserted permission interface changes BridgeClient JSDoc attachment](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372676).
- [R9-7: the abort fake does not reproduce reject-on-abort behavior](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372682).
- [R9-8: detach coverage does not establish that exit handling stays silent](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372686).
- [R9-9: an unoffered permission option can be reported as host failure](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372690).

A's unresolved replay feedback is inherited through the stack; its ownership remains with A.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-10-11-agent-team-identity-projection.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-10-11-agent-team-identity-projection.zh-CN.md). Both documents expand A with coordination decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria and the C follow-up boundary.

## Linked Issues

Related: #13785. Split source: #13902. This PR remains a draft. No automatic issue or PR closure is requested.

Stack links:

- A: [#15657](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15657) — prerequisite.
- B: [#15658](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15658) — this PR.
- C: [#15659](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15659) — depends on B.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

堆叠顺序：**[#15657](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15657) → [#15658](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15658) → [#15659](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15659)**。本 PR 是 **B**，基于 A（`split/13902-agent-identity`，`3294001f39040a668fcbad20045b64e03dc1b6e6`）；以 `split/13902-agent-identity` 为 base。C（`split/13902-teammate-activity`）依赖 B。拆分来源 #13902，固定源提交 `6ed7884c381dfe1c59bd975d6cf61dbb41ef441c`；B 候选为 `435e4f949eca7232c2b48d3a259f5083cb788b8a`。请相对 A 评审 B，以隔离协调层改动。

### 本 PR 做什么

将 ACP-hosted leader 接入 Team 报告、成员变更和队友审批。报告及加入/退出通知携带规范队友身份，进入现有 peer 通知路径，通过录制和重放保留，并在 Web Shell 中标注队友。待处理报告参与 work hold、可逆关闭、队列溢出和关机 flush。

队友审批独立于 leader 权限队列到达 host。会话范围、请求 UUID、binding epoch、所有权检查及 manager 替换或队友退出时的撤回，将审批生命周期绑定到所属会话。B 包含生产者、持久化、bridge、SDK/UI 消费方及配套测试。它消费 A 的共享身份契约，不依赖 subagent 运行时行为。工具活动与 agent 间消息展示由 C 交付。

### 为什么需要

缺少 leader sink 时，ACP-hosted 队友报告保持未读，队友审批事件没有消费方。leader 和客户端需要能传递归因、保存未排空报告并展示队友审批请求的投递路径。

### 评审测试计划

1. 在候选 `435e4f949eca7232c2b48d3a259f5083cb788b8a` 上从仓库根目录运行 `npm run build`，再串行执行英文部分列出的各包命令。每条 Vitest 命令均从标明的包目录执行。
2. 投递队友报告及成员加入/退出，再重载 transcript。确认规范归因、peer 语义和轮次标记关联。覆盖可逆关闭、待处理报告 hold、溢出、重复 flush 及含未排空报告的关机。
3. 保持队友审批未答复，同时让 leader 请求自己的工具审批，确认 leader 请求仍可见。覆盖 host 答复/失败、standalone 策略、会话所有权、manager 重绑定、队友退出及取消；下述继承反馈需另行验证。

**前后证据：**候选 `435e4f949eca7232c2b48d3a259f5083cb788b8a` 的 `npm run build` 退出码为 0。各包目录内的聚焦 Vitest 共通过 **11 个测试文件、3058 项测试**：ACP bridge 356、CLI 2246、core 130、SDK 13、Web Shell 313。这些数字来自本次拆分候选，不是原 PR 的历史结果。

未运行 runtime、UI E2E 或独立 typecheck，也没有匹配的协议、持久化和 UI 前后证据。构建与聚焦测试不代表所有验证义务均已完成；本 PR 保持 draft，下述未解决反馈仍然开放。

**测试平台：**macOS 已执行构建及聚焦测试，未运行 runtime/UI E2E 或独立 typecheck；Windows、Linux 未测试。

**环境：**本地隔离 worktree；从仓库根目录构建，再串行运行各包目录内的 Vitest。

### 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：通知持久性及会话级审批生命周期横跨队列、录制、bridge 和关机边界。成员变更基于事件，晚挂接或重连没有当前状态快照。
- 未验证或范围外：精确 SHA 的运行时/UI 及跨平台验证待完成。观察性活动属于 C。源提交的未解决反馈继续保留。
- 兼容性与迁移：新增可选身份/归因字段及会话级队友审批元数据；没有引入 transcript 迁移。

以下继承的未解决反馈未因拆分而修复：

- [R8-3：完整 XML 转义改变报告/通知 envelope 保真性及跨 host 行为](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372660)。
- [R9-2：Team teardown 可能为每个成员退出排入一次 leader 唤醒](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372667)。
- [R9-5：插入 permission interface 改变 BridgeClient JSDoc 附着](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372676)。
- [R9-7：abort fake 未模拟 reject-on-abort 行为](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372682)。
- [R9-8：detach 测试未证实退出处理保持静默](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372686)。
- [R9-9：未提供的 permission option 可能被报告为 host 失败](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#discussion_r4372372690)。

A 的未解决 replay 反馈也通过堆叠继承，责任归属仍在 A。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-10-11-agent-team-identity-projection.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-10-11-agent-team-identity-projection.zh-CN.md)。两份文档在 A 基础上扩展协调层决策、约束、验收标准及 C 的后续边界。

**关联：**#13785；拆分来源 #13902。本 PR 保持 draft，不请求自动关闭任何 issue 或 PR。

堆叠链接：

- A：[#15657](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15657)，前置依赖。
- B：[#15658](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15658)，本 PR。
- C：[#15659](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15659)，依赖 B。

prs.title: test: settle the two loaded-host waits from #15593
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Both #15593 tests now wait for the write they assert on instead of racing vitest's one-second default. In the gate suite a single `persisted()` accessor in the describe scope awaits the scheduler's background-write chain: it replaces the file's ten repeated double casts into that private field and retires its last persisted-stamp poll — the `enableDurable` catch-up stamp — so no assertion in the file is left on a timeout. The tool-turn suite's command-checkpoint wait was its only bare `vi.waitFor`; its sixteen siblings pass 5 s or 10 s, and it now passes 10 s too.

## Why it's needed

Run 40182849995 (`main` `4b328004`) flipped both on a loaded pool host; neither reproduces on an idle one.

- The tool-turn wait timed out with `expected undefined to be defined`: the turn's append chain had not reached the journal within 1 s.
- The gate read the 10:30 stamp instead of 10:31. Not a scheduling defect — the tick stamps `lastFiredAt` before the gate settles and the persist never regresses — the read just happened too early.

The catch-up poll had the same signal available: `start()` drains the pending catch-up synchronously, so the stamp write is already chained by the time the assertion runs.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Delay the durable write to emulate the loaded host: add `await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1200))` at the top of `updateCronTasks` in `packages/core/src/services/cronTasksFile.ts`, then run the gate probe at `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/services/cronScheduler.gate.test.ts -t 'persists the gate with its downgrade fuse'` — fails on `main` with `expected 1736908140000 to be 1736908260000`, passes here. The catch-up probe is `-t 'stamps a gated catch-up at once'`: on the first commit of this branch both cases fail with `expected 1736895600000 to be 1736908140000`; here both pass, at a 3 s delay too. Revert the probe afterwards.
2. Unmodified, neighbours stay green: `npx vitest run src/services/cronScheduler src/services/cronTasksFile` in `packages/core` (237 tests), `npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-workspace-tool-turn` in `packages/cli` (799).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only, no user-visible behavior.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️ Not tested locally; CI covers Windows |
|  🐧 Linux  |   🟢   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS 26.6 arm64 (Node 22.23.4); Linux in Docker `node:22-bookworm`, kernel 6.8 aarch64, fresh install and build. Typecheck, ESLint and Prettier pass on both.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none to product code; one test may now spend up to 10 s in that wait before failing.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows; the flake class was reproduced only through the delayed write. A checked drain on `CronScheduler` would close the cast seam at the source but touches `packages/core/src/**`, so it belongs in a maintainer-authored follow-up.

auto_merge.commit_title: test: settle the two loaded-host waits from #15593 (#15639)
auto_merge.commit_message:
* test: settle the two loaded-host waits from #15593

The command-checkpoint wait in the tool-turn suite was the only bare
`vi.waitFor` in that file and fell back to vitest's 1 s default, while all
sixteen sibling waits in the same file pass 5 s or 10 s.

The gate suite's persisted-stamp assertions polled under the same 1 s
default. Await the scheduler's own `pendingPersist` instead, as the rest of
that file already does, so the read happens after the write it asserts on
lands, rather than inside a wall-clock budget.

Verified: with the durable write delayed by 1.2 s the old assertion fails
(`expected 1736908140000 to be 1736908260000`, the same shape as the CI
flip); the new one passes at 1.2 s and at 3 s. Both suites are green on
macOS and on Linux under node:22.

* test(core): await the write chain from one seam in the gate suite

Review of #15639 found the file's last 1 s-default poll still standing 44
lines above the hunks: the `enableDurable` catch-up stamp. The signal does
exist there — `start()` drains the pending catch-up synchronously, so the
stamp write is already chained when the poll would have run — so it now
awaits the same chain instead of polling.

The await itself was reaching the private field through a repeated double
cast: ten sites, no compile-time tie to the field. One `persisted()`
accessor in the describe scope replaces all ten, dereferencing the field
per call because it is reassigned on every tracked write.

Acceptance for the converted poll, with the durable write held 1.2 s: the
two catch-up cases fail on the previous commit (`expected 1736895600000
to be 1736908140000`) and pass here. The file's 28 tests and the wider
cron suites (237) are green.

prs.title: feat(web-shell): move archived conversations into Settings
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Implements option 3 from #15549: archived conversations move from the persistent sidebar section into a dedicated **Settings → Archived conversations** category. The Settings content area directly displays the existing archive management UI, preserving workspace groups, standalone and managed archives, session-source filtering, and existing lifecycle actions and restrictions.

Archive catalogs load when the category is opened and refresh on re-entry. The category has no configuration scope tabs or artificial setting count, follows host presentation controls, and remains reachable when archives are available without a local project.

## Why it's needed

Archived conversations are useful but accessed less often than active projects and recent conversations. Giving them a stable management destination in Settings removes a permanent sidebar row while preserving access to archived work.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Open Settings and select **Archived conversations**. Expect the archive list directly in the content area, with existing workspace grouping and no extra dialog or User/Workspace scope tabs. The sidebar should no longer contain an Archived section, including when collapsed.
- Open another Settings category and return. Expect fresh archive data; a previous sidebar search should not hide the archive list. Empty archives should retain the category and show an empty state, and a failed load should offer retry.
- Restore, rename, export and delete supported archived conversations. Expect the same capability restrictions and owning-workspace or standalone routes as before. Also check managed archives where that provider is configured.
- With no local projects but available standalone or managed archives, verify Settings remains reachable. Check English/Chinese labels and desktop/mobile layouts in light/dark themes.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: even collapsed, Archived occupies a permanent row beneath the sidebar conversation lists. Settings has no archive-management category.

After: actual browser captures of the implementation with deterministic archive fixtures:

![Archived conversations in Settings, desktop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deggs7/qwen-code/codex/archived-settings/docs/design/images/archived-settings-desktop.png)

[Mobile screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deggs7/qwen-code/codex/archived-settings/docs/design/images/archived-settings-mobile.png)

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | ✅ Local built daemon, real browser, unit and browser automation |
| Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Final review follow-up: root build, typecheck, bundle and complete lint:ci passed. All 498 Web Shell test files (13,361 tests), 296 focused regression tests, 12 Chromium archive/standalone scenarios and 2 archive visual captures passed. Cold and invalidated archive catalogs now read once per workspace; a real React/store probe and exact browser request assertions verify the ordering. Archive Tasks/Channels controls are independent of active navigation, standalone status is isolated and reset, archive-only Settings omit unavailable model management, and pending restart notices remain visible. Five negative-control groups fail at the intended assertions when their corresponding fixes are removed.

The initial full repository preflight on the preceding head was **not green**: its workspace test phase reported 50 failures outside Web Shell (111,617 passed). Targeted reruns confirm several concurrency/Git-environment failures disappear in isolation, while unrelated backend/runtime assertions remain failing. A separate script-unit run reported 3,675 passed and 25 failures in unchanged CI/release tests; the runtime-download gate timed out. The serve fast-path bundle check passed. Details and remaining limitations are recorded in the separate E2E report. The built-in review runner failed at its API layer without producing a verdict; an independent local review completed and its archive-reachability finding was fixed and reverified.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Settings now includes archive management alongside configuration. Existing archive state and actions retain their owner, and portal mounting controls lazy catalog activation.
- Not validated / out of scope: a live managed backend, Windows/Linux runtime behavior, new read-only archive viewing, and Undo/View archived completion notifications. Managed behavior is covered by the Web Shell unit suite.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: archive management moves to Settings; there is no storage or lifecycle migration. Hosts that disable the sidebar retain their existing lack of archive management. Embedded hosts must expose settings in sidebar.footer.items and add builtin:archived-sessions to existing Settings whitelists; excluding the category deliberately hides its UI. The archive APIs remain available.

Design: [English](https://github.com/deggs7/qwen-code/blob/codex/archived-settings/docs/design/archived-conversations-settings.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/deggs7/qwen-code/blob/codex/archived-settings/docs/design/archived-conversations-settings.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Closes #15549.

prs.title: fix(ci): preserve Maven suite results across cache write-back failures
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR hardens the SDK Java Maven cache path after the suite/write-back lock split. Failed MariaDB suites can still publish downloaded artifacts while preserving the original suite status, cache setup failures preserve the already-known suite result, and the final error annotation identifies the failed Maven stage. Cache seeds report copy failures, tolerate an unavailable cache or failed best-effort prune, and detach mutable resolver metadata before Maven runs. Write-back excludes the same metadata and partial-download files.

## Why it's needed

The lock relocation associated with #15262 already landed on main through #15128 and #15254. This branch is the remaining hardening delta: a failed suite should not throw away reusable downloads, a best-effort cache operation should not replace the suite result, and mutable resolver state should not be published as an immutable shared artifact. The test repair in 11c0f4b2fb12c also includes the deferred-status reporter in extracted shell snippets so those tests can exercise their intended paths.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Fail either Maven stage in the self-hosted MariaDB lane. Reusable downloaded artifacts should reach write-back, later suites should not run, and the step should retain the failed stage's status and annotation.
- Run a green and a failed suite with an unusable cache or missing job-local repository. The cache fault should produce a warning and preserve the suite result.
- Seed a warm cache containing resolver markers and version metadata. Mutable hardlinks should be detached before Maven runs; write-back should publish artifacts while excluding resolver markers, metadata and partial-download files.
- Exercise a cold cache and a seed prune failure. Both should still reach Maven; an actual copy failure should remain visible in the log.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The current base already runs Maven before acquiring the cache lock. On the remaining delta, the prior Linux A/B report found that failed MariaDB runs publish their download delta and retain failure, and that write-back excludes resolver markers. Its seed-prune regression was repaired by restoring best-effort pruning. The latest closeout comment records verification against the exact current head and distinguishes macOS tests from Linux shell witnesses and CI.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Focused workflow guard tests; Linux-only cases skip |
| Linux | See the exact-head closeout evidence and CI links; macOS results are not Linux verification |
| Windows | Not run locally |

## Risk & Scope

The host cache remains best-effort. Failure to seed can increase network resolution. An unexpected bare-flock failure remains fatal. Real Maven resolver behavior and contention on the self-hosted pool require CI evidence beyond shell fixtures.

#15286 contains distinct follow-up work: existing-destination seed nesting, removal of old in-house artifacts from the host cache, self-hosted Checkstyle repository selection, and reference-release cache isolation. Those changes remain separately owned. Shared-helper and test-fixture extraction are deferred rather than widening this repair.

Related to #15262; the original lock relocation is already on main.

prs.title: fix(core): skip memory imports of files already loaded as context files
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a context file imports another file that is itself loaded as a top-level context file (for example `CLAUDE.md` containing `@AGENTS.md` while both are configured context filenames), the import is now skipped instead of expanding the same content a second time. The set of top-level files is computed once, after canonical de-duplication and before the parallel reads, so the result does not depend on batch order: the top-level copy always wins. Imports that reach a top-level file through a different path (for example a symlink) are matched by real path. In tree mode the skipped import is replaced by the existing "File already processed" marker; in flat mode it is omitted. No `include` instruction-loaded notification is emitted for the skipped import.

## Why it's needed

The duplicated content wastes context tokens and repeats instructions to the model, as described in #15679. The existing per-file `processedFiles` guard only covers imports within one file's tree, so sibling top-level files were not protected.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `npx vitest run src/memory/memoryDiscovery.test.ts -t "#15679"` in `packages/core`. The new tests cover tree and flat import modes for a direct `@AGENTS.md` import, a symlinked import of a top-level file, the default context filenames, and the absence of an `include` notification for the skipped import. With the production changes reverted, the 5 new tests fail (content appears twice); with the change applied, all 5 pass.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (non-UI change). Test results on Linux, Node 24:

- New tests, before fix: 5 failed. After fix: 5 passed.
- `packages/core` memory suites (`src/memory`, `memoryImportProcessor.test.ts`): before 1161 passed / 2 failed / 1 skipped; after 1167 passed / 1 failed / 1 skipped. The remaining failure (`formatContextFileDisplayPath` ANSI stripping) fails identically on `main` in this environment; the second baseline failure was a timing-sensitive latency test.
- Full `packages/core` vitest run: before 39389 passed / 15 failed / 18 skipped; after 39395 passed / 14 failed / 18 skipped. All remaining failures also fail on `main` in the same environment (extensionManager, hook-command-cgroup, LspConfigLoader, git-branches, git-worktrees, runtime-boundary bun, formatContextFileDisplayPath) and are unrelated to this change.
- `npm run typecheck`: passes.
- `eslint --max-warnings 0` on `packages/core` and `prettier --check` on the changed files: pass.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only (vitest, Node 24, Linux).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: this picks "the top-level copy wins" when a file is both a top-level context file and an import target; if maintainers prefer the import to win instead, the skip set would need to be applied the other way. This PR touches `memoryImportProcessor.ts`, which is also modified by #15430 (`validateImportPath`); the changes are in different functions but may need a rebase depending on merge order.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS and Windows runs (including case-insensitive path matching on Windows), a scenario with more than 20 context files spanning multiple read batches, and the full `npm run preflight`.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. `readMemoryFiles` is internal and gains a parameter.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15679

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 做了什么

当某个上下文文件导入了另一个本身已作为顶层上下文文件加载的文件时（例如 `CLAUDE.md` 中包含 `@AGENTS.md`，且两者都是已配置的上下文文件名），该导入现在会被跳过，而不再第二次展开相同内容。顶层文件集合在规范化去重之后、并行读取之前只计算一次，因此结果不依赖于批次顺序：始终以顶层副本为准。通过不同路径（例如符号链接）指向顶层文件的导入会按真实路径进行匹配。在 tree 模式下，被跳过的导入会替换为已有的 "File already processed" 标记；在 flat 模式下则直接省略。被跳过的导入不会触发 `include` 类型的指令加载通知。

## 为什么需要

如 #15679 所述，重复的内容会浪费上下文 token，并向模型重复相同的指令。现有的按文件 `processedFiles` 保护只覆盖单个文件导入树内部的导入，无法保护同级的顶层文件。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

在 `packages/core` 中运行 `npx vitest run src/memory/memoryDiscovery.test.ts -t "#15679"`。新增测试覆盖：tree 和 flat 两种导入模式下直接导入 `@AGENTS.md`、通过符号链接导入顶层文件、默认上下文文件名，以及被跳过的导入不产生 `include` 通知。回退生产代码改动后，5 个新测试全部失败（内容出现两次）；应用改动后，5 个测试全部通过。

### 证据（修改前后）

N/A（非 UI 改动）。Linux、Node 24 下的测试结果：

- 新测试：修复前 5 个失败，修复后 5 个通过。

prs.title: fix(core): size the qwen-latest-series invite aliases at 1M
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Teaches the context-window detector to recognize the invite-only `qwen-latest-series-` model aliases as 1M-context models. The series prefix is matched ahead of the Qwen family defaults, with a trailing hyphen so the prefix cannot claim ids that merely share its letters. Nothing else changes: output ceilings, input modalities and model-id normalization are untouched, and the models.dev catalog is still consulted first, so the new rule answers only for ids no upstream source describes and steps aside once the catalog carries one.

## Why it's needed

An id such as `qwen-latest-series-invite-202610-m4` names no model generation that the curated 1M rules key on, and models.dev does not list it, so it fell through to the 256K Qwen family default. The model was then treated as having 262,144 tokens instead of 1,000,000: auto-compaction fired at 222,822 tokens — 22% of the real window — and output requests were sized against the 32K family ceiling. Nothing failed loudly, so the loss showed up only as conversations compacting far earlier than they needed to.

Because the whole series shares the 1M window, a prefix rule also covers later invite codes without another code change, as well as the beta-series spelling that was already in use.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Point an OpenAI-compatible provider at `qwen-latest-series-invite-202610-m4` and run `/context`. The header should read `Context window: 1000.0k tokens`; before this change the same model reported `Context window: 262.1k tokens`. Note that the detector is reached only on the API-key auth paths — Qwen OAuth admits `coder-model` alone and substitutes it before any window is computed, so that auth type is unaffected either way.

At the unit level, from `packages/core`:

```
npx vitest run src/core/tokenLimits.test.ts
```

Both new assertions were checked to redden on their own, one mutant at a time, so neither passes vacuously:

- Removing the new rule: `expected 262144 to be 1000000` on the reported id.
- Dropping the trailing hyphen from the rule (`^qwen-latest-series`): the boundary case reports `expected 1000000 to be 262144`.

The surrounding suites were run as well — `tokenLimits`, `modalityDefaults`, `model-catalog`, `model-catalog-refresh`, `modelConfigResolver` — 314 passed. `prettier --check`, `eslint` and `tsc --noEmit` are clean for the core package.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Not captured against a live endpoint: I have no credentials for this invite-only model, so the before/after below is the window and the thresholds computed from it at the source level, not a terminal capture.

| | Before | After |
| :-- | --: | --: |
| Detected context window | 262,144 | 1,000,000 |
| `/context` header | `262.1k tokens` | `1000.0k tokens` |
| Auto-compaction threshold | 222,822 | 850,000 |
| Hard threshold | 239,144 | 977,000 |

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests plus source-level evaluation of the detector and the threshold computation. No live model endpoint was exercised.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the rule takes the whole series to be 1M, which is maintainer-reported rather than something the code or models.dev can confirm. If a future member of the series ships a smaller window, compaction would fire late and a request could be rejected for length. That stays recoverable — the server's own reported ceiling already shrinks the reactive compaction target — but it costs one failed request. Encoding an internal invite-only naming family in the shared detector is the other tradeoff: an internal catalog mirror served through the existing models.dev URL override would avoid it, at the cost of standing up that mirror.
- Not validated / out of scope: no end-to-end run against the real invite endpoint, for lack of credentials. The output ceiling is deliberately left at the 32K family default, since only the context window was reported. A bare `qwen-latest` is not covered: normalization strips its trailing `-latest`, so no prefix rule can reach it, and changing that shared step would reach catalog keys and modality detection too.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The only ids whose answer changes are those beginning with `qwen-latest-series-`, and only when the catalog has no entry for them.

## Linked Issues

None.

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

让上下文窗口识别逻辑把邀测专用的 `qwen-latest-series-` 系列别名识别为 1M 上下文模型。该系列前缀在 Qwen 家族默认值之前匹配，并带尾部连字符，使这个前缀不会误认那些仅仅字母相同的 id。其余一切不变：输出上限、输入模态与模型 id 归一化都未触及，并且仍然优先查询 models.dev 目录，因此新规则只为那些上游数据源没有描述的 id 作答，一旦目录收录了它们，规则就自动让位。

## 为什么需要

像 `qwen-latest-series-invite-202610-m4` 这样的 id 不含任何可供既有 1M 规则据以判断的型号代际信息，models.dev 也没有收录它，于是它落到了 256K 的 Qwen 家族默认值上。这个模型因此被当作只有 262,144 而非 1,000,000 tokens 来处理：自动压缩在 222,822 tokens 处就触发 —— 只有真实窗口的 22% —— 而输出请求则按 32K 的家族上限设定。没有任何显式报错，所以损失只表现为对话远比必要的时机更早被压缩。

由于整个系列共享 1M 窗口，一条前缀规则还能覆盖后续新的邀测代号而无需再次改码，同样覆盖此前已在使用的 beta 系列拼写。

### 如何验证

单测层面，在 `packages/core` 目录下执行：

```

```

两条新断言都逐一做过变异验证，每次只改一处，确认它们不是空跑通过：

- 移除新规则：报告的 id 上出现 `expected 262144 to be 1000000`。
- 去掉规则的尾部连字符（`^qwen-latest-series`）：边界用例出现 `expected 1000000 to be 262144`。

周边套件也一并跑过 —— `tokenLimits`、`modalityDefaults`、`model-catalog`、`model-catalog-refresh`、`modelConfigResolver` —— 314 项通过。core 包的 `prettier --check`、`eslint` 与 `tsc --noEmit` 均干净。

### 证据（改动前后）

未在真实端点上采集：我没有这个邀测模型的凭据，因此下面的前后对比是在源码层面由窗口值及其推算出的阈值，而不是终端截图。

| | 改动前 | 改动后 |
| :-- | --: | --: |
| 识别出的上下文窗口 | 262,144 | 1,000,000 |
| `/context` 头部 | `262.1k tokens` | `1000.0k tokens` |
| 自动压缩阈值 | 222,822 | 850,000 |
| 硬阈值 | 239,144 | 977,000 |

### 测试环境

|     操作系统     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### 运行环境（可选）

单元测试，加上对识别逻辑与阈值计算的源码层面求值。未调用任何真实模型端点。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：该规则把整个系列都当作 1M，这一点来自维护者的说明，而非代码或 models.dev 所能确认。若该系列将来某个成员的窗口更小，压缩就会触发过晚，请求可能因长度被拒。这种情况仍可恢复 —— 服务端自己报出的上限已经会收缩反应式压缩的目标值 —— 但代价是一次失败请求。另一个权衡是把内部邀测命名族写进共享的识别逻辑：通过既有的 models.dev URL 覆盖项提供一个内部目录镜像可以避开这一点，代价是要把那个镜像建起来。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：没有对真实邀测端点做端到端运行，原因是缺少凭据。输出上限有意保留在 32K 的家族默认值上，因为此次只报告了上下文窗口。裸 `qwen-latest` 不在覆盖范围内：归一化会剥掉它尾部的 `-latest`，因此任何前缀规则都到不了它，而改动那个共享步骤还会波及目录键与模态识别。

prs.title: test(cli): pin pid liveness in the review cleanup unlink case
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Pins process liveness in the one orphan-reap case of the review cleanup suite that trusted a hardcoded pid to be absent from the host's process table. The case now stubs the liveness probe for the duration of the sweep, using the same helper as two sibling orphan cases in the same block, so the fixture's "this launcher is dead" premise is a fact of the test instead of an assumption about the machine it runs on.

## Why it's needed

`Main CI failed: Qwen Code CI — src/commands/review/cleanup.test.ts > … > keeps the run alive when the post-kill UNLINK fails` (#15737, [run 40547925273](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40547925273)) is not a defect in the unlink guard it is meant to pin. The case builds an orphan socket named for pid `626262` and never stubs `process.kill`, so when a busy runner happens to have a process at that pid the sweep correctly treats the socket as alive, skips it, and reports `Nothing to clean for target "local"` — an output that reads exactly like the guard under test having been removed. Giving the same fixture a pid that is certainly resident reproduces that CI output on an otherwise green tree, and the pinned fixture passes under the same condition.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the suite (`cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/commands/review/cleanup.test.ts`) and confirm 109 tests pass. To see the failure this prevents, rename the fixture in that one case to a pid you know is alive (for example `process.pid`) and drop the new wrapper: the case then fails with `"Nothing to clean for target \"local\"."` instead of the assertion about the reaped line. Restoring the wrapper makes it pass with the same resident pid.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before — old assertion, fixture pid made resident:

```
× runCleanup > orphaned capture-tui servers > keeps the run alive when the post-kill UNLINK fails 9ms
+   "Nothing to clean for target \"local\".",
      Tests  1 failed | 108 skipped (109)
```

After — pinned probe, same resident fixture pid:

```
✓ src/commands/review/cleanup.test.ts (109 tests | 108 skipped) 4ms
      Tests  1 passed | 108 skipped (109)
```

Full file after the change: 109 passed.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

A local worktree of `main` at `9acb3a5a1d68a`, installed with `corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and built with `npm run build`; unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none for product code; the change is confined to one test case and only replaces an assumption about the host's pid space with an explicit stub.
- Not validated / out of scope: the Windows and Linux lanes were not run locally. The enclosing block is `describe.skipIf(process.platform === 'win32')`, so only the POSIX lanes execute this case.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Closes #15737

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

给 review cleanup 测试里唯一一个依赖"写死的 pid 在宿主机上不存在"的孤儿进程用例补上存活探针的桩。该用例现在在一次扫描期间固定 `process.kill` 的返回，复用同一代码块里另外两个孤儿用例使用的 helper，于是"这个启动器已经死了"从对运行机器的假设变成测试自己给出的事实。

## 为什么需要

`Main CI failed: Qwen Code CI — src/commands/review/cleanup.test.ts > … > keeps the run alive when the post-kill UNLINK fails`（#15737，[run 40547925273](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40547925273)）并不是它想要守住的那段 unlink 兜底逻辑的缺陷。该用例构造了一个以 `626262` 命名的孤儿 socket，却从未桩掉 `process.kill`；当繁忙的 runner 上恰好存在这个 pid 时，扫描会正确地把它判为存活并跳过，最后打印 `Nothing to clean for target "local"`——这个输出看起来和"兜底被删掉"一模一样。把这个用例的固定 pid 换成一个必然存活的 pid，就能在其它测试全绿的工作区里复现出同一行 CI 输出；而在同样的条件下，固定存活探针之后用例就能通过。

## 评审方式

运行该测试文件（`cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/commands/review/cleanup.test.ts`），确认 109 个用例全部通过。如果想看到它防止的失败，把该用例的固定 pid 换成一个你确定存活的 pid（例如 `process.pid`）并去掉新加的包装：用例会以 `"Nothing to clean for target \"local\"."` 失败，而不是关于 reap 输出的断言失败；把包装加回来后，在同一个存活 pid 下就会通过。

## 证据（修改前后）

修改前——旧断言，固定 pid 恰好存活：

```
× runCleanup > orphaned capture-tui servers > keeps the run alive when the post-kill UNLINK fails 9ms
+   "Nothing to clean for target \"local\".",
      Tests  1 failed | 108 skipped (109)
```

```
✓ src/commands/review/cleanup.test.ts (109 tests | 108 skipped) 4ms
      Tests  1 passed | 108 skipped (109)
```

修改后整份文件：109 个用例通过。

## 本地验证范围

本地在 `main`（`9acb3a5a1d68a`）的独立工作区里用 `corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` 安装、`npm run build` 构建，只跑了单元测试。Windows 与 Linux 两条 lane 未在本地运行；该代码块是 `describe.skipIf(process.platform === 'win32')`，只有 POSIX lane 会执行这个用例。

## 风险与范围

只改一个测试用例，不涉及产品代码；把对宿主机 pid 空间的假设换成显式桩，没有其它影响。

Closes #15737

prs.title: feat: project agent identity and Agent Team delivery onto the ACP/daemon wire (refs #13785)
prs.body:
## What this PR does Projects agent identity and Agent Team coordination onto the ACP/daemon wire, in two deliberately distinct collaboration columns. Subagent column (parent→child delegation): every projected subagent frame (thought, message, tool call, tool call update) now carries `_meta.agent = { agentName, depth, kind }` with a path-style name (`/root/general-purpose`), mirroring OpenAI Responses' per-item `agent` identity; the Web Shell keeps that path on the subagent panel name as a `title` tooltip only — no visible path chip ships in this slice (`SubAgentPanel.tsx:345`; pinned by `SubAgentPanel.test.tsx` `keeps the path on the name title without rendering it as a chip`). `agentName` is a readable role path, not a unique execution id: concurrent same-type subagents share it, and renaming the agent definition changes it. `parentToolCallId` distinguishes subagent executions; that boundary is documented on both the producer and the normalizer. Agent Team column (peer complete agents): an ACP-hosted session now attaches a leader sink (`team-sink.ts`). Before this, `TeamManager.pollLeaderInbox()` returned before consuming on this host (teammate reports stayed unread in the leader inbox) and `TEAMMATE_APPROVAL_REQUEST` was void-emitted — the coordination never reached anyone. Now teammate reports are delivered as `peer` background notifications carrying structured sender identity (`kind: 'teammate'`, minted from the inbox entry's `from`, never parsed from message text), roster joins/exits are projected as peer notifications so an already-attached client can track membership transitions (there is no current-state snapshot for late attach or reconnect), and teammate tool approvals route to the client's `requestPermission` (fail-closed: Cancel plus a `` to the leader when the host cannot answer; YOLO auto-approve only when the request carries no renderable details). ## Why it's needed #13785 records the gap: the public vocabulary names child agents and teams, but nothing a client receives says which agent produced what. Both reference protocols (OpenAI Responses multi-agent, Anthropic Managed Agents) treat agent identity as contractual. This slice delivers the identity dimension on the daemon/ACP projection and removes the "ACP host has no leader sink" failure class — the zero-signal class among the three host classes in #13785 M4 — giving M1b a reference wire shape. Peer delivery reuses core's existing `'peer'` background-notification channel (idle wake, loss accounting, kind-agnostic drain/display), without a new peer runtime. Team-binding approval retirement now uses one private, versioned `qwen/notify/session/teammate-binding-ended` notification on the existing SDK 0.14.1 connection; it adds no daemon REST route or public mediator API. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify At `3499b027c4faa`, 2,106 focused cases, targeted ESLint/Prettier, five affected workspace typechecks and integration typecheck passed on the exact committed candidate. Approval retirement, status identity, activity isolation and canonical START behavior were mutation-checked. A serialized ACP component probe verified old-binding cancellation and replacement approval at cap 1; a local macOS browser rendered the real transcript pipeline with injected protocol frames without splitting leader output or taking its usage. Main was synchronized to supply the current CI budget helper; obsolete assistant-activity handling was removed, and the rebuilt transcript's size ceiling was **raised** from 1,338,000 (main) to 1,340,000 in `packages/web-shell/client/build-artifact.test.ts` — merged with main the entry measures 1,338,274 UTF-16 units, past both main's ceiling and the 1,338,500 this branch carried. See the [current repair report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#issuecomment-6192665587) for build results and verification limits. No real-provider or full daemon/browser E2E was run for this repair. The [real-model report and screenshots at `df760052100d1`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#issuecomment-6138227209) and the runtime observations below are historical evidence, not current-head acceptance. Real machine: boot the daemon from this branch with `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_AGENT_TEAM=1 node scripts/dev.js serve --port

--token --workspace

`, create a session, send a team prompt (`team_create`, then spawn teammate `correctness` asking it to report one sentence ending in a marker). Expected and observed on SSE: peer notifications `teammate-roster-1` (status joined) and `teammate-message-2/3`, each carrying `_meta.agent={"agentName":"/root/correctness","depth":1,"kind":"teammate"}`, plus leader-reply frames with `source=background_notification_response`; the same capture contains zero subagent-column frames. Contrast run without a team: 47 `parentToolCallId`-chained frames carrying `kind:'subagent'` and zero peer markers — the two columns are mutually attributable at a glance. The Web Shell rendered the peer rows (`ⓘ … · peer`) and the verbatim teammate report in a real headless Chromium against the same daemon. ### Evidence (Before & After) Before: on this host an ACP session with a team delivered 0 teammate reports (retained unread in the leader inbox) and emitted 0 approval signals; no projected object carried any agent identity. After: the SSE markers and browser rendering described above. ### Tested on (earlier runtime acceptance) | OS | Status | | :--------: | :-------------: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ not tested | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ tested | ### Environment (optional) Linux host; daemon via `node scripts/dev.js serve` (no bundle step); headless Chromium (playwright) for Web Shell rendering; unit suites via vitest with `env -u QWEN_CODE_SERVE -u QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR`. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: identity is additive `_meta`; older readers ignore it. Teammate identity is minted only for single-sender batches — mixed-sender batches stay unattributed rather than misattributed. Status/idle team events are deliberately not projected (each would wake the leader into an automatic turn). Join/exit notifications are incremental, so a client that attaches late still needs a non-waking roster snapshot/query before it can claim authoritative current membership. - Not validated / out of scope: managed-agent public-contract projections (#13785 M1a/M2/M3) and client intervention verbs (M4) remain design surfaces; foreground nested subagents do not project their own frames today (verified on real machine: single `parentToolCallId` layer, depth values only 1), so depth ≥ 2 identity has no wire producer yet — nested trees remain record-projection work (M1a); cross-session teammate projection is M1b/M3. Mailbox consumption and model-visible delivery are not transactional; crash-safe redelivery after process/session destruction remains follow-up work, and reversible-close retention does not provide that guarantee. - Breaking changes / migration notes: identity fields are additive. Approval retirement requires this CLI/bridge pair; older bridges that ignore the new private notification retain the previous stale-approval behavior. No new daemon REST routes, public mediator APIs, dependencies or persisted formats. ## Linked Issues Refs #13785 (referenced without a closing keyword: the public-contract milestones remain open design work).
中文说明 ## 本 PR 做了什么 把 agent 身份与 Agent Team 协调投影到 ACP/daemon 的 wire 上，分为刻意保持区分的两条协作列。 subagent 列（父子委派）：每个投影出的 subagent 帧（thought、message、tool call、tool call update）现在都带 `_meta.agent = { agentName, depth, kind }`，名字为 path 风格（`/root/general-purpose`），与 OpenAI Responses 的逐 item `agent` 身份同形；Web Shell 本片只把该 path 挂在 subagent 面板名字的 `title` tooltip 上，不渲染可见的 path chip（`SubAgentPanel.tsx:345`；由 `SubAgentPanel.test.tsx` 的 `keeps the path on the name title without rendering it as a chip` 钉住）。`agentName` 是可读的角色 path，并不是唯一执行 ID：同类型并发 subagent 会共享它，agent 定义改名也会改变它；`parentToolCallId` 用于区分 subagent 执行，这一边界在生产侧与 normalizer 两侧都有文档。 Agent Team 列（对等完整 agent）：ACP 托管会话现在会挂一个 leader sink（`team-sink.ts`）。在此之前，本宿主上 `TeamManager.pollLeaderInbox()` 会在消费前早退（队员报告留在 leader inbox 里未读），`TEAMMATE_APPROVAL_REQUEST` 空 emit——协调过程到不了任何人手里。现在队员报告以 `peer` 背景通知投递，带结构化发送者身份（`kind: 'teammate'`，从 inbox 条目的 `from` 铸造，绝不从消息文本解析）；roster 的加入/退出投影为 peer 通知，已挂载的客户端可跟踪成员变化（晚挂载或重连时没有当前状态快照）；队员的工具审批路由到客户端 `requestPermission`（fail-closed：宿主无法应答时 Cancel 并向 leader 注入 ``；仅当请求不带可渲染细节且处于 YOLO 时才自动批准）。 ## 为什么需要 #13785 记录了缺口：公共词表里有 child agent 与 team，但客户端收到的任何东西都不说明「哪条输出是哪个 agent 产的」。两个参照协议（OpenAI Responses multi-agent、Anthropic Managed Agents）都把 agent 身份当契约内容。本片在 daemon/ACP 投影侧交付身份维度，并消掉「ACP 宿主没有 leader sink」这一失效类——即 #13785 M4 三类宿主中的零信号类——为 M1b 给出参考 wire 形状。peer 投递复用 core 既有的 `'peer'` 背景通知通道（空闲唤醒、丢失记账、kind 无关的 drain/display），不增加 peer runtime。队绑定审批回收新增一条私有、版本化的 `qwen/notify/session/teammate-binding-ended` 通知，走既有 SDK 0.14.1 连接；不添加 daemon REST 路由或 public mediator API。 ## 评审测试计划 ### 如何验证 `3499b027c4faa` 的精确提交候选通过 2,106 条聚焦用例、定向 ESLint/Prettier、五个相关 workspace 的类型检查和 integration 类型检查；审批回收、status 身份、活动隔离与 START canonical 行为做过变异反证。真实 ACP 串行化组件链路以 cap 1 验证旧绑定取消和新绑定审批；本地 macOS 浏览器通过真实 transcript 流水线渲染注入的协议帧，leader 答案与 usage 未被活动切断或夺走。已同步 main 补齐当前 CI 预算脚本，并删除旧 assistant 活动路径；重建 transcript 的体积阈值是**上调**的——由 main 的 1,338,000 提到 `packages/web-shell/client/build-artifact.test.ts` 里的 1,340,000，因为与 main 合并后该 entry 实测 1,338,274 UTF-16 单位，同时超出 main 的阈值和本分支此前携带的 1,338,500。构建结果与验证限制见[本轮修复报告](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#issuecomment-6192665587)。本轮未跑真实模型或完整 daemon/browser E2E。[`df760052100d1` 的真实模型报告与截图](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#issuecomment-6138227209)及下方真机记录仅为历史证据，不作为当前 head 验收。 真机：从本分支起 daemon（`QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_AGENT_TEAM=1 node scripts/dev.js serve --port

--token --workspace

`），建会话，发 team prompt（`team_create`，再派 teammate `correctness` 要求其回一句以 marker 结尾的话）。SSE 上期望并实测到：peer 通知 `teammate-roster-1`（status joined）与 `teammate-message-2/3`，均带 `_meta.agent={"agentName":"/root/correctness","depth":1,"kind":"teammate"}`，以及 `source=background_notification_response` 的 leader 回话帧；同一抓帧中 subagent 列帧为零。不带 team 的对照跑：47 帧 `parentToolCallId` 链帧带 `kind:'subagent'`、peer 标记零命中——两列形状互斥、可一眼归因。Web Shell 在真 headless Chromium 中对同一 daemon 渲染出了 peer 行（`ⓘ … · peer`）与队员原话。 ### 证据（Before & After） Before：本宿主上带 team 的 ACP 会话投递 0 条队员报告（留在 leader inbox 未读）、0 个审批信号；任何投影对象都不带 agent 身份。After：上述 SSE 标记与浏览器渲染。 ### Tested on（较早版本的真机验收） | OS | Status | | :--------: | :-------------: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未测试 | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ 已测试 | ### 环境（可选） Linux 宿主机；daemon 走 `node scripts/dev.js serve`（无 bundle 步骤）；Web Shell 渲染用 headless Chromium（playwright）；单测走 vitest 并加 `env -u QWEN_CODE_SERVE -u QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR`。 ## 风险与范围 - 主要风险或权衡：身份是 additive `_meta`，旧读者会忽略它。teammate 身份只为单发送者批次铸造——混合发送者批次宁可无身份也不张冠李戴。status/idle 队事件刻意不投影（每条都会唤醒 leader 起一个自动 turn）。加入/退出通知是增量流，晚挂载客户端仍需要一个不会唤醒 leader 的 roster 快照/查询，才能声称拿到了权威当前成员表。 - 未验证 / 超出范围：managed-agent 公共契约投影（#13785 M1a/M2/M3）与客户端干预动词（M4）仍是设计面；foreground 嵌套 subagent 今天不投影自身帧（真机验过：parentToolCallId 仅一层、depth 取值仅 1），故 depth ≥ 2 身份暂无 wire 生产者——嵌套树仍是记录投影工作（M1a）；跨 session 的 teammate 投影属 M1b/M3。mailbox 消费与模型可见投递不是事务；进程崩溃或会话销毁后的安全重投递留到后续，可逆 close 时保留队列不构成这一保证。 - 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：身份字段为 additive。审批回收需要本轮配套 CLI/bridge；忽略新增私有通知的旧 bridge 仍保留此前的陈旧审批行为。不添加 daemon REST 路由、public mediator API、依赖或持久化格式。 ## 关联 Issue Refs #13785（不用 closing 关键字引用：公共契约里程碑仍是开放的设计工作）。

prs.title: fix(ci): keep sdk-java resolver bookkeeping and in-house jars out of the host cache (#15281)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The job-local Maven repository that the sdk-java suites resolve from no longer shares mutable inodes with the host cache:

- Every seed site drops `maven-metadata-local.xml` together with the other resolver bookkeeping names (`_remote.repositories`, `resolver-status.properties`, `*.lastUpdated`, `*.tmp`), so the unlocked Maven runs cannot rewrite a host-cache file through a seeded hardlink.
- The locked write-back removes the two in-house fixed-release coordinates from the host cache, prunes them at any depth rather than only at the repository root, publishes only job-produced files (the same five names stay job-local), and downgrades a failed cache-directory creation to a warning instead of reddening a green suite.
- The self-hosted Managed Agent Checkstyle leg resolves the SDK from the job-local repository the suite installed it into.
- The release builder's seed copies into the job-local repository instead of nesting a second `repository/` inside it, and drops the same bookkeeping names.
- The workflow meta-tests pin the five exclusions at every seed and both prunes, the write-back's children and their fd 9 closure, the host-side removal, the warning path, and the Checkstyle repository.

## Why it's needed

Moving Maven above the per-host lock is only safe while the job-local repository has no inode in common with the host cache. Maven's resolver rewrites its bookkeeping files in place, and the suites `install` two fixed-release in-house artifacts: seeded as hardlinks, both let an unlocked run mutate state that every sibling job on the host reads.

Correction to the earlier description: the lock-scope change itself ("only the write-back takes the lock") landed through #15128 and #15254 and is already on main. #15274 remains open with overlapping cache and deferred-status changes. This PR is the cache-isolation half that makes that scope safe, and it is judged on that, not on the lock wait from #15281.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Open the `SDK Java (fast) / ubuntu-latest / Java 21` job of a PR that touches a managed-agent path. The self-hosted step should show the `cp -aln` seed and all three Maven invocations before any `Waiting for the sdk-java host lock` line; the lock wait should appear only at the cache write-back, and the write-back should remove the in-house coordinates before copying. Grep the job-local repository for `maven-metadata-local.xml` after the suite: it should hold only job-produced files.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: a seeded `maven-metadata-local.xml` and a seeded `qwencode-sdk` jar were the same inode as the host cache, so the unlocked `mvn install` changed the host file (same inode, SHA and mtime both moved). After: the host file is byte- and mtime-identical while the job-local copy is still written, the write-back publishes zero bookkeeping files and never the in-house coordinates, and the host cache loses the pre-PR in-house trees. N/A for UI.

### Tested on

|     OS     |                       Status                        |
| :--------: | :-------------------------------------------------: |
|  🍏 macOS  |                   ⚠️ not tested                    |
| 🪟 Windows |                   ⚠️ not tested                    |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ meta-tests, size baseline, lint, Prettier        |

### Environment (optional)

Meta-tests only: `scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js` (129 passed), `scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js` (239 passed, 1 skipped), `scripts/tests/sdk-java-lock.test.js` (14 passed). No JDK 21 / Maven in this container, so the real Java suite is left to CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a cold host pays the seed cost once, and the write-back is best-effort and capped at 300 seconds, matching the MariaDB lane. The write-back also deletes pre-existing in-house copies from the host cache — intended, because they are the stale fixed-release jars the in-house prune exists to stop publishing.
- Not validated / out of scope: the real ECS pool and its ticketed lock queue; the full JDK 21 Maven suite; the MySQL / MariaDB integration lanes; the hosted legs.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

Design documents: [English](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Related to #15281 (the lock-scope change landed through #15128 and #15254; this PR closes the cache-isolation gap that the smaller lock scope depends on).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

sdk-java 套件解析所使用的 job 本地 Maven 仓库，不再与宿主缓存共享可写 inode：

- 每个播种站点在删除其他解析器记账文件（`_remote.repositories`、`resolver-status.properties`、`*.lastUpdated`、`*.tmp`）的同时也删除 `maven-metadata-local.xml`，因此不持锁的 Maven 运行无法穿透播种的硬链接改写宿主缓存。
- 持锁的写回会在宿主缓存中删除两个内部固定发布坐标，按任意深度 prune 而不只匹配仓库根，只发布本 job 产生的文件（同样五个名字留在 job 本地），并把缓存目录创建失败降级为警告，而不是让绿色套件变红。
- self-hosted 的 Managed Agent Checkstyle leg 从套件安装到的 job 本地仓库解析 SDK。
- 发布构建的播种改为向 job 本地仓库内复制，而不是在其中再嵌套一个 `repository/`，并删除同样的记账文件。
- 工作流元测试钉住每个播种点与两处 prune 的五个排除名、写回子进程及其 fd 9 关闭、宿主侧删除、警告路径，以及 Checkstyle 的仓库。

## 为什么需要

把 Maven 移到池级锁之外，只有在 job 本地仓库与宿主缓存没有共同 inode 时才是安全的。Maven 解析器会原地重写记账文件，而套件会 `install` 两个固定发布坐标的内部构件：一旦以硬链接播种，二者都会让不持锁的运行改写同宿主上所有兄弟 job 都读取的状态。

对早先描述的更正：持锁范围的改动本身（“只有写回取锁”）已通过 #15128 和 #15254 落地并在 main 上。#15274 仍然开放，其中缓存和延后状态处理的改动与本 PR 有重叠。本 PR 是让该范围安全成立的缓存隔离部分，评审应以这一点为准，而不是 #15281 的锁等待。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

打开一个触及 managed-agent 路径的 PR 的 `SDK Java (fast) / ubuntu-latest / Java 21` job。self-hosted step 应先出现 `cp -aln` 播种和三次 Maven 调用，之后才可能出现 `Waiting for the sdk-java host lock`；锁等待只应出现在缓存写回处，且写回会先删除内部坐标再复制。套件结束后在 job 本地仓库里 grep `maven-metadata-local.xml`，应当只剩本 job 产生的文件。

### 证据（Before & After）

Before：播种出的 `maven-metadata-local.xml` 与 `qwencode-sdk` jar 与宿主缓存是同一 inode，不持锁的 `mvn install` 会改写宿主文件（inode 相同，SHA 与 mtime 都变化）。After：宿主文件字节与 mtime 完全不变，同时 job 本地副本仍被写入；写回不发布任何记账文件、也从不发布内部坐标；宿主缓存中遗留的内部目录被删除。UI 不适用。

### 测试环境

仅元测试：`scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js`（129 通过）、`scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js`（239 通过、1 跳过）、`scripts/tests/sdk-java-lock.test.js`（14 通过）。容器内没有 JDK 21 / Maven，真实 Java 套件交给 CI。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险与取舍：冷宿主要付一次播种成本；写回是尽力而为且上限 300 秒，与 MariaDB 通道一致。写回还会删除宿主缓存中遗留的内部坐标副本——这是有意为之，因为它们正是内部坐标 prune 要阻止继续发布的过期固定发布 jar。
- 未验证 / 范围外：真实 ECS 池及其票据化锁队列；完整 JDK 21 Maven 套件；MySQL / MariaDB 集成通道；hosted leg。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 issue

与 #15281 相关（持锁范围的改动已通过 #15128 和 #15254 落地；本 PR 补上更小持锁范围所依赖的缓存隔离缺口）。

</details>

prs.title: feat: add hybrid code mode
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a Codex-aligned `tools.mode` enum with `direct`, `code_mode`, and `code_mode_only`. `code_mode` keeps ordinary tools directly callable while also exposing the isolated `exec` JavaScript tool; each visible ordinary tool carries its nested JavaScript declaration, while `exec` retains compact `ALL_TOOLS` metadata. `code_mode_only` preserves the strict exec-only ordinary-tool surface, and `direct` remains the default.

Updates filtered subagent tool surfaces so direct declarations and nested exec bindings honor the same allowlists, exposes the enum in Settings as Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only, regenerates the settings JSON schema, and removes the former `tools.codeModeOnly` boolean setting entirely.

Adds synchronized [English](docs/design/code-mode.md) and [Chinese](docs/design/code-mode.zh-CN.md) design documents, and brings the existing CodeModeOnly design up to the repository's bilingual documentation standard ([English](docs/design/code-mode-only.md), [Chinese](docs/design/code-mode-only.zh-CN.md)).

## Why it's needed

Qwen Code previously offered only the default direct tool surface or the strict CodeModeOnly surface. Models could not combine direct calls for simple operations with `exec` orchestration for multi-tool workflows. A three-value enum matches Codex's `ToolMode` naming and gives users one explicit setting for all supported exposure modes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Leave `tools.mode` unset or set it to `direct`, restart Qwen Code, and confirm ordinary tools remain available while `exec` is absent.
2. Set `tools.mode` to `code_mode`, restart, and confirm both ordinary tools and `exec` are available. Confirm ordinary tool descriptions include their `tools.<name>(args)` declaration and deferred tools remain discoverable through `tool_search`.
3. Set `tools.mode` to `code_mode_only`, restart, and confirm ordinary tools are available through `exec` rather than as top-level calls, while direct control tools remain available.
4. Open Settings and confirm Tool Mode cycles among Default, Code Mode, and Code Mode Only. Confirm `tools.codeModeOnly` is no longer present in the settings schema.
5. Start with `--safe-mode` or `--bare` while either code mode is configured and confirm the effective mode is `direct`.

Automated verification completed: focused Core tests (121 tests), focused CLI tests (585 tests), a repeated settings-schema regression run (60 tests), full build, full typecheck, full lint, and both installed and branch-built CLI version smoke checks.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: Settings exposed `Code Mode Only (Experimental)` as a boolean with `false` / `true`.

After: Settings exposes `Tool Mode (Experimental)` as an enum displaying Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only. Updated TUI snapshots cover the default display.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Node.js v24.18.0; local source build and package-level Vitest suites.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Hybrid mode adds a short nested-call declaration to each ordinary tool description, increasing prompt size slightly; complete schemas are not duplicated in the `exec` description.
- Not validated / out of scope: Live-provider interactive runs and Windows/Linux local execution were not tested; CI covers supported platforms.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: `tools.codeModeOnly` is removed. Replace `{ "tools": { "codeModeOnly": true } }` with `{ "tools": { "mode": "code_mode_only" } }`.

## Linked Issues

Related to #10377.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增与 Codex 对齐的 `tools.mode` 枚举，支持 `direct`、`code_mode` 和 `code_mode_only`。`code_mode` 在保留普通工具直接调用能力的同时提供隔离的 `exec` JavaScript 工具；每个可见普通工具会携带自己的嵌套 JavaScript 声明，而 `exec` 保留精简的 `ALL_TOOLS` 元数据。`code_mode_only` 保持严格的普通工具仅经 `exec` 调用模式，`direct` 仍为默认值。

更新经过过滤的子智能体工具面，使直接声明和 `exec` 嵌套 binding 遵守同一组 allowlist；在设置界面中将该枚举显示为 Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only；重新生成 settings JSON schema；并彻底移除原来的 `tools.codeModeOnly` 布尔设置。

新增同步的[英文](docs/design/code-mode.md)和[中文](docs/design/code-mode.zh-CN.md)设计文档，并将现有 CodeModeOnly 设计补齐为仓库要求的双语文档（[英文](docs/design/code-mode-only.md)、[中文](docs/design/code-mode-only.zh-CN.md)）。

## 为什么需要

Qwen Code 此前只提供默认的直接工具面或严格的 CodeModeOnly 工具面。模型无法在简单操作中使用直接调用，同时在多工具工作流中使用 `exec` 编排。三值枚举与 Codex 的 `ToolMode` 命名一致，并为所有支持的暴露模式提供一个明确的统一设置项。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 不设置 `tools.mode` 或将其设为 `direct`，重启 Qwen Code，确认普通工具仍可用且不存在 `exec`。
2. 将 `tools.mode` 设为 `code_mode` 并重启，确认普通工具和 `exec` 同时可用；确认普通工具描述包含各自的 `tools.<name>(args)` 声明，延迟工具仍可通过 `tool_search` 发现。
3. 将 `tools.mode` 设为 `code_mode_only` 并重启，确认普通工具通过 `exec` 而不是顶层调用使用，同时直接控制工具仍然可用。
4. 打开设置界面，确认 Tool Mode 可在 Default、Code Mode 和 Code Mode Only 之间切换，并确认 settings schema 中不再存在 `tools.codeModeOnly`。
5. 配置任一 code mode 后用 `--safe-mode` 或 `--bare` 启动，确认有效模式为 `direct`。

已完成自动化验证：Core 相关测试（121 个）、CLI 相关测试（585 个）、再次运行的 settings schema 回归测试（60 个）、完整 build、完整 typecheck、完整 lint，以及已安装版本和分支构建版本的 CLI 版本 smoke 检查。

### 前后对比证据

之前：设置界面以 `false` / `true` 布尔值展示 `Code Mode Only (Experimental)`。

之后：设置界面以枚举展示 `Tool Mode (Experimental)`，可选 Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only。更新后的 TUI snapshot 覆盖默认显示。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |

prs.title: fix(release): use the job token for the publish checkout
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The release publish job's checkout now uses the job's automatic GitHub token instead of the bot PAT. The PAT remains on the two steps that need it: pushing the release branch and creating the GitHub release, both of which re-authenticate explicitly.

## Why it's needed

The v0.26.2 release run failed at the first `Checkout` step of `Publish Release` with `could not read Username for 'https://github.com': terminal prompts disabled` (three fetch attempts, git exit 128). A re-run of the same commit checked out successfully, and the v0.26.2-preview.1 publish job hit the same failure about 40 minutes earlier. The publish checkout was the only release checkout that supplied `secrets.CI_BOT_PAT`, while also setting `persist-credentials: false`; the push step re-authenticates on its own. A read-only checkout therefore had a secret dependency it never used, and a transient auth failure at that point aborted the release before any work ran.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the focused scripts suites and the size gate: `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/package-scripts.test.js scripts/tests/release-workflow.test.js` and `bash .github/scripts/check-workflow-size.sh`. Both should pass. To see the new pin work, temporarily add `token: '${{ secrets.CI_BOT_PAT }}'` back to the publish checkout and rerun the first command: the assertion `expect(checkoutStep).not.toContain('CI_BOT_PAT')` fails. Remove it and the suite returns to green. On the next release run, confirm the publish checkout succeeds and that the release branch is still pushed by the bot PAT (that step is unchanged).

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the publish checkout passed `token: secrets.CI_BOT_PAT`, and a checkout auth failure aborted the release at step 3 (the public run annotations show `could not read Username`). After: the checkout uses the action's default `github.token`; the PAT is supplied only to the push and release-creation steps.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux sandbox, Node.js 22.23.2, pnpm 11.24.0 via corepack. The GitHub-hosted release environment cannot be reproduced locally.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: nothing in the job relied on the checkout's PAT. `persist-credentials: false` is set, the job token has `contents: write`, and every later authenticated operation supplies the PAT explicitly. The push and release-creation steps are unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: the exact hosted-runner environment; the next release run is the end-to-end check.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15727
