prs.title: fix(cli): forward workflow switches into the CLI sandbox (#15740)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The whole-CLI sandbox relaunch forwards a curated whitelist of environment variables into the container. This PR adds the workflow enable/disable switches to that whitelist so a sandboxed CLI honors the operator's exported workflow policy instead of reading only the mounted settings.

## Why it's needed

`QWEN_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS=1` is the documented kill switch for Workflow mode. When the CLI relaunches into a Docker sandbox, the inner process did not see the variable, so `--workflow-mode on` was accepted and the kill switch was silently ignored. The regression surfaced as the two `rejects unavailable on before any provider request` cases failing only in the Docker lane; forwarding the switches makes the existing integration test pass without weakening it.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

On a host with Docker:

1. Run `QWEN_SANDBOX=docker npx vitest run --root ./integration-tests cli/workflow-mode.test.ts`. The two `rejects unavailable on before any provider request` cases (`legacy` and `shared`) should pass.
2. Alternatively, run the focused unit test and confirm the prepared `docker run` arguments include `--env QWEN_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS=1`.

Expected: the sandboxed CLI rejects `--workflow-mode on` before any provider request. Before this change it accepted the mode because the inner process could not see the kill switch.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the two Docker-lane cases failed because the inner CLI never saw `QWEN_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS`; the E2E failure issue #15739 lists both loop variants by name.
After: the sandbox whitelist forwards both workflow switches, and the unit test pins the generated `--env` arguments and fails when the entries are removed.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local agent sandbox: `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, and the focused Vitest file. No Docker daemon is available in that sandbox, so the Docker integration lane was not run locally.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the sandbox now forwards two more operator environment variables. Both only affect the Workflow feature; neither grants filesystem or network access.
- Not validated / out of scope: other `QWEN_CODE_*` switches (for example the cron kill switch) are not forwarded; this PR only fixes the workflow pair needed by the failing test and its documented counterpart.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15740

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

整个 CLI 的沙箱重启会向容器转发一组精选的环境变量。本 PR 把 Workflow 的启用/禁用开关加入该白名单，使沙箱内的 CLI 遵守运维导出的 Workflow 策略，而不是只读取挂载的设置。

## 为什么需要它

`QWEN_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS=1` 是 Workflow mode 的文档化 kill switch。当 CLI 重启进入 Docker 沙箱时，容器内的进程看不到该变量，因此 `--workflow-mode on` 被接受，kill switch 被静默忽略。该回归表现为两个 `rejects unavailable on before any provider request` 用例仅在 Docker 流水线中失败；转发这些开关后，现有集成测试无需弱化即可通过。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

在具备 Docker 的主机上：

1. 运行 `QWEN_SANDBOX=docker npx vitest run --root ./integration-tests cli/workflow-mode.test.ts`。两个 `rejects unavailable on before any provider request` 用例（`legacy` 和 `shared`）应通过。
2. 或者运行定向单元测试，确认生成的 `docker run` 参数包含 `--env QWEN_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS=1`。

预期：沙箱内的 CLI 在发出任何 provider 请求前拒绝 `--workflow-mode on`。在此更改之前，由于容器内进程看不到 kill switch，该模式会被接受。

### 证据（更改前与更改后）

更改前：两个 Docker 流水线用例失败，因为容器内的 CLI 看不到 `QWEN_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS`；E2E 失败 issue #15739 按名称列出了两个循环变体。
更改后：沙箱白名单转发两个 Workflow 开关，单元测试钉住生成的 `--env` 参数，并在删除条目时失败。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

本地 agent 沙箱：`npm run build`、`npm run typecheck`、`npm run lint` 以及定向 Vitest 文件。该沙箱没有 Docker 守护进程，因此未在本地运行 Docker 集成流水线。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：沙箱现在多转发两个运维环境变量。二者都只影响 Workflow 功能，不会授予文件系统或网络访问权限。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：其它 `QWEN_CODE_*` 开关（例如 cron 的 kill switch）未转发；本 PR 只修复失败测试及其文档化对应项所需的 Workflow 开关对。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #15740

## What this PR does

Aligns the selected sidebar, shared session-creation, workspace overview, dialog and Memory scope labels to use **Workspace / 工作区** and **Session / 会话**: the sidebar's Project heading becomes Workspaces, ordinary New task actions become New session, and the workspace Memory scope uses the same noun. Existing add/rename/remove dialog copy and session-creation errors are aligned in English and Chinese.

Executable production changes are limited to values of existing translation keys; public JSDoc comments are also synchronized with the visible labels. Existing tests only update their displayed-text selectors/expectations, and the adapter documentation records the terminology. No identifiers, translation keys, component structure, APIs, storage, or runtime logic are renamed or refactored.

This is a scoped copy pass, not a product-wide terminology migration. Existing Managed-page and registration copy, the session-source Tasks tab, execution/offline hints and other feature scope labels retain their current wording. Label-derived accessible names and dialog DOM attribute values carry the new text; automation matching old labels must update its selectors.

## Why it's needed

The sidebar currently calls the same directory-backed object Project in its heading and Workspace in its actions, while ordinary conversation creation says New task. This implements the final Workspace/Session vocabulary recorded in #14988 with a small copy-only change.

prs.title: feat(serve): batch workspace session live-state snapshots
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds one read-only request for complete live-session snapshots from 1–20 explicitly selected registered workspaces. Each workspace keeps its own canonical identity, catalog version, and independent success or error result. The new request shares the existing single-workspace snapshot and catalog-cache reconciliation logic. A distinct capability and TypeScript SDK method let clients opt in with cancellation and timeout support.

## Why it's needed

Clients showing several workspaces currently make one live-state HTTP request per workspace on every refresh. The recently added batch session catalog can read persisted history, so it is not a suitable high-frequency execution-state endpoint. This API lets clients fetch the same authoritative in-memory state in one request, while preserving the existing single-workspace route and per-session SSE.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Start a local daemon with a primary workspace, register a trusted secondary workspace, then send one batch request containing both IDs and an unknown selector. Expect two full snapshots and one explicit `workspace_not_found` member in input order, with `Cache-Control: no-store`. Confirm malformed bodies fail with HTTP 400, an untrusted or transitioning workspace fails only its own member, and the capability is advertised. Change a live session between running, waiting, and idle without advancing its catalog version; every batch snapshot should still reflect the current state. Confirm the SDK makes one authenticated native REST request and preserves abort and timeout behavior. Older daemons should continue to use the single-workspace route after callers preflight capabilities.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (HTTP and SDK change; no TUI change). The local daemon returned two workspace snapshots and one explicit unknown-workspace error in a single POST.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ Build, typecheck, bundle, focused tests, and local HTTP E2E passed; the large server test file showed unrelated intermittent failures |
| 🪟 Windows | Not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ `dev` x86_64: frozen install/build/bundle, typecheck, focused tests, and daemon HTTP E2E passed |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.1 on macOS arm64 and `dev` Linux x86_64, each with an isolated daemon on a dynamically assigned loopback port. The global `qwen` binary was unavailable for the pre-change CLI dry-run; the absence of this route was confirmed in the current base source.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: A batch is not atomic across workspaces. Each successful member is capped at 512 KiB and an oversized member gets an explicit error.
- Not validated / out of scope: Web Shell still polls workspaces separately until a client migration adopts the new capability; no model-driven live session was created in the HTTP E2E. Windows was not tested locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. Clients preflight `workspace_session_live_state_batch` and retain the existing single-workspace path for older daemons.

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): name a message-less row failure in the scan summary (#15700 item 4)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

One item from #15700's deferred list: the scanner's bounded failure summary now names the exception class when a non-first row failure carries no message. Previously such a row rendered as `failure=null`, with no class and no other record anywhere, because the summary is the only place an additional row failure is reported.

## Why it's needed

#15632 replaced unbounded per-row stacks with one bounded summary. The sample it keeps is the only record of every failure except the first — so a message-less exception was recorded as the literal string `failure=null`, which identifies neither the row's cause nor its type. That is the one item in the deferred list that loses information rather than merely formatting it differently.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Non-UI. The change is confined to the sample string construction:

- With the previous wording, a tick where the second row throws a message-less `IllegalStateException` logs `failure=null`; with this change it logs `failure=java.lang.IllegalStateException`.
- Failures that do carry a message keep their existing rendering, so the summary format for the common case is unchanged.

`aMessageLessRowFailureKeepsItsIdentityInTheSummary` pins both halves, and I confirmed it fails against the unpatched construction (the assertion on `failure=` sees `null`) and passes after; `commonClaimFailuresProduceOneBoundedSummary` still passes unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI. Before (reverted hunk, same test): `sample=[… failure=claim store down, … failure=null]`; after: `failure=java.lang.IllegalStateException`. Local: both summary tests green, Checkstyle 0 violations.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

OpenJDK 21, Maven 3.10.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: only a diagnostics string changes; the counting and severity semantics of the summary are untouched, and the other eight deferred items in #15700 stay deferred.
- Not validated / out of scope: no MySQL or Hosted profile involvement; no behavior change for any non-logging path.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Log text for message-carrying failures is unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Refs #15700 — item 4 only; the other eight deferred suggestions stay deferred.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

处理 #15700 延后清单中的一项：扫描器的有界失败汇总，在非首个行失败没有 message 时改为记录异常类名。此前这种情况会渲染成 `failure=null`，既没有类名、也没有任何其它记录——因为汇总正是额外行失败唯一的记录位置。

## 为什么需要

### 如何验证

非 UI。改动仅限样本字符串构造：

- 用旧写法时，第二个行抛无 message 的 `IllegalStateException`，日志为 `failure=null`；改动后为 `failure=java.lang.IllegalStateException`。

`aMessageLessRowFailureKeepsItsIdentityInTheSummary` 同时钉住这两半；我验证过它在未修复的写法下失败（`failure=` 处为 `null`）、修复后通过；`commonClaimFailuresProduceOneBoundedSummary` 不受影响仍通过。

prs.title: docs(managed-agent): decide the shared-Session queue and correct the pool comment (#15667)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Closes #15667 with the decision it asked for plus the comment correction. The row-pool design now records that gated definitions sharing a Session are deliberately not serialized by the pool: their fires queue in that Session's funnel, the later one can lose its 30 s relay answer and is re-driven without running twice, and in a Harness pool that lost answer can also drop the Harness from selection until its next refresh (#15666). The decision is "intended", with guidance to give a slow-probed gated definition its own Session. Separately, the scanner's class comment no longer claims a slow gated fire never stalls every definition on the node — that holds within a tick, not across the tick boundary the join creates.

## Why it's needed

#15667 named two residues of the row pool. The first needed a maintainer verdict rather than code: the mechanism is a consequence of the funnel being serial per Session, and serializing rows per Session inside the scanner would not remove it, because the funnel is shared with public relays and with other nodes. The second was a comment that overstated what the join allows: `fixedDelay` starts the next tick only after the slowest row returns, so one slow row still delays every definition the node works. Both are now written down where the next reader will look.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Documentation and one production comment; no behavior changes. What a reviewer should confirm:

- The decision paragraph matches the mechanism described by #15667 and the gate design's §10, and its guidance is actionable (one gated definition per Session when its probe is slow).
- The class comment matches `tick()`: rows run concurrently within a tick, and the join plus `fixedDelay` still makes the slowest row delay the next tick.
- Nothing else in the file changed: `git diff` on the Java file is comment-only.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no runtime behavior changes. Local: module compiles, Checkstyle 0 violations, both design files pass Prettier.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

OpenJDK 21, Maven 3.10.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none code-wise; the decision accepts a queueing window on shared Sessions in exchange for not adding per-Session grouping that could not remove the cross-node/public-relay queue anyway.
- Not validated / out of scope: no reproduction rig was built for the queueing case; the mechanism is documented from the code paths named in #15667, and the 409 face stays with #15666.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15667

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

按 #15667 的要求给出决定，并修正一处注释。行线程池的设计文档现在记录：共享同一 Session 的带闸门定义，线程池刻意不串行化——它们的 fire 会在该 Session 的 funnel 中排队，后一个可能丢掉 30 秒中继应答，但会被重新驱动且不会重复运行；在 Harness 池中，这次丢失的应答还可能让该 Harness 退出选择，直到下一次刷新（#15666）。决定为「预期语义」，并给出「探针较慢的带闸门定义单独使用一个 Session」的运维建议。另外，扫描器类注释不再声称一个慢速带闸门 fire 不会拖慢节点上的任何定义——这在一次 tick 内成立，但跨不过 join 造成的 tick 边界。

## 为什么需要

#15667 点出线程池的两项遗留。第一项需要维护者裁定而不是代码：该机制是「funnel 按 Session 串行」的结果，而在扫描器内按 Session 串行化也无法消除它，因为 funnel 与公共中继、其它节点共享。第二项是一处过度声明的注释：`fixedDelay` 要等最慢的行返回才开始下一次 tick，因此一个慢行仍会拖慢该节点上所有定义。两处现在都写在下一个读者会看的位置。

## 评审者验证计划

### 如何验证

文档 + 一处生产注释，无行为变更。评审者应确认：

- 决定段与 #15667、闸门设计 §10 描述的机制一致，且建议可执行（探针慢的带闸门定义单独一个 Session）。
- 类注释与 `tick()` 一致：行在一次 tick 内并发，join 加 `fixedDelay` 仍会让最慢的行推迟下一次 tick。
- Java 文件除注释外无其它改动：对该文件跑 `git diff` 可见仅注释。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A —— 无运行时行为变化。本地：模块编译通过，Checkstyle 0 违规，两份设计文档 Prettier 通过。

### 测试平台

macOS ✅；Windows / Linux：N/A。

### 环境（可选）

OpenJDK 21、Maven 3.10。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：代码层面无。该决定接受共享 Session 上的排队窗口，以换取不引入按 Session 分组——后者本也消除不了跨节点与公共中继的排队。
- 未验证 / 不在范围：没有为排队场景搭建复现 rig；机制依据 #15667 点名的代码路径记录，409 那一面留给 #15666。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #15667

</details>

prs.title: feat(cli): enable LSP through a user-scoped setting and env pair
prs.body:
## What this PR does Adds a supported way to turn the experimental LSP code-intelligence service on without a command line flag: a new Tools setting, readable from the user, system and system-defaults layers only, plus a matching environment variable pair where the disable switch beats the enable switch beats the setting. All three entrances feed one subsystem through a single resolver, so precedence cannot drift between surfaces. Workspace-scoped values are ignored, because turning LSP on lets a session spawn language servers with the user's own permissions, and the repository's per-workspace settings file is not an authorization surface. The daemon now consults the same resolver when it decides whether a session may run on a paired managed engine host, for every workspace runtime it owns, instead of relying only on a flag forwarded through its own argument list. Previously the flag-forwarding path was reachable from only one of the daemon's two start-up paths, so a settings-enabled daemon could certify a session as engine-compatible while that session really did start language servers under the user's permissions. Finally, an embedding host can refuse LSP for a configuration it owns and never uses the service for. The existing way of expressing that refusal (passing the flag as off) stopped meaning "off" as soon as a second entrance existed, so the refusal is now a runtime-only policy a host sets when it constructs a configuration; three internal configurations that exist only to discover MCP servers, run one hosted model turn or run one hook operation now refuse it, instead of each starting and never stopping a full set of language servers. ## Why it's needed The LSP feature already works inside the daemon, but the only documented entrance is a flag, and the clients that would benefit most from code intelligence are exactly the ones that cannot pass it: the Desktop client builds the daemon's argument list itself, and any other host that embeds the Web Shell does the same. Users of those clients therefore had no path to go-to-definition, find-references, hover, diagnostics or code actions even though the capability was shipped, and the slash command for it was not even registered for them. This is the opt-in channel requested in #14507, not a general availability change: the feature stays labelled experimental and stays off by default. The shape follows the precedent the triage of that issue pointed at — the dynamic-workflows setting — including both halves of its safety pairing that a maintainer asked not to lose: an operator kill switch that wins regardless of how the feature was enabled, and a project environment file that cannot enable the feature or clear that kill switch. ## Review follow-up Round 1 found three host-owned Configs that would start language servers under the new setting, plus a safe-mode gap. That revision guarded the pre-sandbox authentication config and the hosted workflow turn, refused LSP in safe mode, published the Web Shell alias and zh-CN strings the panel requires, moved the row to the **Experimental** group while keeping the `tools.lspEnabled` key, and recorded the enablement contract in `docs/design/2026-10-19-lsp-enablement-entrances.md`. Round 2 found that the daemon's cached per-runtime answer still went stale on paths that never reload, so this revision deletes the cache: `evaluateManagedCompatibility` now applies the same resolver to the settings snapshot and effective environment it already reads, with the forwarded flag as the argv entrance. It also closes the LSP env denylist gaps (`BASH_ENV`, `ENV`, `npm_config_node_options`), corrects the trust and env-provenance wording, documents safe mode, and pins the remaining guards in tests. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify Set the new Tools setting to true in the user settings file, with no command line flag, and start an agent session. Expected: the LSP service is constructed and started once for the session, the status slash command reports it enabled, and the per-session status route returns enabled with servers for a workspace that declares them. With the setting unset, expected behavior is unchanged from before: no service, no servers, status reports disabled. Then export the disable variable and repeat with both the setting and the flag on: expected is off, and the disable switch also wins over the enable variable. Confirm a workspace-level settings file cannot turn the feature on: the value is stripped before settings are merged and the user is warned that it was ignored. Confirm the same for a checked-out repository's environment file and its settings environment block: neither can enable the feature nor clear the kill switch. For the daemon behavior, start the daemon with the setting on in a configuration that pairs a workspace runtime with a managed engine host and confirm the compatibility evaluation defers the session instead of certifying it, which is what keeps a settings-enabled session from being routed to an engine that does not account for language servers. Confirm this holds for the plain daemon start command, which is the path the Desktop client uses, not only for the path that parses full command line options — that asymmetry is the defect this change removes. For the refusal policy, trigger workspace MCP discovery or a hosted model turn with the setting on and confirm no language server is spawned for those internal configurations, while an ordinary session in the same workspace still gets the service. The same must hold for a hosted workflow turn, the pre-sandbox authentication config and the read-only command-parity probe, and a session started with `--safe-mode` (or `QWEN_CODE_SAFE_MODE=1`) must resolve LSP off even with the setting on. ### Evidence (Before & After) Before: enablement was derivable only from a flag, the sandbox-compatibility guard and the status command saw a different answer than the daemon's engine check did, and internal per-turn configurations started language servers they could never use. After: one resolver answers for every surface and every host mode that refuses the service, including an explicit host refusal, and the engine check consults the same answer per runtime. Unit evidence is in the branch: the resolver's precedence (kill switch over flag, enable variable and setting), the setting enabling the service with no flag at all, the kill switch overriding both, the execution-sandbox refusal triggering for a settings-enabled entrance rather than only a flagged one, the host refusal keeping the service off while the setting is on, the workspace value being stripped with a warning, and the managed-engine check deferring on the setting entrance. The attached screenshot is the Web Shell settings panel served by this branch's own build: the new row sits in the **Experimental** group, switched on and marked *Modified in User*, which is the flow this request asked for. The setting key stays `tools.lspEnabled`, so its path still names the capability it enables. No new interface was added — the panel renders the row from the same schema entry as its neighbors, and the released build has no such row to photograph, which is the reported gap itself. Measured on the same machine: same workspace (whose `.lsp.json` declares a Roslyn server), same operator-scoped `{"tools":{"lspEnabled":true}}`, same daemon argv, **no** `--experimental-lsp`, and no prompt was sent — the service is constructed while the session's configuration is built, which is what creating a session triggers, so these runs requested no inference. Released desktop build `0.25.2`, which cannot contain this change: ``` GET /session/63a5da82-d56b-4d24-97f5-fa6d676fc46a/lsp {"v":1,"sessionId":"63a5da82-…","workspaceCwd":"C:\\Repository","enabled":false,"configuredServers":0,"readyServers":0,"failedServers":0,"inProgressServers":0,"notStartedServers":0,"servers":[]} ``` This branch (`npm run build && npm run bundle`), same operator-scoped file and nothing else: ``` GET /session/066b80f9-672d-4e59-b480-3bcb46a87d9f/lsp {"v":1,"sessionId":"066b80f9-…","workspaceCwd":"C:\\Repository","enabled":true,"configuredServers":1,"readyServers":1,"failedServers":0,"inProgressServers":0,"notStartedServers":0,"servers":[{"name":"…\\Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.LanguageServer.exe","status":"READY","languages":["csharp"],"transport":"stdio"}]} ``` The user layer is confirmed separately by the screenshot and by session `db143f06-1fbf-435c-b185-19a15b3d9977`, which returned the same `enabled: true` with `readyServers: 1` after the row was switched on in the panel. The daemon's own view of the panel row, `GET /workspace/settings`, reports `"requiresRestart":true,"default":false,"values":{"effective":true,"user":true}`; with `--require-auth` (the Desktop argv shape) `GET /health` answered `401` without the bearer and `200` with it on both builds. ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ not tested | | 🪟 Windows | ✅ tested | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested | ### Environment (optional) Unit tests, type check, lint and formatting checks on the local workspace; dependency install and workspace build restored to a clean state before running them. No live end-to-end daemon run against a paired managed engine host, and no run inside the packaged Desktop client (see Risk & Scope). ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: a persistent user-level setting now enables a subsystem that starts processes with the user's permissions, for every workspace that user later opens. The mitigations are deliberate: no workspace scope, environment files of a project cannot opt in or opt out, the sandbox and read-only/remote/provisional/bare host modes still refuse it, hosts can refuse it outright for internal configurations, and the value is read at startup only so it cannot flip a running session. - Not validated / out of scope: no live Desktop-client or paired-engine daemon run, so those paths rest on unit-level coverage of the decision itself; the per-runtime capability advertisement used by the workflows precedent is deliberately not added here, so the daemon reports LSP through the compatibility check rather than a new field in the public capabilities payload; LSP teardown in `Config.shutdown` is left untouched, so a daemon-spawned session's language servers live until process exit — it is tracked in #14751 rather than folded into a change that would widen the core `LspClient` interface; a duplicated guard in the startup path that still reads only the flag, the stale hint text of the status command, and a narrower denylist whose deferral note assumed the flag was the only entrance remain follow-ups; `docs/design/hot-reload/lsp-runtime-reinitialization.md` still describes the flag as the only enablement switch, and correcting it obligates creating its missing Simplified Chinese counterpart in full, so that is a separate docs change. - Breaking changes / migration notes: `--safe-mode` / `QWEN_CODE_SAFE_MODE=1` and `--bare` now refuse LSP even when `--experimental-lsp` is also passed, because those modes distrust the workspace content that declares the servers. Otherwise the new setting defaults to off and existing flag behavior is unchanged. The generated settings schema in this branch is byte-identical to what the generator produces from it; four pre-existing failures in an unrelated large integration suite reproduce identically at the base commit of this branch on Windows and are not caused by this change. ## Linked Issues Refs #14507
中文说明 ## 本 PR 做了什么 新增一种受支持的、无需命令行参数即可启用实验性 LSP 代码智能服务的途径：一项新的 Tools 配置，仅从用户层、系统层与系统默认层读取，并配套一对环境变量，其中禁用开关优先于启用变量、启用变量优先于配置项。三个入口经由同一个解析函数进入同一子系统，因此各表面的优先级不会漂移。工作区层的取值会被忽略，因为开启 LSP 会让会话以用户自身权限启动语言服务器，而仓库内的按工作区设置文件并不是授权表面。 守护进程现在在判定某会话能否运行于配对的非托管引擎宿主时，也 consult 同一个解析函数，并且覆盖它所持有的每一个工作区运行时，而不再仅依赖经由自身参数列表转发的开关。此前转发开关的路径只在守护进程两条启动路径中的一条上可达，因此一个通过配置启用 LSP 的守护进程可能把会话认证为“引擎兼容”，而该会话确实正在以用户权限启动语言服务器。 最后，宿主可以对它自己拥有、且永不使用该服务的配置显式拒绝 LSP。原先表达拒绝的方式（把开关传为 false）在出现第二个入口后不再等于“关闭”，因此拒绝改为运行时策略，仅由构造该配置的宿主设置；三处内部配置（只为发现 MCP 服务器、只为跑一次宿主模型轮次、只为跑一次钩子操作）现在会拒绝 LSP，而不再各自启动一套完整语言服务器且永不停止。 ## 为什么需要 LSP 能力在守护进程内已经可用，但唯一有文档的入口是命令行参数，而最需要代码智能的客户端恰恰无法传参：Desktop 客户端自行构造守护进程参数列表，其他内嵌 Web Shell 的宿主也是如此。于是这些客户端的用户即使功能已发布，也无法获得跳转定义、查找引用、悬浮提示、诊断与代码操作，连相应的斜杠命令都不会为他们注册。这正是 #14507 所请求的“opt-in 通道”，并非正式发布变更：该功能仍标记为实验性，仍默认关闭。 整体形态遵循该 issue 分诊时指出的先例——动态 Workflow 配置项——并完整保留维护者特别要求不要丢掉的两个安全配对：无论以何种方式启用都优先生效的运维者禁用开关，以及项目环境文件既不能开启该功能、也不能清除该禁用开关。 ## 评审者验证计划 ### 如何验证 在用户设置文件中把新的 Tools 配置置为 true，且不带任何命令行参数，启动一个智能体会话。预期：为该会话构造并启动一次 LSP 服务，状态斜杠命令报告其为启用，且对声明了服务器的 workspace，按会话状态路由返回 enabled 并带服务器列表。未设置该项时行为与之前一致：无服务、无服务器、状态报告为禁用。随后导出禁用环境变量，并在配置项与参数同时开启的情况下重复：预期为关闭，且禁用变量同样压过启用变量。确认工作区级设置文件无法开启该功能：该值在设置合并前被剥离，并提示用户它被忽略。对检出仓库的环境文件及其设置环境块作同样确认：两者都不能开启该功能，也不能清除禁用开关。 关于守护进程行为：在“把某工作区运行时与配对的非托管引擎宿主相连”的配置下，以该项开启的状态启动守护进程，确认兼容性判定将该会话置为延后而非认证通过，这正是防止“启用语言服务器的会话被路由到并不考虑语言服务器的引擎”的机制。请确认该行为对普通守护进程启动命令同样成立（Desktop 客户端走的就是这条路径），而不是仅对解析完整命令行参数的路径成立——这一不对称正是本变更消除的缺陷。 关于拒绝策略：在该项开启的情况下触发工作区 MCP 发现或一次宿主模型轮次，确认这些内部配置不会 spawn 语言服务器；同一 workspace 的普通会话仍能获得该服务。同样必须对 hosted workflow turn、沙箱前置鉴权 Config 与只读命令 parity 探针成立；以 `--safe-mode`（或 `QWEN_CODE_SAFE_MODE=1`）启动的会话即使该项为真也必须解析为关闭。 ## 评审后续 第一轮评审发现三处宿主自有 Config 会在新设置下启动语言服务器，另有一处 safe 模式缺口。该次修订让沙箱前置鉴权 Config 与 hosted workflow turn 获得相同的 `lspDisabled` 拒绝，在 safe 模式下拒绝 LSP，补齐面板要求的 Web Shell 别名与 zh-CN 文案，把该行归入 **Experimental** 分组而保留 `tools.lspEnabled` 键，并把启用契约记录在 `docs/design/2026-10-19-lsp-enablement-entrances.md`。 第二轮评审发现守护进程缓存的按 runtime 判定在那些不会触发 reload 的路径上仍会过期，因此本次修订删除了该缓存：`evaluateManagedCompatibility` 直接对它已经读取的设置快照与有效环境应用同一个解析函数，并把转发的 flag 作为 argv 入口。同时还补齐了 LSP env denylist 的缺口（`BASH_ENV`、`ENV`、`npm_config_node_options`），修正了信任与 env 来源的措辞，记录了 safe 模式，并用测试固定了其余守卫。 ### 证据（前后对比） 变更前：启用与否只能由参数推导；沙箱兼容性守卫与状态命令看到的答案和守护进程引擎判定看到的答案不一致；内部逐轮配置会启动它们永远用不到的语言服务器。变更后：一个解析函数为所有表面、以及所有仍拒绝该服务的宿主模式给出答案（包含宿主的显式拒绝），引擎判定按运行时 consult 同一答案。 单元层面证据已在分支中：解析函数的优先级（禁用开关压过参数、启用变量与配置项）、仅有配置项而无参数时启用服务、禁用开关压过其余全部入口、沙箱执行守卫对“配置项入口”同样触发拒绝而非仅对参数入口、宿主拒绝时即使配置项为真仍保持关闭、工作区取值被剥离并给出警告、非托管引擎检查在配置项入口下延后。所附截图是由本分支自身构建提供的 Web Shell 设置面板：新行归入 **Experimental** 分组，处于开启状态并标注 *Modified in User*，正是该请求所要的流程。键仍为 `tools.lspEnabled`，因此其路径依然点名所启用的能力。并未新增任何界面——面板用与相邻项相同的机制渲染该行；而已发布版本根本没有该行可截，这本身就是所报告的缺口。 在同一台机器上实测：同一 workspace（其 `.lsp.json` 声明 Roslyn 服务器）、同一运维级 `{"tools":{"lspEnabled":true}}`、同一守护进程参数形式、**不带** `--experimental-lsp`、未发送任何 prompt（服务在会话配置构造期间建立，即创建会话时触发），因此这些运行没有发起任何推理请求。已发布 desktop 版本 `0.25.2`（不可能包含本变更）： ``` GET /session/63a5da82-d56b-4d24-97f5-fa6d676fc46a/lsp {"v":1,"sessionId":"63a5da82-…","workspaceCwd":"C:\\Repository","enabled":false,"configuredServers":0,"readyServers":0,"failedServers":0,"inProgressServers":0,"notStartedServers":0,"servers":[]} ``` 本分支（`npm run build && npm run bundle`），同样只有运维级文件： ``` GET /session/066b80f9-672d-4e59-b480-3bcb46a87d9f/lsp {"v":1,"sessionId":"066b80f9-…","workspaceCwd":"C:\\Repository","enabled":true,"configuredServers":1,"readyServers":1,"failedServers":0,"inProgressServers":0,"notStartedServers":0,"servers":[{"name":"…\\Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.LanguageServer.exe","status":"READY","languages":["csharp"],"transport":"stdio"}]} ``` 用户层单独由截图与会话 `db143f06-1fbf-435c-b185-19a15b3d9977` 佐证：在面板中打开该行后，它返回同样的 `enabled: true` 与 `readyServers: 1`。 守护进程对该行的视图 `GET /workspace/settings` 报告 `"requiresRestart":true,"default":false,"values":{"effective":true,"user":true}`；在 `--require-auth`（Desktop 参数形式）下，两个版本的 `GET /health` 无 bearer 时返回 `401`、带 bearer 时返回 `200`。 ### 测试环境 | OS | 状态 | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未测试 | | 🪟 Windows | ✅ 已测试 | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试 | ### 本地运行环境（可选） 在本地工作区执行单元测试、类型检查、lint 与格式检查；执行前已将依赖安装与工作区构建恢复到干净状态。未针对配对非托管引擎宿主做真实端到端守护进程运行，也未在打包后的 Desktop 客户端内运行（见“风险与范围”）。 ## 风险与范围 - 主要风险与权衡：一项持久的用户级配置现在会为“该用户之后打开的每一个 workspace”启用会以其权限启动进程的子系统。缓解措施是明确的：不提供工作区作用域，项目环境文件既不能 opt-in 也不能 opt-out，沙箱以及只读/远程/临时/bare 宿主模式仍然拒绝，宿主可对内部配置直接拒绝，且取值只在启动时读取，因此无法翻转一个正在运行的会话。 - 未验证 / 超出范围：没有真实的 Desktop 客户端或配对引擎守护进程端到端运行，这些路径依赖对判定本身的单元覆盖；有意不引入非托管引擎 workflows 先例所用的按运行时能力广播，因此守护进程通过兼容性检查而非公共能力负载中的新字段来反映 LSP；`Config.shutdown` 中的 LSP 拆除未动，因此守护进程 spawn 的会话其语言服务器会存活到进程退出——该项在 #14751 中跟踪，而不并入一个会扩宽 core `LspClient` 接口的变更；启动路径中仍只读参数的重复守卫、状态命令里过时的提示文案，以及一条其延后理由曾假定“参数是唯一入口”的更窄 denylist 仍为后续项；`docs/design/hot-reload/lsp-runtime-reinitialization.md` 仍把参数描述为唯一启用开关，而修正它就必须补齐其缺失的完整简体中文对应版本，因此该项另起纯文档变更。 - 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：`--safe-mode` / `QWEN_CODE_SAFE_MODE=1` 与 `--bare` 现在即使同时传入 `--experimental-lsp` 也会拒绝 LSP，因为这些模式不信任声明服务器的工作区内容。除此之外，新配置默认关闭，既有参数行为不变。本分支中生成的设置 schema 与生成器输出逐字节一致；一个无关的大型集成套件中有四个既有失败，在本分支基线提交上于 Windows 同样复现，与本变更无关。 ## 关联 issue Refs #14507
--- ## Appendix — raw transcript of the measured run Daemon start, this branch (`node dist/cli.js serve --hostname 127.0.0.1 --workspace C:\Repository --no-open`, with `QWEN_CODE_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH` pointing at `{"tools":{"lspEnabled":true}}`): ``` qwen serve listening on http://127.0.0.1:4170 (mode=http-bridge, workspace=C:\Repository) qwen serve: Web Shell UI served from C:\Repository\qwen-code\dist\web-shell qwen serve: --require-auth enabled (bearer token mandatory on every route, including loopback /health). qwen serve: startup timing: processToListenMs=1339 runQwenServeToListenMs=1109 ``` Session creation on each build (no prompt was sent afterwards): ``` POST /session {"cwd":"C:\\Repository"} → 0.25.2 {"sessionId":"63a5da82-d56b-4d24-97f5-fa6d676fc46a","workspaceCwd":"C:\\Repository","attached":false,"clientId":"client_18d4f9f9-920b-4306-bbca-c4cb18b2fb36","createdAt":"2026-10-18T19:15:53.438Z"} POST /session {"cwd":"C:\\Repository"} → this branch {"sessionId":"066b80f9-672d-4e59-b480-3bcb46a87d9f","workspaceCwd":"C:\\Repository","attached":false,"clientId":"client_d833b1d9-9a3e-4d8b-9425-9749c400a55d","createdAt":"2026-10-18T19:15:02.071Z"} ``` The panel row as the daemon serves it, `GET /workspace/settings` (this branch): ``` {"key":"tools.lspEnabled","type":"boolean","label":"LSP Code Intelligence","category":"Tools", "description":"Enable the LSP (Language Server Protocol) code-intelligence service without the `--experimental-lsp` flag: go-to-definition, find-references, hover, symbols, diagnostics and code actions. Off by default. Servers still start only for a language declared by a trusted workspace `.lsp.json` or by an enabled extension, and they run with your user permissions. The QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_LSP=1 and QWEN_CODE_DISABLE_LSP=1 environment variables override this setting (disable wins).", "requiresRestart":true,"default":false,"values":{"effective":true,"user":true}} ``` Two limits of this evidence, stated plainly: the `before` build has no row to photograph, so its half of the pair is the JSON only; and the `values.user` above became `true` because the panel itself wrote the key into the user settings file when the row was switched on for the screenshot — the `before`/`after` comparison above was taken with the operator-scoped file only, so both sides saw the same input. ## 附录 — 原始记录 上表 `values.user` 为 `true`，是因为截图时在面板中打开该行、面板自身把该键写入了用户设置文件；而“前后对比”的两个测量都只使用运维级文件，因此两侧输入一致。`before` 版本没有可截的界面行，故其一半证据只有 JSON。

prs.title: fix(core): keep MCP tools when a server returns duplicate names
prs.body:
## What this PR does

MCP tool discovery now keeps the first declaration of a duplicated tool name instead of letting the whole server's tool list collapse. The names that were skipped are written to the debug log together with the server name.

## Why it's needed

A server that lists two tools with the same name (the reporter's Unity MCP server emits several `create` entries because it drops the command group from the tool name) made discovery fail entirely: `@google/genai` throws `Duplicate function name ... found in MCP tools` while converting the whole `tools/list` result, the error is folded into an empty tool list, and the caller then reports the misleading `No prompts, tools, or resources found on the server.` Every other tool of that server became unusable, and the health-check reconnect repeated the same failure on every attempt.

Dropping only the colliding declarations is the part the client can do on its own: the server is the one violating the spec by reusing names, and the model cannot call two distinct tools under one name anyway. Keeping the rest turns a completely unusable server into a partially usable one.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Point Qwen Code at an MCP server that lists two tools with the same name plus at least one other tool. Before: the server contributes no tools and the log shows the duplicate error followed by `No prompts, tools, or resources found on the server.` After: the unique tools are registered and the debug log (`--debug`) names the skipped duplicates.
2. Run `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/tools/mcp-client.test.ts`. The new case `keeps the first tool of a duplicated name instead of discarding the server` fails on `main` (`expected [] to deeply equal [ 'create', 'other' ]`) and passes with this change; the file is 167/167 green afterwards.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no UI change. Test output:

```
# before
AssertionError: expected [] to deeply equal [ 'create', 'other' ]
# after
src/tools/mcp-client.test.ts (167 tests) 1916ms
Tests  167 passed (167)
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only. Linux was verified in a `node:22-bookworm` container with a fresh `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and a core package build.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: choosing "first declaration wins" is a guess about the server's intent, but the previous behavior (discard the entire server) is strictly worse.
- Not validated / out of scope: surfacing the skip notice outside `--debug` would need a new user-facing warning channel across packages; other conversion failures still collapse into the generic "no tools" message.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Closes #15741

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

MCP 工具发现现在会保留同名工具中的第一个声明，而不是让整个 server 的工具列表一起失效。被跳过的名字会连同 server 名一起写入 debug 日志。

## 为什么需要

如果某个 server 列出两个同名工具（报告者的 Unity MCP server 因为丢掉命令分组，会产出多个 `create`），发现流程就会整体失败：`@google/genai` 在转换整份 `tools/list` 结果时抛出 `Duplicate function name ... found in MCP tools`，这个错误被吞成空工具列表，调用方随后报出误导性的 `No prompts, tools, or resources found on the server.`。该 server 的其余工具全部不可用，健康检查重连时还会重复同样的失败。

只丢弃冲突的声明是客户端能独立完成的部分：违反规范的是 server（它复用了名字），而模型本来也无法用一个名字调用两个不同的工具。保留其余工具，可以把一个完全不可用的 server 变成部分可用。

## 评审验证步骤

1. 让 Qwen Code 连接一个列出两个同名工具、同时还有至少一个其他工具的 MCP server。修复前：该 server 不贡献任何工具，日志先出现重复名错误，再出现 `No prompts, tools, or resources found on the server.`。修复后：不重名的工具正常注册，`--debug` 日志会列出被跳过的重名工具。
2. 运行 `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/tools/mcp-client.test.ts`。新增用例 `keeps the first tool of a duplicated name instead of discarding the server` 在 `main` 上失败（`expected [] to deeply equal [ 'create', 'other' ]`），本改动后通过，整个文件 167/167 通过。

## 证据

N/A —— 无 UI 变化，测试输出见上方英文部分。

## 测试平台

macOS ✅、Windows ⚠️ 未测试、Linux ✅（`node:22-bookworm` 容器，全新 `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` 并构建 core 包后运行单测）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：以"第一个声明为准"是对 server 意图的猜测，但原行为（丢弃整个 server）严格来说更差。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：在 `--debug` 之外向用户提示被跳过的工具，需要新增跨包的用户可见警告通道；其他转换失败仍会退化成统一的 "no tools" 报错。
- 破坏性变更：无。

## 关联 Issue

Closes #15741

</details>

prs.title: feat(mods): draw the band above the prompt in the OpenTUI terminal
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This is step 4 of the four in the terminal rendering design: the OpenTUI terminal draws the Mods' band above the prompt, as the Ink terminal has since step 2 (#15619).

- **OpenTUI offers the `AbovePrompt` site.** A Mod's `ui.render` hooks now run there, instead of being skipped with a startup line, and `$.session.version()` lists `ui.render`.
- **It gives the hooks the same input as Ink.** The input carries the columns and rows, whether the screen is the alternate screen, whether a turn is in flight, the band's `maxRows` (a third of the rows) and its body columns (the width less 5). OpenTUI has no session survey, so `hasSurvey` is always `false`.
- **It draws the same tree with OpenTUI's box, text and span.**
  - The band sits between the queued messages and the prompt, and hides while a dialog takes the composer's place, as in Ink.
  - It is clipped to `maxRows` and keeps 5 columns free on the right. OpenTUI clips a box's fill but not its border, so the band draws a bordered box's border within the boxes that clip it.
  - A tree that throws while drawn shows nothing, and the next answer is drawn afresh.
  - The band converts trees as Ink does, so the same tree looks the same in both terminals:
    - a Box lays out in a row and may shrink, which is Ink's default and not OpenTUI's;
    - spacing steps become cells, and theme keys follow the active theme;
    - `rgb()` and `ansi256()` colors become hex values, and uncolored text and borders take the theme's text color, where OpenTUI's default is white;
    - a Text with nothing to draw takes no rows, and a `quote` border's blank rows sit within its height;
    - tabs become spaces to 8-column stops;
    - text is sanitized, and Claude Code's `dashed` and `quote` borders and Ink's other named borders are drawn.
- **Ink and OpenTUI now share one module** for the band's input and the tree conversions both terminals read the same way. Ink's drawing does not change.
- The user guide says that both terminals draw the band, and lists what OpenTUI draws differently.

## Why it's needed

Claude Code draws the band in its terminal, and Qwen Code has two terminals. Before this PR, a Mod such as Token Weather drew its band in Ink but nothing in OpenTUI, where its `ui.render` hook was skipped. This completes the terminal rendering design: Mods draw in both terminals from the same tree.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- In `packages/cli`, run `npx vitest run src/ui/opentui/mod-band.test.tsx src/ui/components/ModBand.test.tsx src/ui/opentui/start-opentui-ui.test.tsx src/ui/opentui/opentui-app-shell.test.tsx src/ui/opentui/live-session.test.ts`.
- Run `QWEN_TUI_RENDERER=opentui bun dist/cli.js` with a Mod that draws a band, such as Token Weather, and check that the band shows above the prompt.

### Evidence (Before & After)

**OpenTUI, with Token Weather unchanged.** I took Token Weather from `anthropics/claude-code-playground` without changes. I ran it in tmux at 140×40 under Bun 1.4.4, with `QWEN_TUI_RENDERER=opentui` and `QWEN_TUI_RENDERER_STRICT=1`, so a fallback to Ink would fail the run. The CLI talked to a loopback OpenAI-compatible fixture that reports 122,222 and then 222,222 prompt tokens. Before is the head of #15624, whose runtime code is the same as `main` at `35dc8ee518`; the two commits after it change only CI and release scripts. After is this PR. I bundled both locally.

Before, at startup, the hook is skipped and nothing is drawn:

```

```

At 70 columns the band wraps:

```text

```

I ran the same steps in Ink with this PR's bundle. Ink draws the same lines at both widths, character for character.

**OpenTUI, with a probe Mod.** The probe draws its input and a `dashed` box, and asks for a redraw after each turn. Before, the hook is skipped and nothing is drawn. After:

| Step | The probe's line |
| --- | --- |
| startup | `PROBE cols=135 rows=13 working=false fs=true n=1` |
| during a slow turn | `PROBE cols=135 rows=13 working=true fs=true n=2` |
| resized to 90 columns | `PROBE cols=85 rows=13 working=false fs=true …` |
| after `/clear` | `PROBE cols=85 rows=13 working=false fs=true n=5` |

`$.session.version()` lists `ui.invalidate,ui.log,ui.render`. `fs=true` because OpenTUI uses the alternate screen. The dashed box:

```text

╎ dashed box                                                                        ╎

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
>   Type your message or @path/to/file
```

**Ink and OpenTUI, frame by frame.** I drew 20 trees with Ink's band and OpenTUI's band, using `ink-testing-library` and OpenTUI's own test renderer at 100 columns under Bun, and compared the frames. 16 trees draw the same. They cover:

- a Box's default row, column and row gaps, and spacing steps;
- `round`, `single`, `dashed` and `quote` borders;
- word wrap, tabs and nested text;
- `justifyContent`, `display: "none"`, and boxes that shrink;
- clipping at `maxRows` and long lines;
- the Token Weather line.

The 4 that differ are listed in the guide: three truncations and the `arrow` border. Without the row default in OpenTUI's box, 9 of the 20 differ, Token Weather among them.

Automated checks:

- The five CLI test files above pass, with 292 tests. The broader CLI run, the five plus `Composer.test.tsx`, `AppContainer.test.tsx` and `src/services/`, passes 1,433 tests in 47 files.
- I broke the code deliberately 17 ways, and a test fails for each:
  - the entry's `isWorking` and `hasSurvey`, and OpenTUI's offer of the site;
  - the band's `maxRows` in the app shell;
  - the Box's row and shrink defaults;
  - the `end` and `middle` aliases, the middle truncation, bold and nested spans;
  - the `quote` border's spacing, `borderDimColor` and `display: "none"`;
  - the `ansi256()` gray ramp and color cube;
  - the 8-column tab stops and the repeated-key fallback.
- `tsc --noEmit` for the CLI, ESLint on the changed files and Prettier all pass.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux, Node 24.21.0, Bun 1.4.4, bundles built with `npm run bundle`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff:
  - OpenTUI's text truncates only in the middle, with `...` where Ink draws `…`. `wrap: "middle"` and `"truncate-middle"` draw that way. The other truncations cut the text off at the right edge without a mark.
  - OpenTUI's borders have one stroke per axis, so the `arrow` border draws its top arrow on the bottom edge and its left arrow on the right edge.
  - `ansi256()` colors become the standard xterm values, since OpenTUI takes hex. Ink leaves the index to the terminal's palette. ANSI color names likewise become fixed values.
  - A `borderColor` border draws undimmed under `borderDimColor`, and `isWorking` stays `false` while a `!` shell command runs. The guide lists both.
- Not validated / out of scope:
  - The `Pane` site, focus, scrolling and the collapse mark, in either terminal.
  - macOS and Windows; CI covers them.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Ink's drawing is unchanged.

Design document: [English](docs/design/2026-10-26-mod-terminal-render.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-26-mod-terminal-render.zh-CN.md). This PR implements step 4 as designed, so the document is unchanged.

Part of #13749. Follows #15624.

prs.title: fix(serve): serialize overlapping cleanup retries
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Serialize background and resident-load cleanup retries within each attached Session. A queued request rechecks unsettled work and durable cleanup debt after its predecessor, using its own authorization options. A failed attempt remains an error for its caller and leaves the next request free to retry. An older caller cannot erase a successor's queue slot. Java unit validation also bounds JVM-held H2 catalogs to a test class instead of retaining every class's catalog in one process.

## Why it's needed

I reproduced a wake retry and passive reload observing the same unpaid owner before either confirms its release. This produces three release calls where two are expected. A late background refusal can also leave recovery blocked after successful cleanup. This is the cleanup-debt case in #14101, encountered while checking #14937.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Hold the background original-owner release while admitting a passive load. Success must produce exactly two total release calls, one terminal turn, one subsequent cleanup confirmation, an unblocked Session, and no repeated model turn.
- Refuse the held release. The queued load must make its own retry, with exactly three calls after two refusals and the same final state. Every call must retain the original binding, generation and Runtime owner.
- Admit a real later prompt while a cleanup is queued. After the predecessor refuses, queued cleanup must recheck the prompt before touching its owner.
- For three callers, hold the second release after the first fails. The first caller must preserve the successor's slot, and the third must wait. Once all callers settle, the retry promise must clear.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Current head: `a6f26ee3bea2fc64c8a9f2107005be151af79571`, including required gate `e24f9c48fd333fceeb69883434045a47574ed496` through a normal merge. The merge retains the concurrency tests and migrates their journal read to the upstream scoped API. The retry implementation itself is byte-identical to the previously tested `ef4703a241` implementation.

The recorded original-source control fails the duplicate-release and stale-recovery assertions. This does not claim that both baseline branches fail deterministically on every host. Prior guard mutations were caught by the unsettled-prompt, settled-promise and successor-slot cases; those mutation receipts belong to the earlier recorded candidate.

Root build, bundle, complete TypeScript typecheck, scoped ESLint/Prettier, nine gate-freshness tests and 44 lint-scope tests pass at `2470302a0a`. The selected cleanup suite passes **29/29** with no retry or timeout override. These receipts remain applicable: this increment changes only Java unit-fork configuration and its two regression classes. Other Harness cases were filtered; this is not the complete Harness suite.

The Java run at `2470302a0a` reports 5,573 tests, zero assertion failures, four errors and 19 skips. Three fresh-schema errors terminate in H2 heap exhaustion; a separate provisioner happy-path case exceeds its one-second startup deadline. The earlier run exhausted heap in two different schema cases. The relation between GC pressure and the deadline error remains unproven.

A bounded probe of the actual schema, its 38 canonical tables and H2 2.4.240 confirms one retention mechanism: after four databases are initialized, all connections are closed and all four data sources are collected, H2 still retains all four catalogs after GC. Explicit shutdown removes them. The default reused test JVM lets such fixture state accumulate across 375 classes. Ordinary Surefire now starts a fresh JVM per class, with its default single fork keeping classes sequential. Failsafe MySQL/Hosted settings and the overriding fault-gate profile remain unchanged; JaCoCo continues appending fork execution data.

Two real H2 regression classes deliberately reuse one catalog name. With the old reused fork, the second class sees the first class's table and fails; with class forks, both pass. The local Maven harness uses the unmodified test sources, actual default plugin configuration, Surefire 3.5.6, JUnit 5.14.1, H2 2.4.240 and JDK 21.0.7: **before one passed/one failed; after two passed, zero skips**. It is an isolated harness, not a full server-module compile. Direct JUnit controls also confirm both build-oracle tests skip outside Maven and both fail when a synthetic CI run lacks the Surefire marker; restored fork reuse still fails normally under Maven.

The full module compile, complete Java/Hosted gates, added JVM startup cost and the separate startup-deadline error remain pending CI. Heap, timeout, test-selector and coverage limits are unchanged. Local checks follow the [module validation budget](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/a6f26ee3bea2fc64c8a9f2107005be151af79571/packages/managed-agent-server/AGENTS.md#local-validation-scope-and-budget); a focused harness pass does not clear the unexplained full-suite failure.

An earlier cleanup run also had two 15-second timeouts, followed by a 29/29 pass on an unchanged candidate; their cause remains unresolved and the failed logs are retained. No source timeout increase is included.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | No local current-head run |
| Windows | No local current-head cleanup run |
| Linux | Applicable TypeScript build/bundle/typecheck/style/helper receipts and 29 selected cleanup cases pass; the new H2 fork/guard harness passes as scoped above; full Java CI pending |

### Environment

Node 22.21.1, frozen pnpm dependencies, 4 CPU / 8 GiB isolated Linux container, 6 GiB build/typecheck heap. Public HTTP/journal tests use mocked model and Runtime Broker responses; no live provider or TUI was exercised.

## Risk & Scope

- Serialization is per attached Session; each waiter retains its own authorization and recovery options.
- Full Java compile and complete Harness/Java acceptance remain pending CI. Class isolation adds JVM startup and reduces cross-class Spring cache reuse; its total runtime cost is not measured locally. Earlier timing failures and heap exhaustion are not counted as fully resolved by the focused harness.
- No protocol or migration change. Timeout-policy work remains in #14625 / #10892 rather than this concurrency fix.

## Linked Issues

Related to #14101 and #15483; encountered while checking #14937.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

在每个已附加 Session 内串行执行后台和驻留加载触发的清理重试。排队请求等待前序完成后，使用自身授权选项重新检查未结束工作和持久清理债务。失败仍返回给对应调用者，同时允许后续请求重试。较早调用者不能清除后继请求的队列槽位。Java 单元验证还将 JVM 保留的 H2 目录限定在一个测试类的生命周期内，而不是在一个进程中累积所有类的目录。

## 为什么需要

我复现了唤醒重试与被动重新加载在任一方确认释放之前同时发现同一未偿还所有者的情况。这会产生三次释放，而预期为两次。后台较晚的拒绝还可能在成功清理后重新阻塞恢复。这对应 #14101 的清理债务场景，在检查 #14937 时再次遇到。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

- 阻塞后台对原始所有者的释放，同时允许被动加载。成功时必须恰好有两次释放调用、一个终态回合、其后一个清理确认、解除阻塞的 Session，且不重复模型回合。
- 拒绝被阻塞的释放。排队加载必须自行重试，两次拒绝后恰好有三次调用，并得到相同最终状态。每次调用都必须保持原始绑定、代次和 Runtime 所有者。
- 清理排队时接受一个真实的后续提示。前序拒绝后，排队清理必须在操作所有者之前重新检查该提示。
- 三个调用者场景中，第一次失败后阻塞第二次释放。第一个调用者必须保留后继槽位，第三个必须等待。所有调用结束后，重试 promise 必须清除。

### 前后对比证据

当前提交：`a6f26ee3bea2fc64c8a9f2107005be151af79571`，通过普通合并包含所需门槛 `e24f9c48fd333fceeb69883434045a47574ed496`。合并保留并发测试，并将其日志读取迁移到上游的作用域 API。重试实现本身与此前测试的 `ef4703a241` 实现逐字节相同。

已记录的原始源码对照会触发重复释放和过时恢复状态的断言失败。这不意味着两个基线分支在每个主机上都确定失败。此前的守卫变异被未结束提示、已结束 promise 和后继槽位用例捕获；这些变异记录对应先前记录的候选提交。

根目录构建、打包、完整 TypeScript 类型检查、限定范围 ESLint/Prettier、九个门槛新鲜度测试及 44 个 lint 范围测试在 `2470302a0a` 通过。选定的清理套件 **29/29 通过**，没有修改重试或超时。这些证据仍适用：本增量仅修改 Java 单元分叉配置及两个回归类。其他 Harness 用例被过滤；这不是完整 Harness 套件。

`2470302a0a` 的 Java 运行报告 5,573 个测试、零断言失败、四个错误和 19 个跳过。三个新建模式错误终止于 H2 堆耗尽；另一个提供器正常路径用例超过其一秒启动期限。更早的运行在另外两个模式用例中耗尽堆。GC 压力与启动期限错误之间的关系仍未证实。

对真实模式、其 38 张规范表及 H2 2.4.240 的有界探针确认了一种保留机制：初始化四个数据库后，全部连接关闭且四个数据源均被回收，GC 后 H2 仍保留全部四个目录。显式关闭可将其移除。默认复用测试 JVM 会让此类夹具状态在 375 个类之间累积。普通 Surefire 现为每个类启动新 JVM，其默认单分叉保持类串行执行。Failsafe 的 MySQL/Hosted 设置及覆盖配置的 fault-gate profile 不变；JaCoCo 继续追加各分叉执行数据。

两个真实 H2 回归类有意复用同一目录名称。旧的复用分叉让第二个类看到第一个类的表并失败；按类分叉时两者均通过。本地 Maven 夹具使用未修改的测试源、真实默认插件配置、Surefire 3.5.6、JUnit 5.14.1、H2 2.4.240 和 JDK 21.0.7：**修改前一个通过、一个失败；修改后两个通过、零跳过**。这是独立夹具，不是完整服务端模块编译。直接 JUnit 对照还确认两个构建检查在 Maven 之外跳过，模拟 CI 缺少 Surefire 标记时两个均失败；在 Maven 中恢复复用分叉仍正常触发回归。

完整模块编译、完整 Java/Hosted 门槛、新增 JVM 启动成本及独立的启动期限错误仍待 CI 验证。堆、超时、测试选择器和覆盖限制不变。本地检查遵循[模块验证预算](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/a6f26ee3bea2fc64c8a9f2107005be151af79571/packages/managed-agent-server/AGENTS.md#local-validation-scope-and-budget)；定向夹具通过不代表未解释的完整套件失败已被清除。

此前一次清理运行还出现两个 15 秒超时，之后未修改的候选提交 29/29 通过；原因仍未确定，失败日志已保留。本改动不增加源码超时上限。

### 已测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | 当前提交未在本地运行 |
| Windows | 当前提交的清理用例未在本地运行 |
| Linux | 适用的 TypeScript 构建、打包、类型检查、样式、辅助证据及选定的 29 个清理用例通过；新增 H2 分叉/守卫夹具按上述范围通过；完整 Java CI 待运行 |

### 环境

Node 22.21.1，冻结 pnpm 依赖，4 CPU / 8 GiB 独立 Linux 容器，构建和类型检查使用 6 GiB 堆。公开 HTTP/日志测试使用模拟模型与 Runtime Broker 响应；未测试真实提供商或 TUI。

## 风险与范围

- 串行化按已附加 Session 生效；每个等待者保留自身的授权和恢复选项。
- 完整 Java 编译及完整 Harness/Java 验收仍待 CI。按类隔离增加 JVM 启动并减少跨类 Spring 缓存复用；其总运行成本未在本地测量。此前时序失败和堆耗尽不能因定向夹具通过而计为已完全解决。
- 无协议或迁移变更。超时策略工作保持在 #14625 / #10892，不纳入此并发修复。

## 关联问题

关联 #14101 和 #15483；在检查 #14937 时遇到。

prs.title: feat(cli): support exact-version updates without npm discovery
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds `qwen update --target-version <version>` for standalone installations. An explicit target skips npm version discovery and installs that exact release through the existing download and verification flow, including `QWEN_UPDATE_BASE_URL`. Omitting the option preserves normal update discovery.

Concrete stable and prerelease versions accept an optional leading `v`. Explicit requests allow same-version reinstalls and downgrades. Invalid targets are rejected before downloading, and a downloaded executable reporting a different version is rejected before activation. Unsupported installation methods return an actionable error instead of suggesting an unpinned upgrade. Help and error text are localized.

## Why it's needed

Operators may already have selected a release while npm registry access is unavailable. Configuring a reachable artifact source alone does not help because the current update command performs registry discovery first. Explicit selection makes that dependency unnecessary and prevents discovery from choosing a different release.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run an explicit-version update with a custom HTTPS release root while npm registry access is unavailable. It should install exactly the selected version without invoking npm or contacting a registry.
- Try a concrete prerelease, a same-version reinstall and an explicit downgrade. Each should use the specified version and retain the previous installation for rollback.
- Try a mutable tag, malformed version, missing argument, unavailable archive, incorrect checksum or an archive whose executable reports a different version. Failures must preserve the original installation and clean up update locks and temporary files.
- For a non-standalone installation, expect a nonzero exit and instructions to install the selected version manually, without an unpinned package-manager command.
- Omit the target option and confirm that normal version discovery remains in use.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the installed CLI's update help has no target-version option; source always runs version discovery before downloading.

After: focused unit tests pass, and isolated CLI tests use a local HTTPS release source with registry access unavailable to verify exact installation and failure preservation. Detailed E2E evidence is posted separately.

Validation: full build, workspace typecheck, bundle, 170 focused tests, changed-file ESLint and Prettier checks passed. The npm lockfile was used for final validation; the optional pnpm layout exceeded an unrelated document-export asset budget, while the npm build passed that gate.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Tested: build, typecheck, unit tests and isolated CLI E2E |
| Windows | Not tested locally |
| Linux | Baseline update help only; new implementation not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22.23.1. E2E runs use isolated home directories and disposable installations, a local HTTPS server with a temporary trusted CA, and network/subprocess guards. Downloaded fixtures contain a real Node runtime and a small version-reporting CLI; this verifies updater behavior, not the functionality of a complete new release. No real installation was updated.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: explicit requests intentionally permit reinstalls and downgrades. Version equality is now checked before activation for all standalone update entrypoints.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows deferred replacement, full release-package acceptance, daemon/UI upgrade orchestration and release approval policies.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: existing calls without the option retain version discovery; malformed versions are rejected more strictly.

## Linked Issues

Closes #11484

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

为独立安装新增 `qwen update --target-version <version>`。指定目标时跳过 npm 版本查询，通过现有下载与校验流程安装该精确版本，并继续支持 `QWEN_UPDATE_BASE_URL`。不指定参数时保留原有版本查询行为。

支持具体稳定版和预发布版本，以及可选的 `v` 前缀。显式请求允许同版本重装和降级。非法目标在下载前拒绝；下载后若程序报告的版本与目标不一致，则在激活前拒绝。不支持的安装方式返回可操作的错误提示，避免建议一个未固定版本的升级命令。帮助与错误文案已本地化。

## 需求背景

用户可能已经确定要安装的版本，但无法访问 npm registry。仅配置可访问的制品源仍然不够，因为当前升级命令会先查询 registry。指定版本可以移除这个依赖，并避免版本发现选择另一个版本。

## 审查者验证计划

### 验证方法

- 在 npm registry 不可用时，结合自定义 HTTPS 下载源执行指定版本升级。应准确安装目标版本，不调用 npm，也不访问 registry。
- 验证具体预发布版本、同版本重装和显式降级。每种情况均应使用指定版本，并保留旧安装以供回退。
- 验证可变标签、非法版本、缺少参数、制品不存在、校验不匹配和包内程序版本不匹配。失败必须保留旧安装，并清理锁与临时文件。
- 非独立安装应返回非零退出码，提示手动安装指定版本，不输出未固定版本的包管理器升级命令。
- 不提供目标参数时，应继续执行原有版本查询。

### 修改前后证据

修改前：已安装 CLI 的升级帮助中没有指定版本参数；源码在下载前始终查询版本。

修改后：相关单测通过；隔离 CLI 测试使用本地 HTTPS 制品源，在 registry 不可用的条件下验证准确安装及失败保护。详细 E2E 证据单独评论发布。

验证通过：完整构建、工作区类型检查、bundle、170 项相关测试，以及改动文件的 ESLint 和 Prettier 检查。最终验证使用 npm 锁文件；可选 pnpm 布局触发了无关的文档导出体积限制，npm 构建通过了同一门禁。

### 测试平台

- macOS：构建、类型检查、单测和隔离 CLI E2E 已验证。
- Windows：未在本地验证。
- Linux：仅检查基线升级帮助，未在本地验证新实现。

### 验证环境

Node.js 22.23.1。E2E 使用隔离 HOME、临时安装、本地 HTTPS 服务、临时受信 CA，以及网络和子进程监测。下载制品由真实 Node 运行时和精简的版本输出 CLI 组成，证明的是升级器行为，而非完整新版本的功能验收。未升级任何真实安装。

## 风险与范围

- 显式指定版本允许重装和降级；所有独立升级入口都会在激活前核对版本一致性。
- 未覆盖 Windows 延迟替换、完整发布包验收、daemon/UI 升级编排或版本审核策略。
- 未指定参数时保留现有行为；非法版本校验更加严格。

关联并关闭 #11484。

</details>

prs.title: ci: run installed npm acceptance nightly instead of on PR updates
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Run installed npm/private Bun acceptance and its four-platform distribution matrix nightly at 03:17 Asia/Shanghai (19:17 UTC), or by manual dispatch, instead of on every PR update. Nightly runs skip the source TUI lanes; existing source TUI PR filtering and manual behavior stay unchanged. All product assertions, native hosts, toolchains and canonical artifact dependencies remain intact.

Scheduled failures on main also enter the existing deduplicated CI issue reporter. Repeated test failures reuse their tracker; infrastructure-only failures retain the existing one-rerun policy. PR and manual runs do not enter this new reporting route.

## Why it's needed

The installed jobs bypass the existing impact classifier: [a one-line Java test change](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15715) still [queued installed acceptance](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40483833227). Five successful runs sampled today had a median producer queue of 67.3 minutes versus 8.8 minutes executing. The producer and four consumers used 90.7–108.5 total runner minutes per run. Broad PR triggers make that cost recur for unrelated changes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- On a PR update, installed acceptance and its dependent distribution matrix should be skipped; source TUI jobs should retain their existing impact classification and fail-closed behavior.
- On a scheduled run, only the installed producer and its successful-producer-dependent matrix should execute. The classifier and source TUI jobs should skip.
- A manual dispatch against a selected ref should still run source TUI and installed acceptance. A failed producer must not start distribution consumers without a canonical artifact.

- A failed nightly run on main should create or reuse the existing failure issue after normal infrastructure/stale-attempt handling. Success, cancellation, skipping, PR and manual runs should not file through this new route.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for product UI. Scheduling regression tests failed in two places against the original workflow, then all 76 workflow tests passed after the change. All 92 runner-routing tests passed. ESLint, formatting, CI budget, workflow size, diff checks and bilingual links passed. Actionlint passed with only the unchanged `macos-15-intel` unknown-label diagnostic excluded because the local validator's runner inventory is older. Independent static correctness review found no issues.

The reporting follow-up added a failing regression for the missing workflow watch and schedule route; after wiring both, all 287 tests across the failure reporter, CI platform lanes and TUI/E2E workflow suites passed, including existing issue-reuse tests. Reporter actionlint passed without exclusions. No synthetic GitHub failure or issue was created to test reporting.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Targeted workflow tests and static checks passed |
| Windows | Not run |
| Linux | Not run |

## Risk & Scope

- Installation regressions can now be found on the next nightly run rather than before merge. Maintainers should manually validate high-risk installation/runtime changes and the exact release candidate before publishing.
- Full local build failed because the reused dependency tree resolves Playwright 1.58.2 instead of the current expected 1.62.1. Full typecheck also failed with missing workspace build declarations and dependency errors. These checks are not claimed green. No product source or dependency inputs changed.
- No live four-platform run was dispatched for this scheduling-only change. The daily schedule activates after merge to the default branch and may be delayed by GitHub queueing. Existing queued runs are not cancelled; no release gate is automatically added.
- Design: [English](docs/design/2026-10-27-installed-acceptance-nightly.md) / [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-27-installed-acceptance-nightly.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Maintainer-requested follow-up to observed CI queueing; no linked issue.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 改动内容

npm 安装及私有 Bun 验收和后续四平台分发矩阵改为每天北京时间 03:17（UTC 19:17）或手动触发，不再随每次 PR 更新执行。夜间跳过源码 TUI 任务；现有源码 TUI 的 PR 过滤及手动行为保持不变。全部产品断言、原生平台、工具链和唯一产物依赖不变。

main 夜间失败同时接入已有的去重 CI issue 报障流程。重复测试失败复用跟踪单，纯基础设施失败保留已有的首次重跑策略。PR 和手动运行不进入新增报障路径。

## 原因

安装任务绕过了现有影响分类器：[仅修改一行 Java 测试的 PR](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15715) 仍然[排队等待安装验收](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40483833227)。今天采样的五次成功运行中，产物生成任务排队中位数为 67.3 分钟，而执行中位数仅 8.8 分钟。产物生成及四个消费者每轮累计使用 90.7–108.5 runner 分钟。宽泛的 PR 触发范围让无关改动也反复承担这一成本。

## 评审验证计划

### 验证方式

- PR 更新应跳过安装验收及其依赖的分发矩阵；源码 TUI 任务保持既有影响分类和分类失败仍执行的行为。
- 定时运行应仅执行安装产物生成任务及依赖其成功的矩阵；分类器和源码 TUI 任务跳过。
- 手动选择 ref 运行仍应执行源码 TUI 和安装验收。产物生成失败时，不应在缺少唯一产物的情况下启动分发消费者。

- main 夜间失败应在沿用基础设施及旧 attempt 处理规则后创建或复用已有失败 issue。成功、取消、跳过、PR 和手动运行不应通过新增路径建单。

### 前后证据

产品 UI 不适用。调度回归测试在旧工作流上有两项失败，修改后 76 项工作流测试全部通过。92 项 runner 路由测试全部通过。ESLint、格式、CI 预算、工作流体积、diff 检查及双语链接检查通过。Actionlint 仅排除未修改的 `macos-15-intel` 未知标签诊断后通过，原因是本机校验器的 runner 清单较旧。独立静态正确性评审未发现问题。

报障补充先通过回归测试确认缺少监听及定时路由会失败；接入后，失败报告、CI 平台任务和 TUI/E2E 工作流三个套件共 287 项测试通过，包含已有 issue 复用测试。报告工作流 actionlint 无需排除项即通过。没有为验证报障而制造 GitHub 失败或测试 issue。

### 测试平台

| 平台 | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | 针对性工作流测试和静态检查通过 |
| Windows | 未运行 |
| Linux | 未运行 |

## 风险与范围

- 安装回归可能延迟到下一次夜间运行发现，而不是在合并前发现。维护者应在合并前手动验证高风险安装/运行时改动，并在发布前验证具体候选版本。
- 本地全量构建失败：复用的依赖树解析到 Playwright 1.58.2，而当前代码要求 1.62.1。全量类型检查也因缺失工作区构建声明和依赖错误失败，不声称这些检查通过。没有修改产品源码或依赖输入。
- 本次仅调整调度，没有触发真实四平台验收。每日任务合入默认分支后生效，可能受 GitHub 排队延迟影响。不取消既有排队任务，不自动增加发布门禁。
- 设计：[English](docs/design/2026-10-27-installed-acceptance-nightly.md) / [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-27-installed-acceptance-nightly.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联问题

维护者针对观察到的 CI 排队要求进行的改进，无关联 issue。

</details>

prs.title: fix(ci): run the sdk-java suite before taking the host lock
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The self-hosted SDK Java test job no longer holds the per-host Maven lock while it runs the SDK and Managed Agent suites. It seeds a job-local Maven repository from the host cache, runs every Maven command from that job-local copy without the lock, and takes the ticketed host lock only for the cache write-back. The write-back is the only remaining host-shared mutation; it is bounded at 300 seconds, and its children close the lock fd so a cancelled job's survivor cannot retain the lock.

The workflow pins, the fair-lock design document in English and Chinese, and the recorded workflow size move with the mechanism.

## Why it's needed

Run 39755183699's full-tier Java 11 leg waited its entire 5,400-second lock budget as queue ticket 249 and failed before running a test: "sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes". The queue was working — the ticket was promoted to the fast class after 20 minutes — but the hold in front of it outlasted the budget. The MariaDB lane was already scoped to its cache write-back by #15128; the test job was the remaining site that held the host lock across a long Maven suite, so one suite could serialize every other Java lane on the same host. Moving the suite to a job-local repository removes that last long hold and makes the 90-minute wait far larger than any hold it protects.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `npx vitest run scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/sdk-java-lock.test.js scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js`. Confirm the workflow meta-tests pass, including the assertion that every Maven command in the test job runs before the lock acquisition and that the suite leaves the host lock free. Inspect the `Run Java SDK tests (self-hosted)` step: the seed, the suite, and the `sdk_java_lock_acquire 5400 "${TIER}"` call should appear in that order, and the write-back should close fd 9. A full CI run on Linux then exercises the real Java lanes.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (CI workflow change, not user-visible). Before: the Java 11 leg timed out with the lock annotation after exactly 90 minutes. After: the static and runtime meta-tests show the suite runs before the lock and the lock is free when the suite finishes.

### Tested on

|     OS     |          Status           |
| :--------: | :-----------------------: |
|  🍏 macOS  |       ⚠️ not tested       |
| 🪟 Windows |       ⚠️ not tested       |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested (meta-tests, build, typecheck, lint) |

### Environment (optional)

Local checkout with Node 22; no JDK or Maven in this environment, so the Java suite itself is left to CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Maven suites on the same host can now run concurrently instead of serializing. They resolve from separate job-local repositories seeded with read-only hardlinks, and the only host-shared mutation (the cache write-back) still takes the lock; this is the same model #15128 established for the MariaDB lane.
- Not validated / out of scope: the Java and Maven lanes were not executed locally because this environment has no JDK or Maven. The full Linux Java lanes in CI are the final verification. The 90-minute budget and the job ceilings are unchanged.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The release-tag fallback to the bare lock is preserved.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15264

Design docs: [English](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.zh-CN.md)

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

自托管的 SDK Java test job 不再在运行 SDK 和 Managed Agent 套件期间持有每台宿主机上的 Maven 锁。它从宿主机缓存播种一个 job 本地 Maven 仓库，从该 job 本地副本运行所有 Maven 命令且不持有锁，只在缓存写回时获取票据化的宿主机锁。写回是最后一个宿主机共享的变更；它被限制在 300 秒内，并且其子进程会关闭锁 fd，因此被取消 job 的残留进程无法继续持有锁。

工作流的 pin、英文和中文的公平锁设计文档，以及记录的工作流大小都随机制一起更新。

## 为什么需要

运行 39755183699 的 full 档 Java 11 通道以队列 ticket 249 的身份等满了 5,400 秒锁预算，在运行任何测试之前就失败了："sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes"。队列本身工作正常——该 ticket 在 20 分钟后被提升到 fast 类——但排在它前面的持锁时间超过了预算。MariaDB 通道已由 #15128 限定为只在缓存写回时取锁；test job 是最后一个仍在长时间 Maven 套件期间持有宿主机锁的站点，因此一个套件就能把同一宿主机上的其他 Java 通道串行化。把套件移到 job 本地仓库消除了最后一个长持锁，使 90 分钟的等待远大于它所保护的任何一次持锁。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

运行 `npx vitest run scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/sdk-java-lock.test.js scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js`。确认工作流元测试通过，包括：test job 中的每个 Maven 命令都在取锁之前运行，并且套件结束时宿主机锁是空闲的。检查 `Run Java SDK tests (self-hosted)` 步骤：播种、套件、`sdk_java_lock_acquire 5400 "${TIER}"` 调用应按此顺序出现，写回应关闭 fd 9。随后在 Linux 上运行完整的 CI 即可验证真实 Java 通道。

### 证据（修改前与修改后）

不适用（CI 工作流改动，非用户可见）。修改前：Java 11 通道在整整 90 分钟后带着锁注解超时。修改后：静态和运行时元测试表明套件在取锁之前运行，且套件结束时锁是空闲的。

### 测试平台

|    操作系统    |             状态              |
| :------------: | :---------------------------: |
|  🍏 macOS  |          ⚠️ 未测试           |
| 🪟 Windows |          ⚠️ 未测试           |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测试（元测试、构建、类型检查、lint） |

### 环境（可选）

本地 checkout，Node 22；此环境没有 JDK 或 Maven，因此 Java 套件本身留给 CI 验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：同一宿主机上的 Maven 套件现在可以并发运行，而不是串行化。它们从各自独立的 job 本地仓库解析，这些仓库用只读硬链接播种；唯一的宿主机共享变更（缓存写回）仍然取锁；这与 #15128 为 MariaDB 通道建立的模型相同。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：本地未执行 Java 和 Maven 通道，因为此环境没有 JDK 或 Maven。CI 中完整的 Linux Java 通道是最终验证。90 分钟预算和 job 上限保持不变。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。release tag 回退到裸锁的路径保留。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #15264

设计文档：[英文](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.zh-CN.md)

</details>

prs.title: fix(generated-ui): offer Generated UI only to clients that render MCP Apps
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Bundled Generated UI is now offered only to sessions whose client can render MCP Apps. The daemon's ACP bridge, whose sessions Web Shell and Desktop display, declares an MCP App host capability when it connects to the agent, and the agent marks those session configs as MCP App hosts before initialization. Every other session, including the interactive TUI, `qwen -p` and other headless runs, editor ACP clients and channels, reports a new `unsupported-client` reason and receives neither the `generated_ui_show` tool nor the writer skill.

`unsupported-client` is an expected state, so it does not produce a startup warning. This also removes the misleading "Bundled Generated UI is unavailable (unsupported-runtime)" line the daemon printed at every start even though its sessions had Generated UI enabled.

## Why it's needed

With `experimental.generatedUi` on, every trusted local session received the tool and skill. In clients that cannot show a card, the model still used them: a real `qwen -p` run (qwen3.8-max) loaded the skill, called `generated_ui_show`, and finished with "the interactive splitter is ready, drag the sliders in the card above", although the terminal has no card. This blocks turning the experimental setting on by default, and #14019 requires that CLI/headless clients not receive a Web Shell-only experience.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Enable `experimental.generatedUi` in user settings in a trusted workspace.
2. Run `qwen -p "<a request to adjust a bill split interactively>" --output-format stream-json`. The stream should contain no `generated-ui` skill load and no `mcp__generated-ui__generated_ui_show` call, and the answer should not refer to a card.
3. Start `qwen serve`, open Web Shell and make the same request. The session status reports `generatedUi: { version: 1, enabled: true }` and the model can show the card.
4. The daemon log should no longer contain "Bundled Generated UI is unavailable (unsupported-runtime)" at startup.

Unit coverage: core config (unsupported-client status, no warning, setting-disabled still reported first, provider withheld), acpAgent (the setter is called before `initialize` only when the client advertises `qwen.mcpAppHost`), acp-bridge handshake capabilities, and MCP client manager fixtures that now declare an MCP App host.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Same settings, model and prompt (`聚餐分账：菜品总价 924 元，6 个人平分。我想在对话里直接拖动/输入人数、优惠金额和服务费比例，实时看到总价和每人应付。不需要写文件。`), `qwen -p --output-format stream-json`:

| | Before (`e67cb4a8b4`) | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tool calls | `skill generated-ui`, `tool_search`, `mcp__generated-ui__generated_ui_show` | no Generated UI skill or tool |
| Final answer | "已生成交互式分账计算器，可以直接在上方卡片里拖动滑块或输入数值。" | a text answer without a card reference |

Web Shell sessions on the same daemon still report `generatedUi: { version: 1, enabled: true }` and render the card.

Targeted tests: `packages/core` config/skills/MCP suites (1480 passed), `packages/acp-bridge` `bridge.test.ts` (1023 passed), `packages/cli` acpAgent MCP App host and Goal proposal cases (9 passed).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local bundle (`npm run build && npm run bundle`), isolated `HOME`, `qwen serve` with Web Shell and `qwen -p`, model qwen3.8-max.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the capability belongs to the connection that creates the session. A daemon session viewed only through the SDK still receives the tool and shows the readable summary there; sessions created by direct ACP clients never receive it.
- Not validated / out of scope: making the setting default-on, and the Generated UI presentation and model-guidance changes that follow in later steps of #14019.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: users who enabled the setting and used Generated UI through a non-daemon ACP client lose it there; those clients could not render the card.

## Linked Issues

Part of #14019.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

内置 Generated UI 现在只提供给能渲染 MCP App 的客户端所在的会话。daemon 的 ACP bridge（Web Shell 和 Desktop 显示的就是它的会话）在连接 agent 时声明自己是 MCP App 宿主，agent 在初始化前把这些会话的配置标记为 MCP App 宿主。其他会话，包括交互式 TUI、`qwen -p` 及其他 headless 运行、编辑器 ACP 客户端和频道，都会报告新的 `unsupported-client` 原因，既拿不到 `generated_ui_show` 工具，也拿不到写作技能。

`unsupported-client` 是预期状态，因此不会产生启动警告。这也去掉了 daemon 每次启动都会打印的误导性日志 "Bundled Generated UI is unavailable (unsupported-runtime)"——实际上它的会话是启用了 Generated UI 的。

## 为什么需要

开启 `experimental.generatedUi` 后，每个受信任的本地会话都会拿到工具和技能。在无法显示卡片的客户端里，模型照样会用：一次真实的 `qwen -p` 运行（qwen3.8-max）加载了技能、调用了 `generated_ui_show`，最后回复"已生成交互式分账计算器，可以直接在上方卡片里拖动滑块"，而终端里根本没有卡片。这会阻碍把这个实验设置默认开启；#14019 也要求 CLI/headless 客户端不能收到只在 Web Shell 可用的体验。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 在受信任的工作区中，于用户设置里开启 `experimental.generatedUi`。
2. 运行 `qwen -p "<一个想交互式调整分账的请求>" --output-format stream-json`。输出中不应有 `generated-ui` 技能加载，也不应有 `mcp__generated-ui__generated_ui_show` 调用，回答也不应提到卡片。
3. 启动 `qwen serve`，在 Web Shell 中提同样的请求。会话状态报告 `generatedUi: { version: 1, enabled: true }`，模型可以展示卡片。
4. daemon 启动日志中不应再出现 "Bundled Generated UI is unavailable (unsupported-runtime)"。

单元测试覆盖：core 配置（unsupported-client 状态、无警告、setting-disabled 仍优先报告、不注入 provider）、acpAgent（只有客户端声明 `qwen.mcpAppHost` 时才在 `initialize` 之前调用 setter）、acp-bridge 握手能力，以及 MCP client manager 中现在需要声明 MCP App 宿主的测试夹具。

### 证据（修改前后）

相同设置、模型和提示词（`聚餐分账：菜品总价 924 元，6 个人平分。我想在对话里直接拖动/输入人数、优惠金额和服务费比例，实时看到总价和每人应付。不需要写文件。`），`qwen -p --output-format stream-json`：

| | 修改前（`e67cb4a8b4`） | 修改后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 工具调用 | `skill generated-ui`、`tool_search`、`mcp__generated-ui__generated_ui_show` | 没有 Generated UI 技能或工具 |
| 最终回答 | "已生成交互式分账计算器，可以直接在上方卡片里拖动滑块或输入数值。" | 纯文字回答，不提卡片 |

同一个 daemon 上的 Web Shell 会话仍报告 `generatedUi: { version: 1, enabled: true }` 并能渲染卡片。

定向测试：`packages/core` 配置/技能/MCP 相关测试（1480 通过）、`packages/acp-bridge` `bridge.test.ts`（1023 通过）、`packages/cli` acpAgent 中 MCP App 宿主与 Goal proposal 用例（9 通过）。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境（可选）

本地 bundle（`npm run build && npm run bundle`）、隔离的 `HOME`、`qwen serve` 配合 Web Shell，以及 `qwen -p`，模型 qwen3.8-max。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：能力属于创建会话的那条连接。只通过 SDK 查看的 daemon 会话仍会拿到工具，在那里显示可读摘要；由直连 ACP 客户端创建的会话永远拿不到。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：把设置改为默认开启，以及 #14019 后续步骤中的 Generated UI 展示和模型引导改动。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：开启了该设置并通过非 daemon 的 ACP 客户端使用 Generated UI 的用户会在那里失去它；这些客户端本来也无法渲染卡片。

## 关联 Issue

属于 #14019 的一部分。

</details>
