prs.title: fix(ci): scope the sdk-java test job lock to the cache write-back (#15278)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The self-hosted Java test job now resolves Maven dependencies from a job-local repository seeded from the host cache, runs the sdk-java and managed-agent suites without the per-host lock, and takes that lock only for the optional cache write-back. A write-back lock that cannot be acquired within its budget now warns and skips the copy instead of failing a step whose suite already passed; the same rule applies to the MariaDB integration lane's write-back.

## Why it's needed

The Managed Agent gate failed on main commit `6fb149d6d8fd` before any Java test ran. Both attempts of the fast-tier job were head of the sdk-java host-lock queue and waited the full 5400 s — tickets 239 and 257, on two different hosts — and the annotations name `sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes`. The test job held the lock across the 925 s suite, so a long sibling hold starved the fast tier and the gate then failed with the suite. The lock queue is shared across the ECS pool, so raising the wait again would only lower the probability.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Inspect the two lock-bearing steps: every Maven command is above the acquisition; the step seeds `${RUNNER_TEMP}/m2-repo` with `cp -aln` and passes `-Dmaven.repo.local`; the write-back follows the suite and closes fd 9 on its children.
- Run `npx vitest run scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/sdk-java-lock.test.js scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js`. The new skip tests fail if either best-effort guard or either bare-lock fallback assignment is removed.
- On the ECS pool, a fast-tier job should start Maven immediately; a busy or stale host lock should only produce `Maven cache write-back skipped`, with the job green.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: `sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes as queue ticket 257 (fast)` — no Maven ran. After (pinned by tests): the suite runs unlocked from the job-local repository; a failed write-back acquisition logs `Maven cache write-back skipped` and exits 0. N/A for UI.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux sandbox with Node 22. No Java/MySQL toolchain is available, so the ECS pool path is pending CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the seed adds a hardlink copy to each self-hosted leg; the MariaDB lane already uses the same pattern. Under contention the write-back can be skipped, so the next job re-resolves some artifacts.
- Not validated / out of scope: the real ECS host-lock queue and the Java/MySQL suites; no Java toolchain here, so CI is the final gate. The 5400 s budget and the `lock not acquired within` substring are unchanged.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Design docs: [English](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.md) and [中文](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15278

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

自托管的 Java 测试 job 现在从宿主机缓存播种的 job 本地仓库解析 Maven 依赖，在不再持有每主机锁的情况下运行 sdk-java 和 managed-agent 套件，仅在可选的缓存写回时取锁。写回时预算内拿不到锁的，现在只记录警告并跳过复制，而不是让套件已经通过的 step 失败；MariaDB 集成通道的写回也适用同一规则。

## 为什么需要

Managed Agent gate 在 main 的 `6fb149d6d8fd` 上、任何 Java 测试运行之前就失败了。fast 档 job 的两次尝试都作为 sdk-java 宿主锁队列的队首等满了 5400 秒 —— 票据 239 和 257，位于两台不同主机 —— 注解写的是 `sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes`。测试 job 把锁持在 925 秒的套件之上，因此某个很长的兄弟持锁饿死了 fast 档，随后 gate 因 suite 失败。锁队列在整个 ECS 池上共享，所以再次提高等待预算只会降低概率。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

- 检查两个取锁 step：所有 Maven 命令都在取锁之前；step 用 `cp -aln` 播种 `${RUNNER_TEMP}/m2-repo` 并传入 `-Dmaven.repo.local`；写回在套件之后，且其子进程关闭 fd 9。
- 运行 `npx vitest run scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/sdk-java-lock.test.js scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js`。删除任一尽力而为保护或任一裸锁回退赋值，新增的跳过测试就会失败。
- 在 ECS 池上，fast 档 job 应立即启动 Maven；繁忙或过期的宿主锁只应产生 `Maven cache write-back skipped`，job 保持绿色。

### 证据（Before & After）

Before：`sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes as queue ticket 257 (fast)` —— Maven 没有运行。After（由测试钉住）：套件从 job 本地仓库无锁运行；写回取锁失败时记录 `Maven cache write-back skipped` 并以 0 退出。UI 变更：N/A。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

Linux 沙箱，Node 22。没有 Java/MySQL 工具链，因此 ECS 池路径待 CI 验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：播种会给每个自托管 leg 增加一次硬链接复制；MariaDB 通道已经在使用同一模式。竞争下写回可能被跳过，下一个 job 需要重新解析部分依赖。
- 未验证 / 范围外：真实 ECS 宿主锁队列和 Java/MySQL 套件；本环境没有 Java 工具链，因此 CI 是最终 gate。5400 秒预算和 `lock not acquired within` 子串保持不变。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.md) 和 [中文](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 issue

Fixes #15278

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): respect read-only files and hard links in user file writes
prs.body:
## What this PR does

User-facing file writes now check that an existing destination is writable before committing. For a destination with multiple hard links, they write in place so every name continues to share the updated content. This policy applies to local file editing and the sandbox file worker, while internal state retains its existing atomic replacement behavior.

## Why it's needed

Renaming a temporary file over a destination only consults the directory's permissions, so it can replace a read-only file that a plain write would refuse. It also gives the written name a new inode and leaves other hard-link names on the old content. Applying user-file policy at the file-writing boundary fixes both behaviors without preventing credential permission healing or worktree metadata recovery after an interrupted publication. Local and sandbox writes share this policy; both previously used the same atomic primitive.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Overwrite a read-only user file. Expect a permission error, unchanged content, and no temporary residue.
- Write through one of two hard-linked names, including a name outside the workspace. Expect both names to contain the new bytes, with the inode and link count preserved. Repeat through a symlink to the target.
- Repeat the byte and permission cases through the sandbox worker. A stale target or rejected commit veto must prevent the write, including the in-place hard-link path.
- Save worktree session metadata with a second hard link left from interrupted creation. Expect the saved metadata to have one link and pass strict reads; the stale alias must keep its old bytes.
- Confirm explicit credential permission healing can replace a read-only file with mode 0600, and replacing a credential symlink does not modify its read-only target.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: a real-filesystem service harness passed 8 of 11 checks. Worktree metadata remained at two links and failed strict reads after saving; asynchronous and synchronous credential healing both failed with EACCES.

After: the same scenarios against freshly built production modules pass 11 of 11 checks. Real built-CLI tool calls against a local mock model pass 3 of 3 scenarios: read-only refusal, hard-link write-through, and ordinary creation. Targeted core tests pass 500 of 500 across 11 files. Repository build, bundle, and typecheck pass; changed TypeScript files pass ESLint and formatting checks. An independent local review found no actionable technical defects.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 24.22.1, Qwen Code 0.26.2. Real local files and built sandbox worker services were exercised; no native Windows/Linux or sandbox container runtime was tested. The global qwen executable was unavailable for baseline reproduction, so the baseline used a service-level script fallback.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: hard-link writes intentionally update every name of the inode, including aliases outside the approved workspace path. They lose crash atomicity and concurrent readers may observe a partial write. This inode-wide policy needs maintainer acceptance.
- Not validated / out of scope: native Windows/Linux behavior, sandbox container enforcement, concurrent path swaps, and elimination of existing TOCTOU windows. The Windows EPERM-to-EACCES mapping has mocked unit coverage; chmod-based cases visibly skip where permission bits are not enforced, including Windows and privileged root environments.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: read-only user-file replacements fail with a permission error. Internal atomic-write defaults, credential options, worktree publication and strict checks, delegated ACP/managed filesystem contracts, daemon routes, and CI remain unchanged from main.

Design: [English](https://github.com/wangyu-geek/qwen-code/blob/fix/atomic-write-readonly-hardlinks/docs/design/2026-10-28-user-file-write-policy.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/wangyu-geek/qwen-code/blob/fix/atomic-write-readonly-hardlinks/docs/design/2026-10-28-user-file-write-policy.zh-CN.md)

prs.title: feat(serve): add user-scope Skill activation routes
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds two daemon routes that enable or disable Skills in the **user** settings scope, which every workspace merges: `PUT /skills/:name/activation` and `PUT /skills/activation` (batch, up to 100 names). Like `PUT /extensions/activation`, they take no workspace selector. The body is `{ state: "enabled" | "disabled", mode?: "hard" | "default" }`; `mode` applies to disables only. Each request leaves the name in exactly one user list: a `hard` disable (the default) writes `skills.disabled`, a `default` disable writes `skills.defaultDisabled`, and an enable writes `skills.enabled`; the name is removed from the other two.

An enable is refused without writing, answering `200` with `changed: false` and a `block` naming the entry, when the merged config would still keep the Skill disabled: a System/SystemDefaults `skills.disabled` entry under either spelling, a User entry in the other spelling, or a `skills.defaultDisabled` entry no identically spelled grant cancels. Workspace entries never refuse a user write; they keep gating only their own workspace. Batch enables recheck refused names until the batch converges, so the outcome does not depend on request order.

After a change, every registered workspace runtime is reconciled and each changed key emits `settings_changed` with `scope: "user"` and the existing `skill_toggle` mutation object on every workspace event stream. To make the change reach live sessions, `workspaceSkillsRefresh` gains an optional `settingsScopes` parameter: user writes ask the ACP child and its sessions to re-read the user file as well, while every other refresh keeps re-reading only the workspace file. The runtime coordinator keeps that user reload pending until a refresh carrying it succeeds.

The routes are advertised as `user_skill_activation`, with `DaemonClient.setUserSkillActivation` / `setUserSkillsActivation` in the TypeScript SDK and documentation in the serve protocol and capabilities docs.

## Why it's needed

The daemon could only toggle Skills in workspace settings. Hosts that manage Skills across workspaces (for example an embedding product that centrally enables or disables Skills for a user) had no API for the user settings file: the generic `/workspace/settings` route rejects `skills.*`, so they wrote `~/.qwen/settings.json` directly. That bypasses the daemon's settings lock (risking lost updates against other user-scope writers), duplicates the block/spelling rules, and never reaches running sessions, because the Skills refresh only re-read the workspace file. These routes give a supported, locked, consistently validated write path that also applies to live sessions.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start `qwen serve` and check `GET /capabilities` lists `user_skill_activation`.
2. `PUT /skills/<name>/activation` with `{"state":"disabled"}`: `~/.qwen/settings.json` gains `skills.disabled: ["<name>"]`; a live session's command list drops the Skill; every workspace stream receives `settings_changed` with `scope: "user"`.
3. Repeat with `{"state":"disabled","mode":"default"}`: the name moves to `skills.defaultDisabled`; a workspace `skills.enabled` entry with the same spelling re-enables it in that workspace only.
4. `{"state":"enabled"}`: the name moves to `skills.enabled`. Add `skills.disabled: ["<name>"]` to System settings and repeat: the response is `changed: false` with `block.scope: "System"` and the file is untouched.
5. Unit tests:
   - `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/config/skill-settings.test.ts src/serve/routes/workspace-skills.test.ts src/serve/workspace-runtime-coordinator.test.ts src/serve/run-qwen-serve.test.ts src/serve/capability-parity.test.ts`
   - `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/acpAgent.test.ts -t skill`
   - `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/server.test.ts -t "serve capability registry"`
   - `cd packages/sdk-typescript && npx vitest run test/unit/DaemonClient.test.ts`

Locally all of the above pass, along with `tsc --noEmit` for `packages/cli` and `packages/sdk-typescript`, eslint, and prettier. A full `src/serve/server.test.ts` run shows one or two different unrelated failures per run under load; the same happens on an unmodified `origin/main`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (daemon API; covered by the unit tests above).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only (vitest) on macOS, Node 26.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a `hard` user disable cannot be lifted by any workspace, which is the existing meaning of a user `skills.disabled` entry; callers that want per-workspace opt-in use `mode: "default"`. Re-reading the user file in live sessions now happens only when a user Skill write requests it, so other user settings edited behind those sessions are picked up at the same time.
- Not validated / out of scope: no read route for user-scope Skill lists (reads stay workspace-scoped); `skills.disabledLevels` and `skills.directories` are not writable through these routes; no Managed Agent equivalent (recorded in the capability parity matrix).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. New routes and an optional refresh parameter; existing routes and refresh behavior are unchanged.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增两个 daemon 路由，用于在**用户级** settings（所有工作区都会合并的那一层）中启用或禁用 Skill：`PUT /skills/:name/activation` 和 `PUT /skills/activation`（批量，最多 100 个名字）。与 `PUT /extensions/activation` 一样，它们不带工作区选择器。请求体为 `{ state: "enabled" | "disabled", mode?: "hard" | "default" }`，`mode` 只对禁用生效。每次请求后该名字只会出现在一个用户级名单中：`hard` 禁用（默认）写入 `skills.disabled`，`default` 禁用写入 `skills.defaultDisabled`，启用写入 `skills.enabled`，并从另外两个名单中移除。

当合并后的配置仍会让该 Skill 保持禁用时，启用请求会被拒绝且不写文件，返回 `200`、`changed: false` 以及指明具体条目的 `block`：System/SystemDefaults 中任一拼写的 `skills.disabled` 条目、User 中另一种拼写的条目，或没有同拼写授权可以抵消的 `skills.defaultDisabled` 条目。工作区条目从不拒绝用户级写入，它们只继续约束各自的工作区。批量启用会对被拒绝的名字反复重查直到收敛，因此结果与请求顺序无关。

发生变更后，所有已注册的工作区 runtime 都会 reconcile，每个变更的 key 会在每个工作区的事件流上发出带 `scope: "user"` 和现有 `skill_toggle` mutation 对象的 `settings_changed`。为了让变更作用到运行中的会话，`workspaceSkillsRefresh` 新增可选参数 `settingsScopes`：用户级写入会要求 ACP 子进程及其会话同时重读用户级文件，其他刷新仍然只重读工作区文件。runtime coordinator 会一直保留这次用户级重读请求，直到某次携带它的刷新成功。

这些路由以 `user_skill_activation` 能力标签发布，TypeScript SDK 提供 `DaemonClient.setUserSkillActivation` / `setUserSkillsActivation`，并更新了 serve 协议文档与 capabilities 文档。

## 为什么需要

此前 daemon 只能在工作区 settings 中切换 Skill。需要跨工作区管理 Skill 的宿主（例如为用户统一启停 Skill 的嵌入式产品）没有操作用户级 settings 文件的 API：通用的 `/workspace/settings` 路由会拒绝 `skills.*`，于是它们只能直接写 `~/.qwen/settings.json`。这样绕过了 daemon 的 settings 锁（可能与其他用户级写入互相覆盖），重复实现了锁定与拼写规则，而且永远不会作用到运行中的会话，因为 Skill 刷新只重读工作区文件。这两个路由提供了受支持、加锁、校验一致，并且能作用到运行中会话的写入路径。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 启动 `qwen serve`，确认 `GET /capabilities` 包含 `user_skill_activation`。
2. 对 `PUT /skills/<name>/activation` 发送 `{"state":"disabled"}`：`~/.qwen/settings.json` 中出现 `skills.disabled: ["<name>"]`；运行中会话的命令列表不再包含该 Skill；每个工作区的事件流都收到 `scope: "user"` 的 `settings_changed`。
3. 改为发送 `{"state":"disabled","mode":"default"}`：该名字移到 `skills.defaultDisabled`；某个工作区中同拼写的 `skills.enabled` 条目只会在该工作区重新启用它。
4. 发送 `{"state":"enabled"}`：该名字移到 `skills.enabled`。在 System settings 中加入 `skills.disabled: ["<name>"]` 后重复：响应为 `changed: false` 且 `block.scope: "System"`，文件不变。
5. 单元测试：
   - `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/config/skill-settings.test.ts src/serve/routes/workspace-skills.test.ts src/serve/workspace-runtime-coordinator.test.ts src/serve/run-qwen-serve.test.ts src/serve/capability-parity.test.ts`
   - `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/acpAgent.test.ts -t skill`
   - `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/server.test.ts -t "serve capability registry"`
   - `cd packages/sdk-typescript && npx vitest run test/unit/DaemonClient.test.ts`

本地以上全部通过，`packages/cli` 与 `packages/sdk-typescript` 的 `tsc --noEmit`、eslint、prettier 也通过。完整运行 `src/serve/server.test.ts` 时，在负载下每次会出现一到两条不同的无关失败；在未修改的 `origin/main` 上同样如此。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A（daemon API，由上述单元测试覆盖）。

### 测试平台

|     系统     | 状态 |
| :----------: | :--: |
|   🍏 macOS   |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows  |  ⚠️  |
|   🐧 Linux   |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

仅在 macOS、Node 26 上运行单元测试（vitest）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：`hard` 用户级禁用无法被任何工作区解除，这本就是用户级 `skills.disabled` 条目的既有含义；需要按工作区单独开启的调用方应使用 `mode: "default"`。运行中会话重读用户级文件只在用户级 Skill 写入请求时发生，因此在这些会话背后编辑的其他用户级设置也会同时生效。
- 未验证或范围外：没有读取用户级 Skill 名单的路由（读取仍按工作区）；`skills.disabledLevels` 与 `skills.directories` 不能通过这些路由写入；没有 Managed Agent 对应能力（已记录在 capability parity 矩阵中）。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无。仅新增路由和一个可选的刷新参数，现有路由与刷新行为不变。

无。

prs.title: fix(cli): honor slow-host timeout for command budget test
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Uses the existing slow-host policy for the per-run command-budget test: 60 seconds on ECS or a saturated host, and the existing 30 seconds otherwise. The test's assertions, 256-command boundary, cancellation checks, and pending-write cleanup stay unchanged. Prettier reflows the affected test invocation.

## Why it's needed

The explicit 30-second deadline overrides the CLI suite's 60-second ECS setting. The reported CI run failed this test after 30 seconds while 44,089 other tests passed. The current fixture has already been optimized upstream; this change addresses the remaining deadline override, without claiming that the original timeout necessarily reproduces on current main.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

On an ECS runner, the collected per-test deadline should be 60 seconds. On an unsaturated non-ECS host, it should remain 30 seconds rather than falling to the package's 15-second default. The 256th command must still be admitted and the following command refused with `budget_exhausted`, without adding a record.

### Evidence (Before & After)

A read-only Vitest reporter on the actual test recorded a 60,000 ms package timeout but a 30,000 ms test timeout before the fix. Afterward it recorded 60,000 ms for ECS and 30,000 ms for an unsaturated non-ECS host; the deadline assertion changed from failing to passing. The full target file plus the slow-host helper tests passed (54/54). The original behavioral test also passed locally before the fix: the reproduced defect is the configured deadline mismatch, not a local 30-second wall-clock timeout.

Validation: clean install/build, repository-wide `lint:ci`, repository-wide typecheck, and the focused 54-test run passed. Full `npm run preflight` was attempted but did not pass: the CLI suite reported 17 failures in the unchanged standalone-update tests. I interrupted the remaining full suite after that failure and reproduced two representative smoke-test timeout failures both with this patch and with the upstream version restored. The remaining workspace tests and the final serve-bundle check were not completed.

N/A — no product UI change.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| macOS | ✅ |
| Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| Linux | ⚠️ Not run locally; original CI failure logs inspected |

### Environment

Node 26.7.0, pnpm 11.24.0, macOS arm64. ECS classification was exercised with `RUNNER_NAME=ecs-qwen-reproduction`; low-load OS readings were controlled for the ordinary-host branch.

## Risk & Scope

- A genuine hang on a slow host may take 30 seconds longer to fail. The test remains bounded.
- This does not guarantee completion under arbitrary host contention.
- Test-only; no production behavior or migration change.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15216. Related to #15168; #15175 currently changes the separate monitor-loop test.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 改动

让每次运行的命令预算测试使用现有慢主机策略：ECS 或负载饱和主机为 60 秒，其他主机保留原有 30 秒。断言、256 条命令边界、取消检查和待完成写入的清理均保持不变。Prettier 重排了受影响的测试调用格式。

## 原因

显式的 30 秒超时覆盖了 CLI 测试集的 ECS 60 秒配置。报告中的 CI 在其他 44,089 个测试通过时，由该用例的 30 秒超时导致失败。上游已经优化了当前 fixture；本修改只解决剩余的超时覆盖，不声称当前 main 必然重现原始超时。

## 审阅验证

ECS 主机上收集到的用例超时应为 60 秒；普通低负载主机应保留 30 秒，而不是降至包默认的 15 秒。第 256 条命令仍应被接受，下一条命令仍应以 `budget_exhausted` 拒绝，且不新增记录。

只读 Vitest reporter 在修复前记录到包超时 60,000 ms、用例超时 30,000 ms；修复后 ECS 为 60,000 ms、普通低负载主机为 30,000 ms，deadline 断言由失败转为通过。完整目标文件及慢主机 helper 测试 54/54 通过。原行为用例修复前在本机也通过：复现的是配置不一致，而不是本机 30 秒墙钟超时。无产品界面变化。

验证：干净安装/构建、全仓 `lint:ci`、全仓类型检查、相关 54 个测试通过。已尝试完整 `npm run preflight`，但未通过：CLI 测试集在未修改的 standalone-update 测试中报告 17 个失败，随后中止了剩余全仓测试。抽取两个代表性 smoke-test 超时用例，在补丁版本和恢复上游版本后均复现相同失败。剩余工作区测试及最后的 serve-bundle 检查未完成。

在 macOS arm64、Node 26.7.0、pnpm 11.24.0 下验证。通过 `RUNNER_NAME=ecs-qwen-reproduction` 覆盖 ECS 分支，并控制低负载 OS 读数验证普通主机分支。未在 Windows/Linux 本地执行；已核对原 Linux CI 失败日志。

## 风险与范围

真正挂起的测试在慢主机上可能晚 30 秒失败，但仍有明确上限。不能保证任意负载下都能完成。仅修改测试，无产品行为或迁移变更。

修复 #15216，关联 #15168；#15175 当前修改的是另一个 monitor-loop 测试。

</details>

prs.title: feat(cua): enable default cursor and live macOS PiP
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Enable the native agent cursor by default for same-process Node SDK, Node REPL and main-thread MCP hosts, with a live local macOS preview of each session’s two most recently observed authorized windows. The independent, borderless floating window starts near the lower-right and can be moved by dragging a card or its Move preview handle. Cards share a width while retaining each source’s aspect ratio; hovering an exposed rear card brings it forward with an interruptible transition. Close and move controls appear on hover, and the close button remains accessible while hidden. Preview controls preserve foreground focus and never forward input to source applications. Queued redraws preserve the existing preview while a newer frame is pending; explicit invalidation and owner cleanup still close it. Rear-card hover now promotes once per entry, so small pointer movements during the transition cannot repeatedly reverse the cards. Hosted save controls resolve through their enclosing sheet; semicolon-free code cells remain valid, and oversized desktop PNGs use JPEG without changing pixel coordinates.

## Why it's needed

The same-process SDK disabled the cursor, while the experimental preview displayed a post-action screenshot and could bypass cursor startup. Continuous local feedback should show ongoing application updates between actions, without adding a preview process, transporting frames over the network, authorizing sibling windows by PID alone, or extending the original authorization lifetime. Native cursor and preview share the host’s main-thread UI facility and clear only their owning state on shutdown or reset. Real Keynote testing also exposed repeated card promotions, generated code-cell syntax errors and hosted save-control refusals that prevented task completion.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. On a macOS desktop with the host’s existing Accessibility and Screen Recording grants, observe two applications of different window proportions. Expect separate rounded cards with equal widths, natural source proportions, a transparent surrounding area and no permanent preview title bar. The initial position should be near the lower-right. Enter full-screen in a source application; the preview should remain auxiliary without activating its host or becoming the full-screen primary.
2. Move the real pointer over the preview and across an exposed rear card. Expect floating controls, a smooth front-card switch, continuity when reversing during movement, and controls fading after exit. After dragging, perform repeated observations while the preview refreshes; its native panel and dragged position should remain stable. Small pointer movements within the rear slot should cause one promotion until the pointer leaves or enters the front destination. Drag a card and the Move preview handle; live refresh and later source reordering should retain the chosen panel position.
3. Perform a normal background application click. Expect the real button effect, the native cursor and its matching preview projection while physical pointer and foreground remain unchanged. Clicking or dragging preview contents should affect only the local preview. Clicking a transparent gap should neither deliver input to the underlying application nor activate it. Close it through the visible X and its hidden accessible close control.
4. Keep two SDK owners active, close and recreate one, then close both. Expect distinct default placement and independent cleanup. In the real Node REPL, reset and recreate the kernel; the old process and its UI should disappear. Starting with `--no-overlay --no-pip` should preserve observation with no native UI surface. Normal MCP proxy/service and direct mode should provide the same default behavior.

5. Open the Save sheet for a new test document. Use fresh accessibility controls to change its filename and save under a new basename in a known test directory. Expect the field readback, sheet closure and a valid new Keynote file, without selecting a sibling window or overwriting another file.
6. Use ordinary semicolon-free Computer Use calls after prior variable declarations in the persistent REPL. Expect successful execution. Capture a large desktop image; if its PNG exceeds the model image budget, expect JPEG delivery at the same dimensions and coordinate mapping.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: same-process SDK construction disabled the cursor, and the optional preview received only post-action images. The earlier native preview also had a permanent header and opaque rectangular canvas. The global CLI baseline had Computer Use disabled and returned HTTP404 before tool execution; it is an environment baseline, not visual acceptance.

Initial acceptance at 0575c92: all six macOS entry/opt-out groups passed native acceptance on that artifact: typed SDK, default MCP proxy/service, direct MCP, high-level API, real Node REPL and explicit UI opt-out. Independent pixels and native input/window/AX receipts verify borderless cards, hover/fade/rapid switching, both drag paths, retained position, transparent-gap input isolation, hidden and visible close, background input invariants, live idle refresh, owner isolation and reset/recreation. The final typed recording covers the full interaction and12-second zero-call idle phases; a separate real Node REPL recording verifies24seconds with no js/MCP requests and cursor idle fade. All43 task-owned PIDs exited and both dedicated sockets were unowned. The separate E2E report records the exact artifacts, observations and limits.

Initial source validation at 0575c92: complete workspace build and typecheck, bundle, Rust core653/653, focused macOS PiP14/14 and configuration3/3, SDK68 passed with1 Electron smoke skipped by its prerequisite gate, kernel manager68/68 and release workflow6/6. The new default-owner and transition-clock regressions were first reproduced by failing tests. Independent native AX observation caught and verified the correction of image/button role semantics. Two clean source self-audit passes and final independent code review completed; native acceptance is recorded separately.

Save/hover regression acceptance at e7b544e (before the queued-frame follow-up): the real public Node REPL MCP captured the same hosted Keynote Save sheet at 1760×896, matching 880×448 points at 2x, and fresh AX actions saved a new valid 503,783-byte Keynote document. The same global CUA session displayed two real document cards. Independent 30-second recording and AX/window receipts verified one promotion during small rear-slot pointer movements, re-entry switching, panel dragging, visible close and reset cleanup. No extra SDK owner was substituted for this dual-card check. The separate follow-up E2E comment records artifacts, environment recovery and the remaining unconfirmed input paths.

Source checks at2595d1ea26: workspace build and typecheck, bundle for the unchanged production code, Rust core 654/654, macOS 512 passed / 2 ignored, Node REPL 253/253 across 22 files, focused ESLint, Prettier and cargo formatting passed. The earlier full Node run had one unexplained kernel exit; the affected file passed 68/68 on retry and the final complete 253-test run passed. Two clean self-audit passes and independent source review found no remaining defects; the final test-only lint correction was reviewed separately.

Review follow-up at9ff27926fe: a deterministic publish → observe → queued-draw regression failed before the fix and now retains the original panel; explicit invalidation still closes it. The independent source/callback harness passes17/17, focused native PiP tests16/16, full macOS library513passed/2ignored and Rust core654/654. Workspace build, typecheck, bundle, native release build, release meta-tests164passed/3skipped and independent source review passed after merging main127c2ab904. Fresh GUI smoke remains NOT_VERIFIED: the reused test fixture and a clean source-built fixture both received SIGKILL before their first event, before any SDK host, capture or input ran. The clean fixture passed strict signature verification, so the termination cause remains unknown; no new GUI pass is inferred from this round.

CI resync at 890cb0349a: merged main 9acb3a5a1d after the lint lane correctly rejected a newly outdated gate. Only upstream CI/release workflow files and their tests changed; all product sources and designs remain identical to 9ff27926fe. Changed workflow meta-tests pass 178 with 5 skipped, and freshness helper tests pass 9/9. New-head CI is tracked separately.

Product review follow-up at 3f34443bd0: the preview now requests only the named AppKit FullScreenAuxiliary role, removing the conflicting Primary role. Its regression was RED before the fix and GREEN afterward. Complete macOS library tests (514 passed / 2 ignored), workspace build/typecheck, native release build, formatting/reference checks and independent source review passed. The docs now state persistent disabling with existing CLI precedence and desktop-sharing visibility. Actual full-screen presentation and sharing output remain NOT_VERIFIED. Release ordering: merge the aligned version sources, publish the native 0.27.0 release and matching SDK/browser/Node REPL npm packages, then use the documented installation commands; this PR performs no publication.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Current source checks; ⚠️ new-head GUI smoke unverified (prior GUI evidence above) |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Native GUI not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Native GUI not tested |

### Environment

Local macOS26.5 ARM64, Node.js22.23.1 and native0.27.0 release artifacts. Tests use isolated native/Node runtimes, owned fixture applications and a dedicated MCP service/socket. Permissions were refreshed through normal System Settings for the exact rebuilt executable; no TCC database, signing identity, entitlement, installed shared daemon or global client configuration was replaced.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk: native event dispatch, animation and continuous capture timing. In the Keynote regression run, Cmd-Shift-G and one background coordinate click returned sent-unconfirmed without an observed effect; AX filename editing and AX Save were independently verified. Rebuilt native libraries require a fresh tool runtime; normal MCP disable/enable recovered a stale capture connection without changing permissions. Main-thread ownership covers nested dragging, animation timers stop before close, and shutdown waits for actual capture and UI cleanup receipts.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows/Linux native GUI, physical multiple-display cases, third-window eviction and permission-revocation hardware cases, the system Reduced Motion GUI branch, native Wayland, Windows/Linux PiP, remote frame transport and model benchmarks. The existing macOS background application/window drag refusal remains unchanged. No snapping, saved placement or source-input forwarding is added.
- Migration: native, SDK, browser SDK and Node REPL references align at0.27.0, a development target until separately released. PiP geometry specifies maximum card size and optional initial origin. Canonical macOS Node SDK construction requires the main thread and rejects Workers before native UI initialization. Raw Rust/Python embedding remains UI-disabled by default unless its host supplies a main-thread UI facility. No merge or release is part of this PR.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/3f34443bd07f7bd9d953914040d8c9b9d500dc29/docs/design/cua-cursor-pip.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/3f34443bd07f7bd9d953914040d8c9b9d500dc29/docs/design/cua-cursor-pip.zh-CN.md), complete and synchronized.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本PR的改动

为同进程Node SDK、Node REPL与主线程MCP宿主默认启用原生虚拟鼠标，并在macOS实时预览每个session最近成功授权观察的两个窗口。独立无边框浮窗默认位于右下方，可通过卡片或Move preview手柄拖动。两卡等宽并保留各自来源比例；鼠标进入后卡露出区域时，以可打断的动画将其移到前面。关闭与移动控件在hover时出现，关闭按钮隐藏时仍可通过辅助功能访问。预览控件保持前台焦点，不向来源应用转发输入。排队绘制在等待新画面时保留现有预览，明确失效与owner清理仍会关闭它。后卡悬停现在每次进入只提升一次，切换期间的小幅鼠标移动不会反复翻转卡片。托管保存控件通过外层Sheet确定归属；无分号代码单元保持有效，过大的桌面PNG改用JPEG且不改变像素坐标。

## 改动原因

同进程SDK原先禁用cursor，实验性预览只显示动作后的截图，还可能绕过cursor启动。持续的本地反馈应在动作之间显示应用更新，不新增预览进程、不向网络传输帧、不因PID相同而授权其他窗口，也不延长原有授权寿命。原生cursor与预览共用宿主主线程UI设施，在shutdown或reset时只清理各自owner的状态。真实Keynote测试还发现卡片反复提升、生成的代码单元语法错误及托管保存控件被拒绝，导致任务无法完成。

## Reviewer验收计划

### 如何验证

1. 在已为宿主授予辅助功能与录屏权限的macOS桌面上，观察两个宽高比不同的应用窗口。应看到等宽、按来源比例展示的独立圆角卡片，周围区域透明，无常驻预览标题栏，初始位置在右下方。将来源应用切至全屏，预览应保持辅助窗口角色，不激活宿主或自身成为全屏主窗口。
2. 将真实鼠标移入预览并经过后卡露出区域。应看到浮动控件、平滑的前卡切换、运动中反向时保持连续，以及离开后控件淡出。拖动后在预览刷新期间反复观察，原生panel及拖动位置应保持稳定。后卡区域的小幅鼠标移动应只提升一次，直到指针离开或进入前卡目标区域后才允许再次提升。分别拖动卡片和Move preview手柄；实时刷新及后续来源顺序变化应保留panel位置。
3. 执行正常的后台应用点击。应产生真实按钮效果，并看到原生cursor及对应预览投影，真实鼠标与前台保持不变。点击或拖动预览内容应只操作本地浮窗。点击透明间隙也不应向下层应用发送输入或激活它。分别通过可见X和隐藏时的辅助功能关闭控件关闭它。
4. 同时保留两个SDK owner，关闭并重建其中一个，再关闭两者。应有不同的默认位置，清理相互独立。真实Node REPL的reset与重建应清除旧kernel进程及其UI。使用`--no-overlay --no-pip`启动后应正常观察且不出现原生UI。常规MCP proxy/service与direct模式应提供相同默认行为。

5. 为新的测试文稿打开保存Sheet。使用fresh辅助功能控件修改文件名，在已知测试目录保存为新名称。应读回新文件名、看到Sheet关闭，并得到有效的新Keynote文件，不选中其他窗口、不覆盖已有文件。
6. 在持久REPL中先声明变量，再执行普通的不带末尾分号的Computer Use调用，应成功执行。截取大尺寸桌面；若PNG超出模型图片预算，应以JPEG交付，尺寸和坐标映射保持一致。

### 前后证据

之前：同进程SDK构造禁用cursor，可选预览仅接收动作后图像。此前原生预览还有常驻header和不透明矩形底板。全局CLI基线关闭Computer Use，并在工具执行前返回HTTP404；这是环境基线，不是视觉验收。

初次验收（0575c92提交）：该产物的macOS六组入口及关闭UI验收通过：typed SDK、默认MCP proxy/service、direct MCP、高层API、真实Node REPL及显式关闭UI。独立像素与原生输入、窗口、AX收据验证了无边框卡片、hover/淡入淡出/快速换层、两种拖动、位置保留、透明间隙输入隔离、隐藏及可见关闭、后台输入不变、空闲实时刷新、owner隔离与reset/重建。最终typed录像覆盖完整交互及12秒零调用空闲；真实Node REPL的独立录像还验证了24秒零js/MCP请求与cursor空闲淡出。43个自有测试PID均已退出，两处专用socket均无owner。单独的E2E报告记录精确产物、观察结果与限制。

初次源码验证（0575c92提交）：完整工作区build与typecheck、bundle、Rust core653/653、macOS PiP定向14/14与配置3/3、SDK68项通过，1项Electron smoke因前置条件gate而skip、kernel manager68/68、release workflow6/6。默认多owner位置与动画时钟回归均先以失败测试复现。独立原生AX观察发现并验证了image/button角色语义修复。已完成两遍clean源码自审及最终独立代码review；原生验收另行记录。

e7b544e时的保存/hover回归验收（排队绘制修复前）：真实公开Node REPL MCP成功截取同一个托管Keynote保存Sheet，图像1760×896与880×448点的2x几何一致，fresh AX操作实际保存了新的有效503783字节Keynote文稿。同一个global CUA session显示两份真实文稿的卡片。独立30秒录像与AX、窗口收据验证了后卡区域小幅鼠标移动期间只提升一次、重入切换、panel拖动、可见关闭及reset清理。双卡检查没有替换为额外SDK owner。单独的回归E2E评论记录产物、环境恢复过程以及仍未确认生效的输入路径。

2595d1ea26时的源码检查：工作区build与typecheck、生产代码未变的bundle、Rust core 654/654、macOS512通过/2ignored、Node REPL22个文件253/253，以及定向ESLint、Prettier和cargo格式检查通过。较早一次Node全量测试有一次原因未明的kernel退出；受影响文件重跑68/68通过，最终完整253项测试也全部通过。 两遍clean自审及独立源码review均未发现剩余缺陷；最后仅涉及测试的lint修正已单独review。

9ff27926fe的review跟进：publish → observe → 排队绘制的确定性回归在修复前失败，现在保留原panel；明确失效仍会关闭它。独立源码/回调harness17/17、原生PiP定向测试16/16、macOS完整库513通过/2ignored、Rust core654/654。合入main127c2ab904后，工作区build、typecheck、bundle、原生release构建、release meta-tests164通过/3skipped及独立源码review均通过。新的GUI短测仍为NOT_VERIFIED：复用fixture和从源码洁净构建的fixture都在首个事件前收到SIGKILL，SDK宿主、捕获和输入均未执行；洁净fixture通过严格签名检查，因此终止原因仍未知。本轮不据此声称新的GUI验收通过。

890cb0349a的CI同步：lint正确发现门禁已更新后，再合入main9acb3a5a1d。仅引入上游CI/发布工作流及其测试，全部产品源码与设计文档均与9ff27926fe一致。相关工作流meta-tests178项通过、5项跳过，freshness辅助脚本9/9通过；新head的CI另行跟进。

3f34443bd0的产品review跟进：预览现在仅使用具名的AppKit FullScreenAuxiliary角色，移除冲突的Primary角色。回归测试先失败、修复后通过。macOS完整库514项通过/2ignored，工作区build与typecheck、原生release构建、格式/引用检查和独立源码review通过。文档补充持久关闭、既有CLI优先级及桌面共享可见性。真实全屏展示与共享输出仍为NOT_VERIFIED。发布顺序是先合入对齐版本的源码，再发布0.27.0原生产物及配套SDK/browser/Node REPL npm包，之后用户才能执行文档安装命令；本PR不执行发布。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 当前源码检查；⚠️ 新head的GUI短测未验证（此前GUI证据见上文） |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测原生GUI |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测原生GUI |

### 环境

本地macOS26.5 ARM64、Node.js22.23.1及原生0.27.0 release产物。测试使用隔离的native/Node runtime、自有fixture应用与独立MCP服务/socket。通过正常系统设置为精确重建的可执行文件刷新权限，没有替换TCC数据库、签名身份、entitlement、已安装共享daemon或全局客户端配置。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：原生事件派发、动画及持续捕获时序。Keynote回归中Cmd-Shift-G及一次后台坐标点击返回sent-unconfirmed且未观察到效果；AX文件名编辑与AX保存已独立验证。重建原生库后需使用新工具runtime；通过正常MCP禁用/启用恢复了旧捕获连接，没有修改权限。主线程owner覆盖嵌套拖动，动画timer在关闭前停止；shutdown等待真实capture和UI清理receipt。
- 未验证或范围外：Windows/Linux原生GUI、物理多显示器、第三窗口淘汰与撤权的真机情形、系统Reduced Motion的GUI分支、native Wayland、Windows/Linux PiP、远程帧传输和模型benchmark。现有macOS后台应用/窗口drag拒绝保持不变。不新增吸边、位置保存或来源输入透传。
- 迁移：native、SDK、browser SDK与Node REPL引用统一为0.27.0，单独发布前仍是开发目标。PiP geometry指定卡片最大尺寸及可选初始位置。macOS标准Node SDK构造要求主线程，并在原生UI初始化前拒绝Worker；原始Rust/Python embedding在宿主提供主线程UI设施前默认关闭UI。本PR不执行合并或发布。

设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/3f34443bd07f7bd9d953914040d8c9b9d500dc29/docs/design/cua-cursor-pip.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/3f34443bd07f7bd9d953914040d8c9b9d500dc29/docs/design/cua-cursor-pip.zh-CN.md)，两版完整同步。

prs.title: fix(acp-bridge): display declared Channel submissions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

For Channel-source sessions, use a nonblank original-text declaration as the display projection when the request has a text block and the turn has no channel-worker classification or worker display projection. Pending text, live user echoes, and durable recording use the original declaration verbatim, while the model still receives the complete prepared prompt.

Missing, invalid, empty, whitespace-only, and media-only submissions retain their content-derived display. An explicit worker projection keeps precedence, including an intentionally empty projection paired with a declaration. Add regression coverage for these boundaries and synchronize the [English design contract](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/channel-submitted-display/docs/design/daemon-user-prompt-submit-provenance.md) and [Chinese design contract](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/channel-submitted-display/docs/design/daemon-user-prompt-submit-provenance.zh-CN.md).

## Why it's needed

An external Channel gateway can submit model text such as `gateway instructions\nhello` and separately declare the original user text `hello` through the existing non-privileged `qwen.submittedPrompt` contract. The declaration reaches the bridge, but the user echo and transcript display the prepared wrapper. This change displays `hello` consistently without removing the instructions from model input or granting worker authority.

The declaration is a display contract, not authentication or proof of authorship. Native authenticated channel-worker history behavior and Qwen product wording remain unchanged.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Submit a prepared text prompt to a Channel-source session with a nonblank original-text declaration and no worker keys. Pending text and live user echo should match the raw declaration, including surrounding whitespace. The complete prepared prompt should still reach the model.
2. Complete the turn, stop the daemon, start a new process with the same isolated runtime, and load the session. Both load replay and transcript paging should show the declaration; persisted model content should retain the prepared text.
3. Omit the declaration or supply an invalid type, empty string, or whitespace-only string. Display should retain the prepared text. For an image-only request with a nonblank declaration, pending text should stay `[image]`, the echo should contain only the image, and private display metadata should be absent. Ordinary-source sessions should keep their original display.
4. Confirm caller-supplied private display metadata cannot select this fallback and worker-classified turns cannot acquire a declaration-based projection. An explicit worker projection should win over a declaration; an empty worker projection must still hide every text block and forward `''`.
5. Set a one-tool-call cap and use a controlled model to request another tool call from an ordinary declared Channel turn. Expect `turn_error` with `LOOP_DETECTED`, `errorKind: loop_detected`, and `loopType: turn_tool_call_cap`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The review baseline reproduced three display regressions: an empty declaration erased the live echo and durable user display while the turn-result record retained the wrapper; whitespace-only declarations replaced the display with blank space; a media-only declaration changed pending/child display metadata without adding a live text echo.

After the correction, all ten bridge cases pass. Six real daemon text cases pass live pending/echo, durable user/turn-result recording, and cold-process load plus transcript replay: 18 assertions. A separate real loop-cap assertion also passes, for 19 daemon assertions total. Every complete prepared text was observed in the mock model request and persisted intact. The worker-empty-projection control passes normally and fails an actually executed isolated `??` to `||` mutation.

Local quality checks passed: all 2,639 ACP Bridge package tests, repository typecheck, changed-file lint and Prettier checks, build, and bundle. Independent read-only review found no actionable issue. Test reports and artifact fingerprints are retained locally under `.qwen/e2e-tests/pr-13748-*` and `.qwen/issues/pr-13748-review.md`; these ignored artifacts are not included in the PR. This is protocol/recording evidence, not a browser screenshot or deployed gateway acceptance.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Local quality checks and real daemon with a mock model |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.1, pinned pnpm 11.24.0, and the rebuilt `node dist/cli.js`. The runtime test used synthetic prompts, isolated workspace/home/runtime directories, port-0 listeners, and a local mock OpenAI endpoint. The global `qwen` command was unavailable, so verification used the local bundle. Both daemon processes and the mock endpoint were stopped. CI for the newly pushed source revision must complete separately; earlier revisions do not validate this update.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: an eligible Channel caller can choose the declared display text; that text does not authenticate the caller or prove human authorship. The model still sees the full prepared prompt.
- Not validated / out of scope: external gateway integration, real provider behavior, browser rendering, historical record rewriting, and deployment. Preexisting submission-provenance forwarding remains unchanged; Session already omits blank provenance.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no new API or privileged flag. Gateway producers must explicitly declare nonblank original text beside a text-bearing prompt and omit worker classification, authorization, and private display keys to use the existing non-privileged route.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13747.

## 此 PR 的改动

对于 Channel 来源会话，当请求包含文本块、当前回合没有 channel-worker 分类或 worker 显示投影时，将非空白原文声明用于显示投影。排队文本、实时用户回显和持久录制完整保留该声明，模型仍收到完整准备后的 prompt。

缺失、非法、空串、纯空白声明及纯附件提交继续从内容取得显示文本。显式 worker 投影保持优先，包括刻意为空的投影与声明同时存在的情况。补充这些边界的回归覆盖，并同步[英文设计契约](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/channel-submitted-display/docs/design/daemon-user-prompt-submit-provenance.md)和[中文设计契约](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/channel-submitted-display/docs/design/daemon-user-prompt-submit-provenance.zh-CN.md)。

声明属于展示契约，不是认证，也不证明作者身份。原生授权 channel-worker 的历史展示行为和 Qwen 产品文案保持不变。

## 评审验收计划

### 如何验证

1. 向 Channel 来源会话提交准备后的文本 prompt 与非空白原文声明，省略所有 worker 键。排队文本和实时用户回显应完整保留声明及其空白，模型仍应收到完整准备后的 prompt。
2. 完成回合后退出 daemon，以相同隔离 runtime 启动新进程并加载会话。load 重放与 transcript 分页都应显示声明，持久模型内容仍应保留准备后的文本。
3. 省略声明，或提供非法类型、空串、纯空白字符串，显示应保留准备后的文本。纯图片请求即使带有非空白声明，排队文本仍应为 `[image]`，回显只包含图片，且不附加私有显示元数据。普通来源会话保留原有展示。
4. 确认调用方自报的私有显示字段不能选择此回退，已分类的 worker 回合也不能取得声明投影。显式 worker 投影应优先于声明；空 worker 投影仍须隐藏所有文本块，并转发 `''`。
5. 设置单回合工具调用上限为一次，让受控模型在普通声明 Channel 回合继续请求工具调用。预期收到 `turn_error`，包含 `LOOP_DETECTED`、`errorKind: loop_detected` 和 `loopType: turn_tool_call_cap`。

评审基线复现了三项展示回归：空声明隐藏实时回显和持久用户展示，但回合结果记录仍保留包装文本；纯空白声明将展示替换为空白；纯附件声明改变排队项和子进程显示元数据，却没有增加实时文本回显。

修正后，十项 bridge 场景全部通过。六项真实 daemon 文本场景通过实时排队与回显、持久用户与回合结果录制、冷进程 load 与 transcript 重放，共十八项断言；独立执行的真实工具调用上限断言也通过，daemon 共十九项断言。模拟模型实际请求和持久记录都完整保留了准备后的文本。空 worker 投影控制用例正常通过，实际执行隔离的 `??` 改为 `||` 变异后则失败。

本地质量检查通过：ACP Bridge 包全部 2,639 项测试、仓库类型检查、改动文件 lint 与 Prettier 检查、构建及打包。独立只读评审未发现可行动问题。测试报告及制品指纹保留在本地 `.qwen/e2e-tests/pr-13748-*` 和 `.qwen/issues/pr-13748-review.md`，这些被忽略的制品不包含在 PR 中。上述属于协议与录制证据，不代表浏览器截图或已部署网关验收。

### 已验证平台

| 平台 | 状态 |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 本地质量检查与使用模拟模型的真实 daemon 验证 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未执行本地验证 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未执行本地验证 |

### 环境

Node 22.23.1、固定版本 pnpm 11.24.0，以及重新构建的 `node dist/cli.js`。运行时测试使用合成消息、隔离的 workspace/home/runtime 目录、自动分配端口的监听及本地模拟 OpenAI 服务。全局 `qwen` 命令不可用，因此使用本地 bundle 验证。两个 daemon 进程和模拟服务均已停止。新推送 source revision 的 CI 须单独完成，旧 revision 的结果不能验证本次更新。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：符合条件的 Channel 调用方可选择声明的显示文本；该文本不认证调用方，也不证明内容由人撰写。模型仍会收到完整准备后的 prompt。

- 兼容性与迁移：不新增 API 或特权标记。网关生产方须在包含文本的 prompt 之外显式声明非空白原文，并省略 worker 分类、授权和私有显示键，才能使用既有非特权路由。

Fixes #13747。

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): support opt-in same-context Java embedding
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds opt-in Managed Agent embedding in a Java host's existing JVM and Spring application context. Hosts can use a dedicated Managed Agent connection pool or explicitly supply its DataSource. Native journal callbacks are separately enabled and retain writer-credential authentication; Harness and Worker processes remain separate.

Separates the ordinary Maven dependency from the executable `exec` classifier and updates standalone launch, container, reference-package and release consumers. Managed infrastructure is qualified so it does not silently select unrelated host database or transaction beans.

## Why it's needed

Applications need to call the control plane directly without running a separate Managed Agent Server for Java service calls. A reusable dependency needs explicit activation, persistence ownership and protocol boundaries while preserving standalone behavior.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Adding the dependency alone should not initialize Managed Agent persistence or expose its controllers. Explicit core import should start in the host context with dedicated configuration or a named supplied DataSource.
- In a multi-database host, managed writes and rollback should use the selected managed database; unrelated host transactions should remain unchanged. Closing the context should close an owned pool without adding a second close of a borrowed pool.
- Internal callbacks should reject forged writer credentials and preserve protocol JSON independently of host JSON naming settings. Standalone 404/405 responses should retain their error envelopes.
- Standalone should honor existing Druid settings and reject non-loopback plaintext Harness transport by default. Runtime consumers should select the executable artifact while Maven dependency consumers receive the ordinary jar.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: standalone executable packaging and implicit infrastructure selection were not a supported same-context embedding contract.

After: 41 focused Java tests passed on Linux, including core/internal embedding, dedicated and supplied persistence, rollback, Druid binding, Harness transport policy, container selection, and existing standalone 404/405 dispatch checks. Separately, 90 targeted script/workflow tests and 24 reference-packaging tests passed. Checkstyle and normal Git pre-commit hooks (Prettier/ESLint) passed. No TUI changes; visual evidence is N/A.

Current head `e84588384a8ea90a28a3b9604e6b8994a425835b`: on macOS, 32 focused H2 and callback tests passed, as did 29 targeted MySQL 8.4 tests after correcting a fixture clock qualifier. The ordinary and executable JARs were packaged and installed in an isolated Maven repository; a separate host passed its dependency-only and enabled embedding tests. Checkstyle and SpotBugs passed. The callback filter was narrowed to avoid intercepting host public routes. The broader MySQL profile was stopped after 131 completed tests passed when the fixture error recurred; it was not completed. A subsequent JaCoCo report failed on corrupted data from that interruption; reruns skipped JaCoCo, so coverage reporting is unverified. Current-head CI is pending.

Current head `829855ebce36cf933faad47030b0c605efb72346`: maintenance artifacts retain application configuration, standalone maintenance contexts have a Druid DataSource, documented local jar paths select the executable artifact, and embedded publication validates the URL. Eleven focused tests and three artifact checks passed; normal package, central-release and explicit `managed.operator-tools.attach=false` installs succeeded. The real operator jar reached an intentionally missing state-directory boundary with the documented environment variables; the retirement launcher reached argument validation. Neither proves a complete maintenance operation. JaCoCo was skipped and current-head CI remains pending. With `managed.operator-tools.attach=false`, maintenance jars are now not generated locally rather than generated without attachment; external scripts relying on those local files may need adjustment.

The earlier local automated review engine timed out after 300 seconds without a verdict and remains **UNVERIFIED**.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Focused Java, packaging, independent host and targeted MySQL tests |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ Focused Java and script tests |

### Environment (optional)

Java 21, Maven 3.9.9, Node.js 22, isolated H2 fixtures. No shared database or deployed service was used for these checks.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Spring configuration composition, transaction selection and standalone/runtime artifact compatibility. Host-specific authentication and global advice still need deliberate integration.
- Not validated / out of scope: complete MySQL profile, coverage report, root build/typecheck, full CI, real Harness/Worker execution and durable drain. Earlier revision results are not claimed as current-head passes.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the unclassified jar becomes the library dependency; direct `java -jar` consumers must use the `exec` classifier. Existing downloadable runtime filenames remain unchanged. Maven publication still requires the normal release workflow; merging this PR alone does not publish a version.

## Linked Issues

Related to #15652. This does not claim completion of all end-to-end integration acceptance.

当前 head `e84588384a8ea90a28a3b9604e6b8994a425835b`：macOS 上 32 项 H2 和回调定向测试通过；修正测试夹具中的时钟限定符后，29 项 MySQL 8.4 定向测试通过。普通和可执行 JAR 已在隔离 Maven 仓库中打包安装，独立宿主的仅依赖和启用内嵌测试通过。Checkstyle 与 SpotBugs 通过。内部回调过滤器已收窄，避免拦截宿主公共路由。较大 MySQL 测试集在 131 项完成通过后因测试夹具错误反复出现而中止，未完整完成。中止后 JaCoCo 数据损坏导致一次报告失败；后续重跑跳过 JaCoCo，覆盖率报告未验证。当前 head 的 CI 仍在运行。

当前 head `829855ebce36cf933faad47030b0c605efb72346`：维护制品恢复应用配置，独立维护上下文具备 Druid 数据源，本地文档改用可执行制品，内嵌模式校验 publication URL。11 项定向测试及 3 项制品检查通过；普通打包、central-release 和显式 `managed.operator-tools.attach=false` 安装成功。真实 operator jar 使用文档环境变量运行到刻意缺失的状态目录边界，retirement launcher 到达参数校验；二者均不能证明完整维护操作成功。JaCoCo 已跳过，当前 head CI 尚在运行。设置 `managed.operator-tools.attach=false` 时，现在不再在本地生成维护 JAR，而此前会生成但不附加；依赖这些本地文件的外部脚本可能需要调整。

此前本地自动评审引擎在 300 秒后超时，没有返回结论，仍为 **UNVERIFIED**。

### 测试平台

macOS：定向 Java、打包、独立宿主和 MySQL 测试通过；Windows：未测试；Linux：此前的定向 Java 和脚本测试通过。

### 环境

Java 21、Maven 3.9.9、Node.js 22、隔离 H2 测试。上述验证未使用共享数据库或已部署服务。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：Spring 装配、事务选择及独立运行制品兼容性。宿主自身认证和全局异常处理仍需明确接入。
- 未验证或范围外：完整 MySQL 测试集、覆盖率报告、根目录 build/typecheck、完整 CI、真实 Harness/Worker 执行与持久化 drain。不把旧版本结果当成当前 head 通过。

prs.title: feat(desktop): persist Web Shell catalogs across restarts
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The desktop client now keeps the Web Shell's saved daemon connections and workspace-host catalog across restarts. Both catalogs live in the desktop shell's settings file and are read through a small allowlisted IPC surface gated to the runtime origin. The browser Web Shell keeps its existing storage behavior.

## Why it's needed

The desktop shell serves the Web Shell from a bundled daemon on an ephemeral loopback port. WebView2 scopes storage by origin, so the catalogs written by one launch were unreachable on the next and users had to re-add their connections every time. This is Part 1 of #14947; credential persistence is deliberately separate.

The live restart check also found that the workspace-host catalog would record the page's own ephemeral origin once persistence existed, adding one stale host per launch. This change excludes the page origin from that catalog; the sidebar still adds it in-session.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Launch the desktop shell from this branch and add a daemon connection under Settings → Connections.
2. Restart the app. It comes back on a new loopback port, and the saved connection is still listed; Settings → Connections shows it.
3. Click × next to the connection. It disappears from the list and from `desktop-state.json`.
4. Restart twice and confirm `qwen-workspace-hosts` does not grow a `127.0.0.1:<port>` entry per launch.

Expected: the connection catalog survives restarts; the workspace-host catalog contains remote hosts only. Before this change the connection list was empty after every restart.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: after a restart the saved list was empty because both catalogs lived in origin-scoped `localStorage`.

After: a Windows debug build from this branch, with an isolated app identifier, wrote a catalog, restarted, came back on a different port, and read the catalog back; Settings → Connections showed the saved host. The same run reproduced the per-launch workspace-host growth and then verified its fix. The unit and integration checks below pass.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment

Local Tauri debug build with an isolated app identifier and profile; bundled runtime built from this branch.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the catalogs now live in `desktop-state.json`. The file is plaintext, so it must stay free of credentials; it stores addresses and workspace identities only.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS and Linux live restart checks. The full repository typecheck OOMs in `packages/cli` on this Windows machine; the `web-shell` package typecheck passes. Credential persistence, a stable shell origin, and an automated desktop E2E remain out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Browser behavior is unchanged. Migration reads only the current origin's `localStorage`; older launches cannot be recovered.

## Design docs

- [English](https://github.com/BigDaddy1337/qwen-code/blob/feat/desktop-shell-state/docs/design/2026-10-25-desktop-shell-state.md)
- [简体中文](https://github.com/BigDaddy1337/qwen-code/blob/feat/desktop-shell-state/docs/design/2026-10-25-desktop-shell-state.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

References #14947.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

桌面客户端现在会在重启后保留 Web Shell 的已保存 daemon 连接和工作区主机目录。两个目录都保存在桌面外壳的设置文件中，并通过一层小而带白名单、按运行时 origin 校验的 IPC 读取。浏览器 Web Shell 保持原有存储行为。

## 为什么需要

桌面外壳由内置 daemon 在临时回环端口上提供 Web Shell。WebView2 按 origin 隔离存储，因此一次启动写入的目录在下一次启动时无法读取，用户每次都要重新添加连接。这是 #14947 的第一部分；凭据持久化刻意分开处理。

实机重启检查还发现：一旦目录开始持久化，工作区主机目录会记录页面自身的临时 origin，每次启动都追加一个过期主机。本次改动把页面 origin 排除在该目录之外；侧边栏仍会在会话内加入它。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 从本分支启动桌面外壳，在 Settings → Connections 中添加一个 daemon 连接。
2. 重启应用。应用会以新的回环端口回来，已保存连接仍在列表中；Settings → Connections 能看到它。
3. 点击连接旁的 ×。它会从列表和 `desktop-state.json` 中消失。
4. 连续重启两次，确认 `qwen-workspace-hosts` 不会每次启动都增加一个 `127.0.0.1:<port>` 条目。

预期：连接目录能跨重启存活；工作区主机目录只包含远程主机。改动前，每次重启后连接列表都是空的。

### 证据（修改前后）

修改前：重启后已保存列表为空，因为两个目录都存放在按 origin 隔离的 `localStorage` 中。

修改后：在 Windows 上使用本分支的 debug 构建和隔离的应用 identifier，写入目录、重启、以不同端口回来并读回目录；Settings → Connections 显示了已保存主机。同一次实跑先复现了每次启动累积工作区主机的问题，随后验证了修复。下面的单元与集成检查均通过。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ✅  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境

本地 Tauri debug 构建，使用隔离的应用 identifier 与配置目录；运行时由本分支构建。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险与取舍：目录现在位于 `desktop-state.json`。该文件是明文，因此必须保持不含凭据；其中只存地址和工作区标识。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：macOS 与 Linux 的实机重启检查。在这台 Windows 机器上，完整仓库的 typecheck 会在 `packages/cli` 中 OOM；`web-shell` 包的 typecheck 通过。凭据持久化、稳定外壳 origin 与自动化的桌面端到端测试仍超出范围。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。浏览器行为不变。迁移只读取当前 origin 的 `localStorage`；更早的启动无法恢复。

## 设计文档

- [English](https://github.com/BigDaddy1337/qwen-code/blob/feat/desktop-shell-state/docs/design/2026-10-25-desktop-shell-state.md)
- [简体中文](https://github.com/BigDaddy1337/qwen-code/blob/feat/desktop-shell-state/docs/design/2026-10-25-desktop-shell-state.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

引用 #14947。

</details>

prs.title: fix(ci): pin PR retries to the triggering head SHA
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Pins the four CI lanes that run for pull requests to the head commit recorded in the triggering event, rather than resolving a moving pull-request head ref when checkout starts. The existing checkout verification remains enabled. Manual branch selection, merge-queue SHA selection and main-push SHA selection are unchanged.

This PR now targets `main` with a **CI-only three-file diff (+24/−25)**. The unrelated Managed Agent feature changes from the earlier branch have been removed from the final tree while preserving commit history; the old feature commits remain in the history but are not part of the current Files changed diff.

## Why it's needed

Re-running an older CI job retains its original expected SHA, but the pull-request ref can already point to a newer commit. A depth-one checkout of that moving ref then fails the unchanged ancestry guard before tests can begin. This occurred in [job 122328728208](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40536053683/job/122328728208), which expected `abc86cf7` after the parent PR had advanced.

The earlier npm-cache permission failure was a separate runner-environment incident. Read-only inspection found that runner's cache writable after the failure; this patch adds no permission workaround and does not claim to repair host provisioning.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Create a PR event at commit A, advance its head ref to B, then repeat checkout for the original event with depth one. The old configuration checks out B and the existing expected-A guard fails. The corrected configuration must check out exactly A and pass the same guard. A current event for B should continue to pass. Confirm all four pull-request lanes use the event SHA and keep the verification step, while manual, push and queue routing remain unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

A local real-Git reproduction used an advancing PR ref, shallow fetches and the unchanged checkout guard:

| Case | Observed result |
| :--- | :--- |
| Old moving ref, event expects A after ref advances to B | Guard exits 1 (reproduced failure) |
| Fixed event-A SHA checkout | HEAD is A, guard exits 0 |
| Current event-B moving-ref control | HEAD is B, guard exits 0 |
| Current event-B pinned-SHA control | HEAD is B, guard exits 0 |

The modified workflow contract tests were run red-first: three assertions failed before the workflow edit, then the two focused test files passed with **75 tests passed and 4 platform-specific skips**. Prettier and configured actionlint passed. Broader workflow-consumer test results and independent source review are recorded in the evidence comment.

The local CI-aligned review engine was attempted with Qwen CLI 0.25.3 and the repository's current canary model. It exited before review with HTTP 403 `Access to model denied`; that engine gate is **unverified**, not clean. Independent source review is separate evidence and does not replace it.

UI verification: **N/A**. This change selects a Git commit before dependency installation and tests; it changes neither product UI nor Managed Agent runtime behavior. The real-Git reproduction is the relevant runtime observation. Earlier Managed Agent test counts and UI screenshots do not validate this CI-only change and are not carried forward as its evidence.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--- | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Local Git reproduction, focused workflow tests, Prettier and actionlint |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not run locally; Windows lane unchanged |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Original failure observed in CI; new-head CI pending |

### Environment (optional)

A clean isolated worktree based on main `c586e00cb7a963c041a28759c3749a5e01dd4e29`, with a compatible copy-on-write dependency subset. No shared node_modules symlink or product service was used. Verification commands and raw outcomes are retained in the evidence packet.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the event SHA must remain fetchable from the PR repository. Direct SHA checkout preserves the run's identity and avoids both a stale merge ref and an advanced PR head ref; a missing commit should fail rather than test another tree.
- Not validated / out of scope: GitHub-hosted end-to-end checkout for every fork lifecycle, full repository build/test, Managed Agent functionality, runner cache provisioning. The local model-backed review gate remains unavailable because of the 403 response.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no product API, dependency or database change. Only four PR-reachable checkout expressions and existing workflow regression tests change. The currently non-PR macOS/Windows arms are untouched.

## Linked Issues

Observed while investigating CI on #15734 and #15684. [Failing job](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40536053683/job/122328728208). This CI correction does not claim to complete #15512 or repair the feature-specific #15685 product regressions.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

将四条实际运行PR的CI路径固定检出事件记录的head SHA，不再在checkout时解析会前进的PR head ref。原SHA校验继续启用；手动branch选择、merge queue SHA与main push SHA选择不变。

本PR现在以main为base，最终为 **仅CI的三文件差异（+24/−25）**。先前误带的Managed Agent功能已从最终tree移除，同时保留提交历史；旧功能提交仍存在历史中，但不属于当前Files changed差异。

## 为什么需要

旧CI重跑保留原expected SHA，而PR ref可能已经前进。depth-one检出新ref后，原ancestry校验会在测试前失败。[job122328728208](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40536053683/job/122328728208)正是在父PR已前进后仍期待abc86cf7时触发此问题。

此前npm缓存权限错误是独立runner环境事件，之后只读核查发现缓存已可写；本补丁不添加权限绕过，不声称修复host初始化。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

事件记录A后将PR ref推进到B，再对旧事件以depth one检出。旧配置得到B，expected-A guard退出1；新配置必须精确检出A，同一guard退出0。当前B事件应继续成功。核对四PR lane均固定event SHA并保留校验，手动／push／queue路径不变。

### 修改前后证据

真实本地Git复现使用前进的PR ref、浅fetch和原校验：旧ref配原A失败退出1；固定A检出HEAD=A通过0；当前B ref与固定B两项控制均HEAD=B、退出0。

先改测试做red-first，旧workflow准确失败3项断言；修workflow后两文件 **75通过、4平台跳过**。Prettier及配置下actionlint通过。更广workflow消费者测试和独立源码review结果放在证据评论。

尝试了Qwen CLI0.25.3与仓库当前canary模型的本地对齐review，但在评审前HTTP403 `Access to model denied`退出；该引擎门禁未验证，不能称clean。独立源码review是另一个证据，不冒充该引擎通过。

UI验证N/A：改动仅发生在依赖安装／测试前的Git提交选择，不改产品UI或Managed Agent运行行为；真实Git复现才是相关运行证据。此前Java217项和UI截图不再作为本CI修复证据。

### 测试平台与环境

macOS完成Git复现、聚焦workflow测试、Prettier及actionlint。Windows未本地运行，路径未修改。Linux已有原CI失败，当前修复CI待运行。隔离worktree基于main c586e00cb7a963c041a28759c3749a5e01dd4e29，使用兼容的COW依赖子集，无共享node_modules symlink、无产品服务；保留命令与原始结果。

## 风险与范围

风险是event SHA必须仍可从PR仓库fetch；固定SHA避免旧merge ref和前进head ref，提交不可用时应失败而非测试其他tree。未在GitHub逐一覆盖fork所有生命周期，未跑全仓构建测试，不涉及Managed Agent功能或runner缓存初始化。模型review门禁因403不可用。

无产品API、依赖或数据库变更；仅四条PR可达checkout表达式和现有workflow测试变化，目前不跑PR的macOS/Windows分支不动。

## 关联问题

问题在排查#15734/#15684的CI时观察到，失败job见上方链接。本修复不完成#15512，也不声称修复#15685特有的产品回归。

</details>
